articleTitle: A Network Traffic Classification Method Based on Federated Learning and Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As one of the important research areas in the field of network security, network traffic classification has been receiving a lot of attention. At present, machine learning has been widely used in network traffic classification and achieved good results. However, the network traffic classification method based on machine learning has some problems, such as isolated data island, lack of labeled data and data leakage. Therefore, this paper proposes a network traffic classification method based on Federated learning and Extreme Learning Machine (NTFLELM). NTFLELM does not need to aggregate data for centralized operation, and only needs to pass model parameters, that is, it can use multiple local models to train global models cooperatively, which effectively solves the problems of isolated data island and the lack of labeled data.At the same time, it protects data privacy by sharing only model parameters but not specific data. The NTFLELM is evaluated on the KDD CUP99 data set, and the experimental results show that compared with the benchmark algorithms, the accuracy of NTFLELM network traffic classification is improved by 12%.

articleTitle: IBM Stock Forecast Using LSTM, GRU, Attention and Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the stock market, the change of stock price has always been the most concerned thing of shareholders. However, due to the uncertainty of the stock market, it is also very difficult to predict the trend of stock price. In this paper, first, we collected IBM's stock price data from January 2, 1962 to August 21, 2017, and then we calculated the middle price of the stock. Next, we present four model approach to stock prediction. The method used in our study is known as LSTM, LSTM+GRU, Attention, and Transformer. We carried out several sets of experiments to test the validity of the analysis. The test results show that the LSTM and GRU model superposition method is more effective than other methods in predicting the stock price trend of IBM.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Parcel Segmentation and Extraction Based on U-Net Convolution Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Satellite image parcel segmentation is a specific task of satellite image interpretation. Good satellite image parcel segmentation results can provide guidance for environmental protection, agricultural production and town construction. In this paper, a U-Net convolution neural network model based on Tensorflow framework is built. During the training process, a data enhancement strategy is specially designed for the satellite image parcel segmentation task, so as to enhance the generalization ability of the model. The experimental results select the intersection ratio (Iou), recall rate (Recall), and Kappa coefficient as evaluation indexes, and the final model can achieve a Kappa coefficient of 0.9342, which is significantly better than the random forest and convolution neural network methods commonly used for satellite image segmentation. The regions of some segmented images are not complete enough, and the connectivity of segmented images needs to be further improved. The satellite image parcel segmentation method proposed in this paper can realize the fine segmentation of high-resolution satellite images and provide a reference for the research of satellite image segmentation.

articleTitle: Lunar Impact Crater Detection Based on Yolo V7 Using Muti-source Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper demonstrates that Yolo V7, the latest version of the single-stage neural network Yolo, has good recognition of lunar impact craters on the Lunar CCD data and DEM data provided by the LROC camera which carried by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) used for the experiments. The results show that Yolo V7 has good results in detecting lunar impact craters based on two data types. The best identification results are based on CCD data exceeding 70%.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation for Deploying Dockerized Web Application on AWS, GCP, and Azure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Cloud computing is a growing technology widely used by companies, academic institutions, governments, and personnel. Each of these entities utilizes cloud computing for different purposes and requires different cloud service specifications. Entities require a test to determine the performance of cloud computing services for selecting the correct solution to the problem. In this research, tests are carried out using a web application on a Docker Container environment deployed on the three cloud computing services. JMeter, SysBench, and Apache Benchmark are used to get an evaluation performance test result. Stress test results using the Jmeter show that AWS has the fastest time for request execution and the highest number of threads executed in a second. For Sysbench testing, there are several assessment parameters used. For read-only and read-write data parameters on databases, Azure excels compared to GCP and AWS. in the CPU performance test parameter, AWS gets the highest score compared to GCP and Azure. For IO file performance testing, GCP is the best compared to AWS and Azure. For memory testing, Azure excels compared to GCP and AWS. In the Apache Benchmark test for API load testing, GCP and Azure get results that are not significantly different. However, Azure is slightly better on average than GCP and AWS.

articleTitle: TCN Stock Price Prediction Model Based on Channel Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Since the stock price fluctuations of the concept stocks of the metaverse culture and media sector has the same sector correlation, this paper proposes an improved TCN (Temporal Convolutional Network) models based on the channel attention mechanism, which makes the model focus on effective feature channels. First draw the heat map of the Pearson correlation coefficient of the stock closing price, insert the channel attention module on the TCN basic model; then use the standardized method to process the sample data, unify the sample data dimension, and construct the data set. The experimental results show that the performance of the improved TCN model based on the channel attention mechanism on A shares and US stocks is the same as the RMSE (Root square error) of the prediction results of multiple stocks. Better than the TCN basic model, using the channel attention weights to correct each channel can help the model learn and converge better, and it is effective for the optimization of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of Configurable I2C controller IP Core
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For ease of the building of our own SoC system and realization of more convenient I2C communication between the system and external devices, this paper divided the functions in accordance with I2C bus data transmission principle, and then designed various functional modules based on the Verilog HDL language, which improved the configurability and flexibility of the I2C controller IP core. To advance the use of application software developers efficiently, the interaction signals of information inside and outside the IP core were simplified, and the correctness of its data transmission is verified by means of hardware platform.

articleTitle: Radio Frequency Emitter Identification Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to accurately identify and authenticate radio frequency (RF) emitters, preventing the occurrence of problems such as device cloning, replay attacks and user identity impersonation, an identification method based on time- frequency feature extraction and ensemble learning is proposed. First, the short-time Fourier transform (STFT) is applied on the time-domain signals to generate the time-frequency images which carry the essential characteristics of the signals. Then three sub-models of Resnet34, Inceptionv3 and Densenet121 are trained on the data set with the features extracted by each sub- model and fused to obtain a comprehensive model. The experimental results show that the overall recognition accuracy of the proposed algorithm for 10 LoRa RF emitters outperforms the sub-models applied individually.

articleTitle: Scene Prediction and Manipulator Grasp Pose Estimation Based on YOLO-GraspNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the robotic arm grasps irregularly shaped objects in complex scenes, it cannot be accurately positioned, and the recognition speed is slow. This paper proposes a scene prediction-based location estimation algorithm YOLO-GraspNet. In the first stage of the method, the YOLOv5s model is used to identify and locate the grasping target, and then the depth information of the target area is marked. In the second stage, the GraspNet network is used to process only the data of the marked area, thereby improving the running speed of the model. This method uses GraspNet based on grasping pose prediction network, combined with YOLOv5s to estimate the pose of complex-shaped objects. It takes advantage of YOLOv5s' high detection accuracy, high grasping accuracy and other advantages. At the same time, it overcomes the problems of huge amount of input data, slow calculation speed and inability to accurately locate irregularly shaped objects in traditional methods. Finally, the prediction of grasping pose based on the proposed method and the grasping of the robotic arm are tested through experiments. The results show that the YOLO-GraspNet network can accurately and quickly predict the grasping pose of objects with complex shapes, and can be efficiently applied to robotic arm grasping tasks.

articleTitle: Improved A-star Algorithm in Efficiency Enhancing and Path Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A-star algorithm is a classical path planning method, but the generated path is often not smooth enough, which is difficult to be directly applied to cars or other mobile robots. At the same time, the wayfinding efficiency of a* algorithm also needs to be further improved. To solve the above problems, this study was improved by adjusting the way the A- star algorithm evaluated each node and used Bezier curve to smooth the path, thus improve the efficiency of the A-star algorithm and make the resulting path more suitable for the use of automobile robots. After the improvement, the number of search nodes and the time to complete the path are almost reduced by half compared with the traditional A-star algorithm. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, and show that the improved method can generate smooth paths while improving the planning efficiency.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient VNF Placement Algorithm Using Reinforcement Learning in NFV-Enabled Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The application of network function virtualization (NFV) allows current networks to flexibly manage orchestrated network functions and provide various network services. The current virtual network function placement process suffers from excessive energy consumption and high cost, and reducing energy consumption is one of the important challenges in the NFV resource allocation process. In this article, we explore the issue of placing VNFs within networks that have been enabled for NFV. We propose an algorithm for energy-efficient deployment of virtual network functions based on improved reinforcement learning. NeMC combines neighborhood node information integration with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) method while evaluating the relevance of placed nodes. We set the underlying node resource occupation criteria for the placement policy and dynamically shut down the unused nodes to significantly reduce energy consumption; link selection utilizes the shortest path search technique to achieve end-to-end path search. Evaluation results show that the solution performs well in handling many online NFV requests, with reduced energy consumption compared to the comparison algorithm. The benefit-cost ratio is also improved.

articleTitle: Study on Multipath Interference Performance of a UAV Data Link
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of multipath interference in a UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) data link, by improving the anti-multipath interference ability of UAV data link, the mechanism of multipath affect is analyzed. The diversity method is used to improve the multipath affect in the UAV data link. According to the actual research environment, three simulation scenarios are designed and analyzed quantitatively. The feasibility of spatial diversity and frequency diversity in diversity mode is discussed. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the two diversity methods are effective. By increasing the received signal strength, the multipath effect of UAV data link can be improved.

articleTitle: A 16-21 GHz Double-Balanced Gilbert Upconversion Mixer with Low in-Band Spurious Using 0.25μm GaAs pHEMT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents a 16-21 GHz double-balanced Gilbert upconversion mixer with low RF in-band spurious implemented in 0.25μm GaAs pHEMT technology. To achieve good balance performance, a Marchand balun with spiral structure is set at the LO port, CS-CG baluns with low unbalanced and good matching performances are designed and optimized to set at IF and RF ports. Gilbert mixer is improved by adding charge injection part and LR load to realize high in-band spurious target as well as moderate gain and linearity. The full mixer with baluns is integrated on MMIC chip with an area of 2.7mm×1.76mm. RF in-band suppression of the mixer is more than 40dB over the frequency of 16-21GHz. The mixer has a conversion gain of more than 7dB and OP1dB of -8dBm, OIIP3 of 4dBm when LO power is 5dBm.

articleTitle: Comparison of MPC Algorithms for Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Reaction processes are widely used in the process industry. Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) is an example of such processes. Due to the fact that CSTR temperature control plays a vital role in system performance, there are lots of control strategies proposed to address this need. There are lots of control strategies. Model Predictive Control (MPC) is a popular strategy in industry and academic research. Some popular MPC algorithms are MAC, DMC, GPC, Adaptive GPC, State Space MPC, Linear MPC, and Explicit MPC. This paper provides a performance comparison between these algorithms using performance characteristics and performance indices. The algorithms are evaluated by conducting several series of simulations which illustrate a better performance achieved by State Space MPC along with disturbance and noise robustness, so State Space MPC is the best choice to implement for CSTR.

articleTitle: Research on UAV path planning based on improved particle swarm algorithm with inertia weight
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For standard particle swarm algorithm in track planning, there are search depth convergence slow, local search ability is weak shortcomings, tthis paper studies a based on the inertial weight of nonlinear improvement strategy particle swarm algorithm for drone path planning, using logarithmic function to control inertial weight change, and add Gaussian random adjustment in the process of evolution to adjust the inertia weight, enhance the search ability of the algorithm, to enhance the stability of the path planning, improve the ability to get better path solution.

articleTitle: Research on Human Activity Recognition Based on Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The current machine learning algorithms classify human activities with inaccurate accuracy, poor generalization ability of the model, and poor classification effect. Proposing to use Random Forest classifier to classify the samples. The classifier has the advantage of good generalization ability, high accuracy, and the ability to handle a large number of sample data. After comparing with BP neural networks, Naive Bayesian networks, and decision trees, the random forest classifier achieved an accuracy of 98% on the test set, much higher than the 55%, 87%, and 88% of the other algorithms. In addition, we also tested the generalization ability of the model using the K-Folder cross-validation method, which yielded an average accuracy of 95.5%, also much higher than the 49.9%, 85%, and 90% of the other classifiers. The experimental results show that the random forest classifier has significantly improved in accuracy and generalization ability compared with BP neural network by 78% and 91%, respectively. Therefore, the superiority of the random forest classifier in human activity classification is proved.

articleTitle: Soft Actor-Critic Based Power Control Algorithm for Anti-jamming in D2D Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, we study the anti-jamming problem in device-to-device (D2D) communication. D2D communication will be interfered by cellular users because of multiplexing uplink. When faced with malicious interference from outside, it is necessary to carry out reasonable interference control while ensuring the communication between cellular users and D2D users. Aiming at this problem, a power control communication anti-jamming algorithm based on Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is proposed. By modeling the transmitter of D2D users as an agent, the overall throughput of the system is improved and the influence of external malicious interference is reduced while ensuring the signal-to-noise ratio of D2D users and cellular users. Compared with DQN (Deep Q-network) and random methods, the proposed algorithm can obtain higher system throughput and faster convergence speed in the face of sweep interference, and can show better anti-jamming effect.

articleTitle: Simulation and experiment of intelligent vehicle lateral control based on Fuzzy PID algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the lateral motion control of intelligent vehicle is studied and improved. According to the time-varying nonlinear characteristics of intelligent vehicle driving process, the Fuzzy PID control algorithm based on the combination of fuzzy control theory and traditional PID algorithm is adopted. The Fuzzy PID lateral control simulation platform is established by using Matlab / Simulink to verify the control effect of lateral lane change under different longitudinal speeds. The effectiveness of the fuzzy control algorithm is verified by the simulation results; Finally, the test platform is built and the lateral lane change motion control test is carried out. The accuracy of the simulation model and the reliability of the established control algorithm in the real road environment are verified, and the accuracy and dynamic stability of the lateral motion control of the intelligent vehicle are improved.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Remote Control Signal Recognition Based on Time-frequency Map
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The actual collected UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) signal is converted into CWD (Choi-Williams Distribution), and the maximum time-frequency spectrum of each part of the signal is spliced to make the characteristics of the frequency-hopping signal more obvious, and the adaptive method based on energy statistics is used to set the denoising threshold. According to the difference of correlation between remote control signal and image transmission signal in time and frequency domain, the image transmission signal and remote control signal in the original signal are innovatively separated into low-rank matrix and sparse matrix by using low-rank matrix recovery method, so as to achieve effective extraction of time-frequency characteristics of remote control signal. The convolution neural network CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) is used to input the time-frequency spectrum obtained by CWD of the collected signal into the trained CNN network to complete the sorting of UAV models. This method realizes blind classification of UAV signals without acquiring the target signal parameter characteristics, and the accuracy of test set reaches 89.19%; Further use the LSTM (Long and Short Term Memory) network to convert the remote control signal into a time series, and express the time series in a five-element form, which can make the mode representation of the data closer to the trend change of the original data, and the accuracy of the final test set reaches 92.48%.

articleTitle: Clipping-based Neural Network Post Training Quantization for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) have achieved amazing breakthroughs in computer vision, speech recognition, and other fields. However, with the development of deep learning, the number of weights in the neural network is increasing, consuming a lot of storage and computing resources. The high storage cost and computational complexity severely restrict the deployment of deep learning on embedded mobile devices. Therefore, the compression and acceleration of convolutional neural networks becomes particularly important. Therefore, in order to compress the size of the target detection model and speed up the calculation, this paper proposes a post-training quantization method for clip limit operation, limits are performed on the input data stream and weight parameters during training, then uses the parameter quantization method to quantize the model parameters from 32-bit floating point to 8-bit Integer. Under the premise of no impact on the performance of the algorithm, the model can be effectively compressed and the calculation speed can be improved. On the public data set PASCAL VOC2012, the performance of this algorithm is evaluated by two classic target detection algorithms, Faster R-CNN and YOLO V3. The experimental results show that compared with the original model, it saves 75% of the storage space and improves the calculation speed 2 times faster; FPS is also improved compared to standard quantization.

articleTitle: Survey on Neural Networks in Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Neural Networks can learn natural language representations within levels of abstraction, and have recently shown much promise for Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications. Kinds of Neural Network Language Models (NNLMs) have gained a lot of success by predicting the next word given the other words in a context. These models have improved the state-of-the-art in word sense disambiguation, question answering, web search and many other domains in semantic parsing. Compared with "bag of word", Word Embedding has brought about breakthroughs in representations of words, sentences, or even documents. Recurrent Neural Network Language Models (RNNLMs) have shone light. They can learn and store long-memory knowledge that would help extracting better representations for long documents.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Panel Fault Detection Based on Improved Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic panels are widely recognized as a clean energy generation device, and their quality and efficiency are becoming increasingly important for power generation. However, due to the harsh environmental conditions that PV panels are exposed to, such as high winds, heavy rain, and high temperatures, as well as damage during manufacturing and transportation, various types of failures can occur. These failures can lead to a reduction in the performance of the PV panels, affecting the efficiency and lifespan of the electricity generated. Therefore, it is crucial to detect and monitor PV panels for faults. The traditional target detection method has limitations, including low recognition accuracy and slow detection speed. This paper suggests an improved Mask R-CNN-based intelligent detection method for PV panel faults. The FPN in the Mask R-CNN model is improved to BiFPN to better reflect the original image information. In the later Mask stage, the channel attention mechanism is added to help the model focus more effectively and quickly on important areas of the image. Experiments show that the model can be applied to a variety of scenarios and effectively solves the problems of missed detection and false detection.

articleTitle: Research on Torque Pulsation Suppression of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Harmonic Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is affected by the nonlinearities of the inverter during operation resulting in harmonics in the motor stator current, which causes the motor to pulsate in torque and cause additional losses. To address this problem, an adaptive harmonic injection algorithm is proposed to suppress the harmonic currents of the motor. First, the mathematical models of the 5th and 7th harmonics of the motor are established respectively. Secondly, the harmonic extraction module uses Kalman filter to extract harmonic currents, and the harmonic suppression module introduces Model Reference Adaptive Parameter Identification (MRAI), which, combined with multi-rotation PI control, constitutes an adaptive harmonic suppression algorithm that effectively avoids the effects of inductance, resistance, and magnetic chain changes on the suppression of harmonics during the motor dynamics. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm to suppress torque pulsation is verified by comparing the simulation results before and after adding the algorithm.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLO-v4 Algorithm for Recognition and Detection of Underwater Small Targets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Since the underwater complex environmental conditions seriously affect the accuracy of underwater target recognition, in view of the low accuracy of traditional image recognition algorithms for target recognition and the lack of robustness in extracting features, an image enhancement method for small underwater targets is proposed. A scheme combined with the YOLO-v4 improved algorithm. Firstly, the K-means++ algorithm is used to improve the original input anchor box mechanism to achieve accurate anchor box selection, and the image data enhancement strategy based on geometric and photometric transformation is used to optimize the training network. Finally, the EIOU loss function is used to optimize the model performance and improve the loss function convergence speed. The experimental results show that the average accuracy rate of the improved network model reaches 98.37%, and the number of frames per second of image transmission reaches 35.69FPS, which is 4.4.% higher than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Horse Riding Action Monitoring Platform Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to meet the increasing demand of video analysis and its related applications, the method of temporal motion detection based on deep learning has attracted more and more attention. Through the motion detection system, users can use the labeled data for supervised training through the training module of the system to generate a deep learning model for extracting the target semantics, and can also call the model through the prediction module of the system to calculate and analyze the silhouette of the moving person in the video. Accurate analysis of sports training posture by technical means is one of the important means to improve people's competitive level in modern sports. The method adopted in this paper is deep learning. CNN training model is applied to spatial stream (video image) and temporal stream (dense optical stream) respectively to judge the scores of the categories of actions, and different methods are explored to fuse the scores of the two networks to get the final classification results. According to the research in this paper, this method is effective and can be widely used.

articleTitle: Defense against sybil attack in blockchain based on improved consensus algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Sybil attack is one of the most serious security threats in distributed systems. This paper proposes an anti-sybil consensus algorithm, which can effectively defend against sybil attacks. This algorithm is an improved version of the PBFT algorithm. It introduces a reputation system, which assigns trust scores to nodes based on their behavior, and uses these trust scores to determine their voting weight in the consensus process. In order to evaluate the performance of the algorithm, the simulation is performed on a blockchain network with different number of nodes and sybil attackers. The results show that the algorithm can effectively defend against sybil attacks. Compared with the existing methods, the anti-sybil consensus algorithm in this paper has several advantages. First, it is lightweight and easy to implement, which makes it suitable for resource-constrained devices. Second, the performance of the improved algorithm has not significantly decreased. In short, the anti-sybil consensus algorithm proposed in this paper provides a practical solution for protecting distributed systems from sybil attacks.

articleTitle: Research on near field noise source location method of vertical array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, focusing beamforming algorithm is used to scan a measurement area to achieve passive location of the target noise source in the near field, which effectively solves the problem of noise source location in the near field. In this paper, the near-field focused beamforming method is developed based on the conventional beamforming method (CBF), MVDR beamforming method and MUSIC algorithm under far-field conditions. Finally, based on the near-field focused beamforming method, the sound source localization and recognition simulation of near-field stationary single frequency single point sound source is carried out.

Author Keywords: The near field. Noise source location

articleTitle: Analysis and research on probabilistic power flow calculation method of new urban distribution network based on LHS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the intermittency, volatility, and randomness of the output of photovoltaic power generation, its high proportion of access will bring challenges to the operation of the new urban distribution network. This article analyzes the correlation between distributed photovoltaic power generation and user load power using the LHS method, and validates the proposed method using an IEEE 33 node distribution network model. As a result, a new urban distribution network probabilistic power flow calculation method based on LHS is obtained, proving that this method can be used to analyze and study the impact of distributed photovoltaic integration into the new urban distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on pavement crack detection algorithm in complex background
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Cracks are the most common diseases of highway pavement, which affect the safe operation of highway. Therefore, timely and effective detection and maintenance of cracks in highway pavement is essential. The existing pavement crack detection methods are mainly based on the condition that the image quality is good, the pavement is clean, and the image has no shadow. But in the actual situation, the background of the pavement image is complex. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct in-depth research on pavement crack detection under complex background. The pavement cracks under complex background are characterized by uneven illumination, more interference noise and weak crack information. In this paper, a pavement crack image enhancement algorithm based on luminance region is proposed, which is used to eliminate the shadows on the pavement image, and then the maximum entropy threshold segmentation algorithm is used to extract the cracks on the pavement image. The experimental results show that the algorithm can accurately detect cracks on shadowed pavement.

articleTitle: A self-supervised, few-shot semantic segmentation study based on mobileViT model structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Vision tasks such as semantic segmentation face challenges due to a lack of data and the need to reduce model parameters. In this study, we present a novel approach that unites several techniques, including the mobileViT model, and self-supervised training, to improve the performance of few-shot image segmentation. Our approach leverages unsupervised saliency estimation to obtain a pseudo-mask and contrast learning to enhance the feature representation. Furthermore, we introduce the MaskSplit method to divide up saliency masks into the artificial query and support sets. To train the few-shot segmentation model, we apply self-supervised meta-learning based on vision transformer. Importantly, our approach eliminates the need for manual segmentation of annotations during training, enabling a fully self-supervised learning setup. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach on two popular benchmark datasets for few-shot semantic segmentation, namely Pascal-5i and COCO-20i. Our study demonstrates its effectiveness in small-sample semantic segmentation tasks.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a new online English learning artificial intelligence system based on JAVA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The rapid development of computer information technology has had a profound impact on various industries and fields of society. In recent years, a large number of artificial intelligence software for computer-assisted teaching have emerged. In order to improve the efficiency of auxiliary software development and deployment, this paper uses the combination of Java and artificial intelligence language Prolog to develop a new software system that can realize online intelligent learning. The system also applies the idea of artificial intelligence expert system theory, which has certain creativity. Use Struts+ Spring+ Hibernate lightweight JavaEE framework to build. The system greatly reduces the degree of dislocation between various modules, which is beneficial to the expansion of future functions. In general, compared with ordinary teaching assistance systems, this system applies the artificial intelligence module combined with the forgetting law of the brain into the system, and designs a system for reviewing English knowledge points to check for omissions.

articleTitle: Tile surface defect detection based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high computational complexity and large number of parameters in traditional ceramic tile defect detection methods, a ceramic tile surface defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 was proposed. Firstly, the light weight network ShuffleNet was used to reconstruct the Backbone feature extraction network in YOLOv5, and Focus structure was replaced with Conv_BN_ReLU_Maxpool layer. Then, the SE attention mechanism is introduced to improve the feature extraction ability of the model. The improved algorithm mAP reaches 89.4%, the weight file is only 4.76MB, and the number of parameters is 2.64MB, which are reduced by 66% and 63% respectively, and the accuracy rate of defect detection on ceramic tile surface can reach 87.1% or more. Experimental results show that the accuracy is guaranteed and the number of parameters is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Control Structure Design and Simulation Analysis of Table Tennis Picking Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The existing grab-type table tennis ball-picking device needs to pick up the table tennis balls one by one, which has low picking efficiency and is easy to fail to catch; The absorption type table tennis ball pick-up device has poor absorption effect on the table tennis ball stuck in the gap or corner. In this paper, a table tennis ball-picking device using the functions of mechanical arm ball clamping and fluid suction is proposed, which can realize the switching between two different ball-picking mechanisms, and can be applied to a wider range of scenes and more practical; The mechanical control structure is simpler by positioning the suction pipe of the ball suction mechanism relative to the rotating arm on the ball clamping mechanism. The suction pipe can be driven by the rotating arm to realize the positioning adjustment of the angle of the goal opening, which greatly improves the reliability and efficiency of ball picking.

articleTitle: Research on DNS Attack Detection Based on HMM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the own features of openness, hugeness and complexity in DNS , and the lack of consideration for security when designing DNS, DNS is now faced with a very serious security threat, with man-made attack and destruction. There are various forms of DNS attacks. This paper selects two of the attack forms, DDoS attack against DNS and DNS amplification attack. Combined with HMM model, we do research on DNS attack detection, and use simulation experiments and data to prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the detection method.

articleTitle: Classification of black tea leaf water content based on hyperspectral imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Withering is an important process step in black tea production, and the degree of withering directly determines the quality and flavor of black tea. Presently, the judgment of the degree of the withering of black tea at home and abroad mainly depends on the experience of tea masters, which is highly subjective and quickly leads to the inconsistent quality of finished tea. Based on these reasons, this thesis takes Ying Hong No. 9 black tea as the research object, extracts the spectral information of 50 tea leaves in four time periods using hyperspectral imaging technology and an image processing algorithm, and classifies them using a support vector machine, K-value proximity, random forest algorithm, and BP neural network, and the experimental results show that the spectral information of tea leaves in different periods has some variability. The BP neural network in The classification accuracy on the test set reached 73.3%, which was significantly better than the other three algorithms. Therefore, it is feasible to use hyperspectral imaging technology and related classification algorithms to nondestructively identify and classify the water content of black tea leaves during the tail-withering process.

articleTitle: Recent Advances and Future Perspectives of Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Digital twin technology is oriented to the whole life cycle process of products. By creating a digital virtual model of physical entities, it plays a key role of bond and bridge between the physical scene and the information scene, and can provide more real-time, intelligent and swift diversified services. In recent years, digital twin technology has been widely concerned by scholars at home and abroad, and the research has achieved fruitful results. This paper first summarizes the relevant concepts of digital twins, then introduces the research and application status of the main research institutions from both foreign and domestic perspectives, and finally puts forward the shortcomings of the current research and the key research directions in the future, with a view to providing theoretical and methodological references for further in-depth research and wide application in the future.

articleTitle: Pure orientation passive localization and adjustment strategy of UAV attempted formation based on greedy algorithm and target planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the maturity and popularity of UAV technology, the application of UAVs has gained more and more attention in the past decades in the fields of military, hazardous land exploration, and infrastructure construction. In the actual formation flight of UAVs, the pure azimuth passive positioning technology is used in order to reduce the interference of external signals, which puts higher requirements on the ability of UAVs to determine their own position based on the azimuth information only. The work of this paper is precisely to model the passive signals in the UAV swarm and optimize them step by step, and apply the model to achieve positioning in the face of different restrictions to obtain the positioning method for UAVs in electromagnetic silence.

articleTitle: Application of residual network in household waste classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization, the amount of garbage has skyrocketed. This makes the burden of sorting waste by manual means heavier and heavier, resulting in a large amount of waste accumulation. In this context, the classification of household garbage gradually received attention. In order to improve the efficiency of garbage classification, we should deal with the increasingly complicated garbage classification work and make garbage classification intelligent and efficient. In this paper, convolutional neural network intelligent algorithm is used to solve the classification problem of organic and inorganic garbage in daily life. The accuracy can reach 90.34% only with low sequence training. Compared with existing commonly used garbage classification and recognition algorithms, the proposed garbage classification and recognition algorithm has better recognition performance and is more suitable for widespread application.

articleTitle: Investigation to Screen Region Division for Stable Input of Eye-controlled Cursor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of stable cursor hovering and "Midas Touch" that are difficult to achieve in the current eye-controlled cursor technology, this paper has carried out an experimental study on the stable input of the eye-controlled cursor: Firstly, divide the screen into several small rectangular areas. When the eye-controlled cursor appears in any rectangular region, the position of the cursor will be fixed at the center of the rectangular region, and there will be no shaking of the eye-controlled cursor in a small range due to the natural wobble of the eyeball pupil. Then, the screen interface UI and icon sizes are adjusted according to the screen division level, to ensure that there is only one click target in each small rectangular area of the screen, and to ensure that there is no ambiguity when clicking on the eye-controlled cursor. Finally, by combining the task completion time, task completion rate, error rate, task difficulty, performance indicators, user satisfaction and other test data information to determine the most appropriate screen division size.

articleTitle: Non-oscillation Path Planning Based on Artificial Potential Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Considering that the mobile robot is not flexible enough, in order to avoid the oscillating motion of the robot with repeated steering changes, when encountering obstacles in front, according to the rule that each deflection to the right is not more than 5 degrees, an improved forced resultant force deflection method and virtual obstacle adding method are proposed to solve the local minimum problem and avoid the occurrence of oscillation, which need not get the characteristics after the oscillation for the condition of virtually adding obstacles. The simulation results show that there is no oscillation in different obstacle environments, and the path is smooth without the local minimum problem. By virtually adding multiple obstacles, the robot can quickly leave the dense obstacles.

articleTitle: Prototype-guided Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Semantic segmentation is one of the most important research directions in the field of computer vision, and has a wide range of applications for autonomous driving, medical imaging, intelligent security, etc. Unsupervised domain adaptation is the mainstream research topic in recent years, which can use a large number of labeled source samples to complete the segmentation task in target domain without labeled target samples. In this paper, we propose a prototype-guided unsupervised domain adaptation for semantic segmentation based on ProDA model. Due to lacking of labeled target samples and the prior probability, a prototype distance loss based on target domain is proposed to optimize the distribution of features by measuring the distance between features and the updated prototype and designing an adaptive threshold strategy. Meanwhile, a smoothing loss is proposed to alleviate the impact of source samples on our model and improve the prediction performance of the network. By conducting experiments on the GTA5 to Cityscapes scenarios, the results show that compared with the original model, the loss optimization improves mIoU by1.52.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Analysis System of Operating State of Electric Energy Metering Device Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The model management of electric energy metering devices has been in the state of innovative management for a long time. This model can no longer meet the needs of industrial development in today’s market environment. In order to further strengthen the control of the working state of various electric energy metering devices, it has become an important content of the development of the times to use computer technology to study the intelligent analysis system of the working state of electric energy metering devices. This paper analyzes the various reasons for the failure of electric energy meters, discusses the technical characteristics of various abnormal situations, and puts forward reasonable monitoring principles. This paper completes the overall design of the computer-based intelligent analysis system for the operation status of electric energy metering devices, and designs an external monitoring and processing unit and a fully functional database system. This paper designs the overall structure of the monitoring system of the electric energy meter operation status. The research and development of the main station software of the electric meter state monitoring operating system focuses on the design of the software state monitoring processing unit. Experimental research shows that this paper combines the concept of differentiated operation and maintenance of electric energy metering devices, which reduces the on-site inspection of 33 current transformers in the city, and also helps to ensure the safe operation of the city’s electric power marketing security business.

articleTitle: Network Topology Planning Method of Emergency Microwave Communication Network Based on ACO Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of slow network planning of the existing emergency communication network and low bandwidth of planning objects, an emergency microwave communication network topology planning method based on the ACO optimization algorithm is proposed. The problems existing in the network topology planning of emergency microwave communication network at the current stage are studied, and the planning problem is conceptually modeled; the process and method of ACO application in network planning are proposed, and the Dijkstra algorithm is introduced into the planning model to form a An emergency microwave communication network topology planning method based on ACO optimization algorithm; practical application shows that the network topology planning method can quickly and accurately generate corresponding planning schemes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Cyber Rang with Emulated Network Security Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: When universities conduct network attack and defence experiments, window, Linux systems and vulnerable applications are simulated in the Cyber Security Range, while the simulation of network security devices is missing. As a result, the experimental process is quite different from the process in the real production environment. EVE-NG (Emulated Virtual Environment) is an emerging virtual simulation platform that incorporates Dynamips, IOL, and QEMU simulation technologies. Based on the EVE-NG platform, this paper not only simulates network security hardware devices such as firewall, web firewall, logging platform, but also builds an infrastructure environment for network attack and defence. Based on this environment, a complete network attack and defence experimental environment can be constructed by adding various host systems with vulnerabilities, applications, and even vulnhub target machines. Using the method in this paper, the experimental environment can be established by using a highly configured computer without purchasing any hardware security device, which reduces the cost of establishing a laboratory. In addition, this kind of Cyber Security Range is closer to the real production environment, which is conducive to improving students' network attack and defence skills.

articleTitle: Safety helmet wearing detection in thermal power plant based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In industrial safety accidents, the failure of workers to wear helmets is a major cause. A deep learning detection model can now be developed using computer vision techniques to detect whether workers in thermal power plants are wearing helmets. An improved helmet-wearing detection algorithm for YOLOv5 is proposed in this paper which overcomes the shortcomings of existing algorithms and successfully detects small, obscured, and dense targets. The algorithm enhances the efficiency of detecting small targets by adding classification convolutional blocks. Furthermore, it integrates the MA channel attention mechanism into the Neck network to reconstruct channel weight, filter out erroneous channels, increase feature expression capability, and introduce FReLU to enhance the spatial sensitivity of the activation function. Under the SHWD dataset, the mAP of this model reaches 91.9%, an improvement of about 1.6% as compared to the original model. The study demonstrates that the improved algorithm can satisfy the practical requirements of thermal power plant work sites and performs well for the helmet detection task.

articleTitle: Seam Carving Algorithm Based on Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The retargeting technique is essential for image resizing and greatly preserves regions of interest in the image. In view of the long operation time and the distortion of salient objects of the existing retargeting algorithm when many seams are removed, a new seam carving (SC) algorithm based on image blocking is proposed. Firstly, combine the Sobel algorithm with label decoupling framework (LDF) to fully extract the regions of interest in the image. Then image blocking reduces the range of dynamic programming, which can effectively reduce the running time of image retargeting. Finally, remove the seams in proportion to obtain the result. Experiments are conducted with RetargetMe and DUTOMRON image datasets. Experimental results show that, the proposed method preserves the integrity of significant regions, reduces the running time and improves the operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stock Price Using LSTM, MA and EMA Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, we substitute data from General Electric Company and study the three models of LSTM, MA and EMA, in an attempt to compare and analyze the results to screen out a model with more accurate predictions. Under the prediction of the LSTM model, we find that the difference between the loss values after the trend remains stationary is small. Compared to the MA model, the EMA model predicts more closer line, but not as accurately as the LSTM model. Combining the figures and data, we conclude that the predictions of the LSTM model are more accurate. We hope that our research results can help more readers understand the predictions of stocks and their related models, and then they can successfully reap more profits in the stock market.

articleTitle: Design of Artificial Intelligence Teaching System in Colleges and Universities Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: One of the important goals of online learning is to realize personalized learning service based on intelligent technology, so as to promote personalized education on a large scale. Therefore, the intelligent and personalized transformation of teaching resource service has become two core tasks. Taking this as the goal, this paper aims to realize personalized learning service for learners by reorganizing teaching resources based on knowledge map technology and supporting the evaluation and analysis of learners' learning level and needs. Therefore, the related technology research and system prototype realization are carried out, and a personalized learning platform based on knowledge map is formed. It combines the learning of knowledge points, the training of exercises and personalized recommendation to form a closed loop of personalized learning services. In the daily teaching activities of colleges and universities, the course selection system can not only make students clearly understand the key points of a certain class; At the same time, it can also enable students to make their own choices better and define their own development direction. Therefore, the course selection system should be able to push and recommend courses that students are really interested in, so that every student can choose and take courses that they like and really need.

articleTitle: Small object detection algorithm based on improved yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The detection of small objects is always a difficulty in the field of object detection. This paper proposes an improved yolov5 algorithm to improve the performance of the algorithm for small object detection. In this paper, the BoT3 block is used to instead of the last C3 block in the backbone, which greatly improves the ability of network to feature extraction and fusion ability. Coordinate attention mechanism module is also added to strengthen feature extraction. In addition, EIoU_Loss replaces the CIoU_Loss function to solve the problems that penalizing failure with equal ratio of aspect ratio. At last, in order to better detect small targets in the image, a smaller size prediction head is added. Moreover, before starting the training, the paper uses K-means method to calculate the new anchors. Experimental results show that evaluation indexes of the model have been improved partially. To be specific, the Precision increases 3.8%; the Recall increases 5.9%; the MAP:0.5 increases 6.3%; the MAP0.5:0.95 increases 3.8%.

articleTitle: Satellite Communication Coding Design Based on Large Frequency Reuse Factor and Precoding Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: It is an inevitable trend for high-throughput satellite systems to adopt full frequency multiplexing technology. Therefore, this paper optimizes the design of satellite communication(SC) coding based on large frequency multiplexing factor and precoding technology(PT). The static soft frequency reuse and dynamic soft frequency reuse of large frequency reuse factor(LFRF) are discussed. The PT is briefly analyzed; Through the experimental analysis of the optimization of SC coding design, it shows that the optimization design scheme of the LFRF and PT proposed in this paper obviously eliminates the co frequency interference between beams, and improves the system capacity and has a certain robustness.

articleTitle: Ground classification based on optimal random forest model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Today mobile robots are widely used in medical, rescue, and service industries, and are gradually replacing labor costs and playing an increasingly important role in various industries. The correct recognition of ground types can help robots adapt to different environments and help them reach the target area efficiently and quickly. Random forest model is a classifier model with widespread applications and is often used to solve the ground classification problem of mobile robots. In response to the problem that the traditional random forest algorithm has many initial parameters and lacks a definite formula to obtain the optimal combination of parameters, which leads to the low accuracy of the traditional random forest classifier model. In order to extend the ground recognition method and improve the accuracy of the random forest model, this paper proposes a random forest classifier model optimized by using genetic algorithm to classify ground types. The experimental results show that the effect achieved by the optimized random forest model, in terms of accuracy, has a significant improvement in accuracy compared with the traditional algorithm, reaching a recognition accuracy of 93%.

articleTitle: Image Restoration Based on Wiener Filter and Constrained Least Square Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the process of image acquisition, the final acquired image is always accompanied by dynamic blurring and noise. This article describes the image degradation process as a degradation system. The original image function is first convolved with Point Spread Function (PSF) to simulate the motion blur process, and then Gaussian white noise is added to obtain the final degraded image. For degraded images, this article discusses how to use the Wiener filter and constrained least square filter to restore the image. The Wiener filter uses the minimum mean square error as a criterion for recovery while the least square filter uses the least square criterion for recovery. On the premise of accurately grasping the degradation function and the statistical information of the original picture and noise, the Wiener filter can have a better restoration effect. When only the information about the mean value and variance of the noise is grasped, the constrained least square filtering method can be used to obtain a better restoration effect.

articleTitle: Software Defined Network Load Balancing Based on Im-ACO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to improve the load balancing problem of software defined network (SDN), an improved joint algorithm based on the traditional ant colony algorithm and server load balancing algorithm is proposed. The algorithm uses a weighted least connection scheduling algorithm, the server with the least load is selected on the server side, and the improved ant colony algorithm (Im-ACO) is used to select the best path to the selected server. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the proposed joint algorithm can significantly improve network performance, higher network throughput and lower packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Research on Segmentation and Recognition Algorithm of Moving Human Image Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the improvement of living standards, people have higher and higher requirements for the quality of life and continue to pursue a green and healthy life. Video surveillance system has more and more security requirements in the fields of transportation, banking, security, power and military facilities. Therefore, video surveillance has been widely used in all aspects of people's production and life. The image segmentation algorithm predicts a discrete semantic label for each pixel of the image, which can be used to extract the target object with hard boundary in the image and synthesize it into a new background. But this does not satisfy all needs. Most of the current methods of human image segmentation can only guarantee one of the indicators, which makes the practical application of human image segmentation greatly limited. According to the difference between different areas in the video image, the video image is divided into motion area, background area and occlusion area, and the edge detection operator is used to detect the edge of the moving object, and finally the moving object in the video image is segmented. The algorithm is characterized by simplicity and high efficiency, and is suitable for monitoring systems with limited resources such as embedded systems. Experiments show that this algorithm can segment moving human images in different scenes, and it has good robustness and accuracy, reaching a practical level. This algorithm has practical significance for automatic control of lens aiming at moving human in surveillance system.

articleTitle: Sharded Blockchain Architecture Oriented to Multilateral Collaboration of Source-Grid-Load- Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The scalability of traditional blockchain is insufficient to meet the large-scale access requirements of Source-Grid-Load-Storage, and a large number of authentication and data processing requirements will bring intolerable delay to the business. This paper proposes a sharded blockchain architecture oriented to the multilateral collaboration of Source-Grid-Load-Storage, improves the scalability of the blockchain by using the sharding technology, and proposes a cross-shard transaction mechanism to meet the interaction needs of multiple agents. The experiment verifies that the proposed architecture can effectively improve the operational efficiency of the blockchain in the Source-Grid- Load-Storage large-scale access scenario, and the proposed cross-shard transaction mechanism can effectively ensure the cross-domain collaboration of multiple agents.

articleTitle: Research on Grid Communication Encryption Quantum Key Encryption Transmission System Based on 5G Communication Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on 5G communication, this paper proposes a quantum key encryption method for the physical layer of power grid communication that uses single quantum key encryption to generate a key matrix to achieve the effect of improving the security of the communication system. The innovation of this method is that it can calculate the quantum key update frequency and distribution strategy of each power business by itself. At the same time, the power grid communication encryption algorithm can optimize the quantum key management control process of the quantum security encryption transmission equipment. It can solve the problems of low-key application efficiency or insufficient key that may exist in the current application due to the singleness of the quantum key strategy. Simulation studies show that this scheme can enhance the security and practicability of sensitive information in the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving Control of 3D Animation Rendering Cluster Based on Programmable Processor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Cluster rendering is very necessary in today’s 3D animation rendering and HD post video production. From the initial processing of a single still image to the current rendering of video and 3D scene, from the original rendering process requires a lot of manual interaction to the current computer automatic recognition and rendering. Due to the support of programmable graphics hardware, many rendering technologies can render video or 3D scene in real time and become animation after improvement and acceleration. One of the biggest problems in stylized line drawing of 3D models is the calculation of visibility. In the current algorithm for calculating line visibility with complex models, either the interactive rendering speed is too slow or the rendered animation is incoherent. An algorithm for fast, high-quality calculation of line visibility under the GPU, which utilizes advanced programmable graphics pipeline technology that supports line visibility and a wide range of stylization options. This paper studies the energy consumption of rendering clusters in the field of 3D animation rendering, adopts the task volume prediction model based on neural network, and combines the historical data statistics of rendering system task volume, and proposes a multi-step prediction-based rendering cluster automatic on-off control algorithm and energy-saving control architecture. And the effectiveness of the energy-saving control method is verified by actual data.

articleTitle: A Combined Multi-Pulse Transmitting Circuit for Time-Domain Electromagnetic Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A combined multi-pulse transmitting circuit for time domain electromagnetic detection is proposed in this paper. The dual-pulse energy boosting and high-voltage clamping technology are employed in transmitting system to meet the requirements of large detection depth and high resolution in shallow strata simultaneously. The operation principles of the proposed topology are explained and the simplified control method is provided. Simulation results demonstrate that the circuit can generate high-quality combined current pulses for the highly inductive load. Extensive experiments verify that the proposed circuit and control method can improve the reliability and efficiency of the transmitting system and it is suitable for TEM application.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Substation Video Monitoring Based on Transparent Transmission Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex network architecture, various equipment types, inconsistent transmission protocols, large optimization stock and high requirements for intelligent degree of intelligent substation video monitoring system. This paper presents an optimized design scheme of intelligent substation video monitoring system based on transparent transmission. On the basis of meeting the network security, through optimizing the network architecture, adopt transparent transmission mode to bypass the protocol restrictions of network video recorders and other station equipment, while the local storage and call of substation video images are not affected. So as to realize the full play of the functions of the station camera, the efficient use of IP resources, and the function optimization of the intelligent substation. The experiment shows that the optimization design scheme can effectively solve the above problems and provide some reference and experience for solving the transformation of a large number of video monitoring systems in the power grid system.

articleTitle: Defect Identification Technology for Rotate Object in Transmission Lines Based on Multi-scale Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper,a multi-scale residual network based defect identification technology for rotate targets in transmission lines is proposed. By combining the Res2Net module and the Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks to improve the attention of the backbone network ResNet-50 for multi-scale features, using five parameters (x,y,w,h,theta) to represent the directed bounding box, and using angle regression to improve the detection sensitivity of rotate anchor boxes, which greatly improves the Defect diagnosis effect for large metal fittings in transmission lines.

articleTitle: Fire Distribution Method of Ground Assault Equipment Based on Improved NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Given the problem of weapon coordinated fire distribution of ground assault equipment, against a background of small-scale assault, a fire distribution model is established based on the background of small-scale assault warfare, combining the damage efficiency against the enemy and our operational losses;, the fire distribution model is built; NSGA-II algorithm is selected to solve the problem, and dynamic crowding calculation strategy is adopted, and adaptive crossover and mutation operators are introduced to improve the optimization performance of the algorithm. Finally, the simulation results suggest that the improved NSGA-II algorithm can improve the distribution of the solution set, improve the convergence of the algorithm, and effectively solve the problem of weapon coordinated fire distribution of ground assault equipment.

articleTitle: Design of Navigation System for Underground Mine Complex Environment Based on LVI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the problems of poor light, dust disturbance, and lack of structured information in underground mines, LVI multi-sensor fusion navigation is usually used. However, due to the data transmission delay and sensor installation error in the process of multi-sensor information fusion, the problem of time space non synchronization is easy to occur. In order to solve this problem, this paper designs an underground mine complex environment navigation system based on LVI. The temporal and spatial alignment technology is adopted. IMU time is selected as the registration reference. First, LI is interpolated and registered, and then VI is estimated by minimizing the joint residual motion state. The LVI measurement equation is constructed by factor graph synthesis to solve the position and attitude. The system is deployed on the vehicle platform, and the relative positioning error in the simulation experiment site is less than 4%. Compared with other open source navigation systems in the same environment, the system has a good positioning and navigation results.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Automatic Capacity Adjustment Transformer and Circuit Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The load in the electrical power system changes regularly with seasons. The load also fluctuates will time within the same period. The distribution transformer is operated in full load, half load sometimes and even approximate no-load state. The self-loss of the transformer is higher during half-load and even lower state if the transformer rated capacity is fixed and constant, which is not conducive to system loss reduction. A transformer capacity adjustment control strategy is designed, wherein the actual working capacity of the transformer can be automatically detected, the rated capacity of the transformer can be adjusted according to the actual load capacity so that the actual output capacity of the transformer is close to the rated capacity thereof as far as possible, thereby achieving the highest working efficiency, saving energy, and increasing efficiency. The capacity adjustment control strategy of the transformer as well as hardware and software circuits thereof are designed. The reliability and practicability of the designed control strategy as well as hardware and software circuits are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Building Daylighting System Based on Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, fiber optic lighting technology and intelligent shading technology combined to improve. A number of miniaturized natural light acquisition units are arranged alternately on the outer sun visor and a light tracking control sensor is set in the center position of each group of outer sun visor. Through intelligent light tracking control, the external sunshade system rotates with the incident light Angle and maintains a vertical relationship with the incident light. The natural light acquisition unit attached to the outer sun visor is also kept vertically incident with the incident light. The system transmits the collected and focused light by quartz fiber to indoor natural light and LED mixed light lighting lamps for lighting. The feasibility of this new green lighting system is proved by experiments under actual weather conditions, and it has good performance. In the experiment, the maximum illumination inside the closed darkroom is more than 10 times when the lighting system is installed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System of Metal Surface Heat Treatment Based on Fuzzy PID Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: It refers to several processes such as heating a metal or alloy to a certain temperature in a solid-state, holding it for a certain time, and then heating it to a certain temperature and holding it for a certain time. With the improvement of the level of industrial technology and the diversity of market demands, it is necessary to improve the existing properties of metal materials and their products and to develop their potential properties. From workpieces with uniform shape and density to workpieces with uneven shape and density, since induction heating uses the principle of electromagnetic induction, the depth of infiltration of heat-induced on the surface of the workpiece varies with the shape of the workpiece. Human development is closely related to the application and development of metal materials, especially in modern times, metal materials play a pivotal role in the development of human civilization. Combining the advantages of proportional, fuzzy, and proportional-integral control, compared with the conventional PID controller, it greatly improves the robustness against external disturbances and adapts to changes in internal parameters, reduces overshoot, and improves dynamic performance. All furnaces used in metallurgy and heat treatment are large inertial systems with pure lag. The conventional control method can not meet the industrial requirements by measuring the load output current and voltage and controlling the power output through the experience of field operators. It is a large inertial system with pure lag. The temperature of the furnace is affected by the number of passengers to be processed, the size of the volume, the opening, and closing of the door, the heating material, the ambient temperature, and the voltage fluctuation of the power grid. This extensive production indirectly leads to high energy consumption and high pollution, so heat treatment should be perfected to improve the control accuracy and automation of heat treatment equipment, reduce costs and energy consumption, and upgrade information technology.
