To improve the poor temperature stability of the original system, real-time monitoring is carried out by changing the solution of variable-knot fuzzy PID technology.

articleTitle: Topology and start strategy for DC-DC transformer based on voltage balancing circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As a core equipment to interface between the high voltage DC-bus and low voltage DC-bus in the DC distribution network, DC solid state transformers (DCSST) use input-series output-parallel (ISOP) to achieve high voltage small current input and small voltage high current output. Due to the electrical stress limitation of the switching device, the number of power circuit in the traditional DCSST-ISOP structure is large, which will increase the number of high-frequency transformers and the volume of DCSST, and reduce the power density of DCSST. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a new type of DCSST topology, which can effectively reduce the number and volume of DCSST power circuit and increase its power density by stringing the voltage balancing circuit into the LLC resonant converter. Working principle, parameter design method and soft start strategy are analyzed in this article. Simulation and experimental results verify the effectiveness and correctness of the topology structure, parameter design method and startup strategy presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Trigger Control Strategy of Voltage Reinjection Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: By utilizing voltage reinjection conversion technology, a converter based on high-voltage DC transmission can be shut down under zero voltage conditions, which offers more advantages than traditional PWM (pulse width modulation) in terms of efficiency, capacity and harmonics, and has broad range of applications. The reinjection circuit's cascaded H-bridge capacitor voltage imbalance is the major problem that affects the reliability of the MLVR (multi-level voltage reinjection) configuration, so the control strategy of improving the triggering method is proposed to achieve the capacitor voltage balance, thus optimizing the converter. In this paper, a simulation model of the voltage reinjection converter is established based on the traditional twelve-pulse converter. As a result of the simulation result, it has been shown that the proposed trigger method control strategy is correct. This is because it is able to effectively solve the voltage imbalance problem of the reinjected bridge capacitor voltage.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Planar Electromagnetic Lens Array Modeling for Fast Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Planar electromagnetic (EM) lenses are thin devices usually comprising sub-wavelength unit cell elements that synthesize a certain phase delay profile to focus the energy at a specific distance from the lens focal length. The design of these planar EM lenses unit cell elements is usually performed by means of full-EM simulation and optimization software. However, the full-EM simulation of the whole planar EM lens for its performance verification has an extremely large computational complexity, as well as it requires a very long simulation time. A mathematical model which describes the behavior of a planar EM lens array based on the characteristics of the EM lens unit cell elements is described in this paper. After that, this model is employed to benchmark the performance of a planar EM lens array based on a reconfigurable transmit array unit cell element, verifying the ability of the lens to reconfigure the focus characteristics to better deal with different incident angles ranges.

articleTitle: Prediction search on the threat of darknet based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The anonymity and untraceability of the darknet provide fertile ground for the development of illegal trade and terrorism. In recent years, the number of darknet websites dominated by Tor and I2P has been increasing sharply. There have been many vulnerabilities that have happened on the darknet causing a generalized impact on the real world, which is attracting increasing concern from all sides. In order to monitor the traffic of darknet and find out whether the vulnerabilities discussed on the darknet may lead to serious consequences in the real world, we propose a method to predict the threat of the darknet based on machine learning. Firstly, the project builds a crawler system, using the privoxy service to set up agents and using Tor service to connect to the darknet. Then, with firefox’s headless browser, we recursively access the contents of the darknet webpage. The project crawls the HTML of webpage and searches for important contents in HTML through python’s selenium library. The crawled data and returned header information are stored in the database. As a pack of software, kibana can perform full-text searches of data stored in the elasticsearch database. In addition, based on react framework, web visualization of database data is realized by using echarts, grommet, grid-layout and other control groups. Line charts, pie charts and lists are used to display the total amount of data, extra daily data and other information. Finally, the project washes HTML data to obtain corpus. The word vector and Lda model are combined to realize web page classification. The labeled data set, containing vulnerability exploitation, is modeled by various methods, including Bayesian, random forest, SVM and other common methods. With the performance of the model evaluated, SVM can achieve 93% accuracy rate on 80% of the test sets. On this basis, the time node when the vulnerability may be used in the open network is predicted.

articleTitle: The Algorithm Based on Supervised Time Series Segmentation of Researching Dynamic Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The Algorithm use the changes of pixels in the time domain in image sequences and the correlation between adjacent frames, find the corresponding relationship between the previous frame and the current frame to collect samples, ensure that the whole gesture can be collected without too many redundant frames. Use two-way propagation search mechanism, shortest length constraint l<inf>min</inf> and maximum length constraint l<inf>max</inf> are introduced to reduce the search space. By calculating an estimate ei of a point, determinate of segmentation points for sequence segmentation quantitatively, then calculate the joint probability of each characteristic distribution under each state, category matching based on maximum probability. The experiment uses a large number of samples to train the model and compares it with other algorithms, it shows that the algorithm has achieved good results in dynamic gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Research on the star algorithm for safe path planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The conventional A star algorithm is one of the most effective direct search methods to solve the shortest path in the static map. However, to keep the path as short as possible, the best path it seeks tends to be close to obstacles, which has defects for some medical and service robots that need to keep a safe distance from obstacles. In this paper, based on the conventional A star algorithm, the computational form of its heuristic function is adjusted so that the search efficiency is improved by nearly 80%. Meanwhile, the obstacles are extended during calculation so that they are kept in line with the obstacles. Experiments show that the mentioned method can improve computational efficiency while ensuring that the generated path and obstacles are within the safe range. The results of this paper may be conducive to the application of the algorithm in practical situations.

articleTitle: Critical Variable Guided Mutation for Directed Greybox Fuzzing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Directed greybox fuzzing directs fuzzers to specified code areas and has gained great achievements in 1-day vulnerability detection. However, existing directed graybox fuzzers fail to generate the crash sample even if they found a testcase reaching the target site. There are mainly two questions that affect the effectiveness of directed greybox fuzzing: basic block-level target is coarse enough for 1-day vulnerability detection and the fuzzers follow a specific rule to select operators regardless of the vulnerability itself. This paper points out that only a few vulnerability-related variables are related to the vulnerability triggering. Based on the vulnerability-related variables, this paper proposes critical variable guided mutation, a mutation scheduling method to enhance the crash reproduction capability of directed greybox fuzzing. We implemented a prototype MDGF based on the critical variable guided mutation and evaluate it on real world programs. Evaluation of MDGF on various real-world programs showed that MDGF found vulnerabilities faster than the mainstream directed greybox fuzzers. The experimental results showed that the speed of MDGF is 6.18 times faster than that of AFLGo and 1.40 times faster than Beacon, and MDGF can find 1.71x more bugs than AFLGo.

articleTitle: Study on Opening and Closing Valve for Sector Based on Air Traffic Controller Workload
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on the SIR model, the dynamic equations of attention resources and control workload are established. The stability of the equation at the equilibrium point is proved by Lyapunov stability theorem. Based on this algorithm, the opening and closing valve for sector operation is designed. Sector opening and closing valve can provide decision support for team resource management and sector opening and closing decision. Simulation shows that, the evolution rules of attention resources and residual workload of controllers are verified. The sector opening and closing valve can provide sector opening warning for large flow and capacity environment and predict the future workload of controllers.

articleTitle: Service Dynamic Mapping Algorithm for Industry Chain Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The industrial chain knowledge graph is an industrial chain analysis method based on knowledge graph technology, which can present knowledge, entities, and relationships in a structured way in a specific field. Through the industrial chain knowledge graph, the various links in the industrial chain can be clearly understood, thus enabling the quick discovery of relevant entities and relationships in the user's desired field. Service mapping is crucial for service organization, discovery, and management. However, there are currently many problems with service mapping, as services in various fields on the Internet exist in a chaotic manner, making it difficult for users to quickly discover relevant service information in their desired field. Currently, methods for organizing and managing services based on the industrial chain knowledge graph are not widely available. To improve the efficiency and accuracy of service mapping, this article proposes a dynamic service mapping algorithm based on the industrial chain knowledge graph. This method organizes and manages services in various fields through the industrial chain knowledge graph, and calculates the similarity between feature words based on the word2vec model, combined with the TF-IDF inverse document frequency to comprehensively calculate the similarity between industrial chain segments and services. When the similarity is greater than a specified threshold, the segment and the service are automatically mapped. The results show that this method can greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of service mapping, thereby greatly improving the efficiency of service organization and discovery.

articleTitle: Prediction of B-cell epitopes using diverse class-conditional data selection policies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The rapid and accurate localisation of B cell epitopes on antigenic proteins is a major challenge. However, for diverse class-conditional data, the combination of multiple machine learning algorithms and single algorithm methods seems to have little effect because they have not considered long-tailed distributions of the data. We propose the prediction of continuous B-cell epitopes based on diverse class-conditional data selection policies. The method can generate a set of classifiers with complementary predictive capabilities. In the method, at a certain step, the binary classification is transformed into the four-class classification problem based on the original binary classifier and the training sample set. In our experiments, SVM and partial RNN with a single hidden layer were used to classify the epitope and non-epitope peptides. Four classifiers were trained for six window sizes such as 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 and obtained similar performance under our selection policy. In the other experiment, the maximum performance achieved by our method is 92.88%, while the other classifiers varied from 57.24% to 68.87%. The results suggest that a group of classifiers where adjacent classifiers have complementary predictive capabilities can improve epitope prediction. In particular, our selection policy of complementary classifiers could not only predict B cell epitopes, but also solve the whole classification problem.

articleTitle: Realization of hierarchical early warning management system for cigarette manufacturing department
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to monitor the production process of the cigarette manufacturing department more intelligently, this paper designs a hierarchical early warning management system, which integrates the huge process quality data generated by a variety of key equipment on a platform, realizes the comprehensive integration and real-time processing of the equipment status and product process quality information, and establishes a flexible and widely applicable early warning rule setting platform. A workflow capable of closed-loop processing of alarm events is established, and the alarm data is analyzed and the alarm causes are traced through multi-dimensional statistics, curve analysis, monitoring video playback and other methods. It is convenient for managers to conduct accurate and in-depth analysis of the data they care about most, so as to take appropriate strategies and actions.

articleTitle: SRv6-based Differentiated Service Framework for IP Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of 5G new services, the IP network layer needs to provide the service layer with deterministic carrying and forwarding capabilities characterized by differentiation and quality assurance. To effectively manage and utilize differentiated forwarding resources at the IP network layer, an open framework for IP network differentiated services based on SRv6 is proposed. The framework combines SRv6 BSID to abstract the end-to-end network forwarding path. A unified service resource pool with differentiated characteristics has been formed, and the service layer can schedule differentiated services on demand. We set up a typical operator backbone network environment in the laboratory, and verified that switching differentiated service resources on demand can make the video services own a better forwarding path. This framework can reduce the coupling between the service layer and the network layer, and provides differentiated services with guaranteed network quality through overlay and underlay collaboration.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Electrical Automation Control Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper designs an electrical automation control system based on artificial intelligence technology. In this paper, the chaotic algorithm is used to obtain the real-time operating parameters of electrical equipment, and then it is compared with the database data. If the comparison results are inconsistent, start the digital expert experience processing method and give feedback to the console. The research results of this paper improve the control effect of the electrical automation system and make the controlled equipment run in an efficient and optimal working state.

articleTitle: Research on Single Bottleneck Optimization Based on Intelligent Manufacturing Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: More and more manufacturing companies are adopting a multi-variety, low-volume production model, and there are bottlenecks in the workshop due to the different demands on machine capacity for different products. The presence of the bottleneck in the workshop will severely limit the daily output of the workshop, reducing productivity and profits. In this paper, an improved Jaya algorithm based on problem characteristics is proposed to solve the single bottleneck optimization problem within intelligent manufacturing mode. Firstly, under the single bottleneck of intelligent manufacturing mode, the flexible factor of the manufacturing machine is considered, which effectively solves the problem of machine load distribution in the workshop. Secondly, based on the basic JAYA algorithm, a two-layer encoding mechanism and decoding mechanism based on problem characteristics are proposed, as well as the improvement of the similarity method. Finally, the effectiveness of the improved algorithm in this problem is demonstrated by comparing it with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Disaster Identification Algorithm System of Key Technologies of Computer Urban Pipe Network Safety Monitoring and Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper studies the online monitoring and accident warning system design of pipe network. Intelligent online liquid level monitoring and warning system is a digital monitoring platform for urban drainage based on the Internet of Things technology. It has the functions of permanent data storage, online fast query and statistical analysis, dynamic alarm management and so on. The system will organically integrate the 3D visualization scene, pipeline model and monitoring results with the Super Map software system. Establish an intuitive and effective three-dimensional visualization scene of urban underground pipe network. The system can dynamically display and interactive query visual model information in real time. By setting thresholds for water quality monitoring indicators, the system can automatically identify abnormal monitoring indicators and push abnormal information to monitoring personnel to achieve monitoring and early warning. The system provides an intuitive and interactive information visualization management platform and monitoring and warning platform for the urban underground pipe network water quality monitoring.

articleTitle: A Design of Angular Acceleration Evaluation Algorithm Based on FAL-RLSN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Angular acceleration evaluation is a common problem in the field of mechanical engineering. According to the characteristics of the Fal function, this paper designs a filter based on the Fal function to evaluate the angular acceleration at the input end of the system. At the same time, in order to eliminate the signal delay, the RLSN prediction compensation is designed. Experiments show that the angular acceleration evaluation method based on Fal-RLSN can obtain relatively accurate angular acceleration signals, and can effectively eliminate the phase delay.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Web Service Classification Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, web services have played an increasingly important role in the software industry in recent years, and the increasing number of web services has brought about problems such as increased difficulty in obtaining labels. Therefore, finding a technique that can automatically match and recommend the most accurate labels quickly and accurately based on the service descriptions published by service providers has become a hot issue in the field of service computing. The current web service classification methods mainly focus on the main labels of web services, and there is no good method to classify web services with multiple labels. In this paper for the problem of multi-label classification of web services, we propose a multi-label classification model BCLAS for web services based on label embedding and attention. The BCLAS model uses BERT to generate word vector sequences of service descriptions and labels, and uses stacking networks of CNN and Bi-LSTM to extract semantic features in service descriptions, after which the obtained semantic features and labels are jointly learned in the embedding space, the learned attention is weighted to the final web service description text sequence and label representation, the feature vector representation of the optimized text, the labels are also learned to different text feature representations, and finally the classifier classifies web services using the weighted label embedding representation.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of pile machine based on improved artificial bee colony and K-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of pile machinery fault diagnosis, a fault diagnosis algorithm based on improved artificial bee colony and K-means clustering(IABC-K) is proposed. Firstly, the normalization method is used to preprocess the original fault data; Secondly, the artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm is used to optimize the K-means clustering, which is affected by the initial clustering center, and cluster the characteristic parameters; Finally, the clustering and diagnosis results are analyzed. The results show that this method can effectively identify the fault type of pile driver and improve the efficiency of fault diagnosis of pile machinery.

articleTitle: Overload state estimation of embedded devices based on improved particle swarm optimization and big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Accurate estimation of the overload state of embedded equipment can improve the stability of embedded equipment. Because of the complicated structure of embedded equipment, the voltage and current load borne by each part can't form a single stable feature, but it will change greatly. The traditional estimation method only updates and superimposes the load data characteristics of a single circuit in real time, but does not fully consider the interaction between load parameters and the identifiable periodicity in the characteristic changes, so the calculation results are inaccurate. Man-machine interaction of embedded upper computer is carried out through CAN field bus, and a NOR Flash is added to LPC2292 monitoring controller to realize system reset. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is introduced to filter out abnormal big data, find the optimal solution, and avoid the influence of redundant data. Then, the normal data volume of high-voltage cable channel is calculated, and the design of high-voltage cable channel big data monitoring system is completed. According to the experimental results, the monitoring accuracy of this system is 0.96 at the lowest and 0.98 at the highest, and it has accurate monitoring results.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimal Design of Closing Buffer System of the High Voltage Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the proposed dual carbon target, vacuum circuit breakers have attracted much attention due to their pollution-free and maintenance-free properties. Currently, vacuum circuit breakers are being developed for high voltage and high current. As the breaking capacity increases, so does the volume of contacts, and the vacuum circuit breaker faces the more severe problem of closing bounce. To address this issue, an electromagnetic repulsive buffer structure was proposed in this paper, which can reduce the closing speed of the moving contact and the bouncing time. First, several factors affecting the closing bounce were analyzed theoretically and through simulations. It is shown that the bouncing time can be greatly reduced by reducing the closing speed and the mass of the moving contact. In this way, an electromagnetic repulsive buffer structure was designed. Through simulations, it was found to be effective in reducing the bouncing time. Finally, simulations were performed to explore the effect of different capacitance C<inf>0</inf>, capacitive pre-charge voltage U<inf>0</inf> and buffer stroke l<inf>0</inf> on the buffer effect. Optimized buffer mechanism parameters were obtained, and the bouncing time can be reduced to 0 ms.

articleTitle: Test and Research on Calibration of Power Generation Operating Parameters of No.4 Generator of a Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of power grid, the load dispatching and distribution principle of unit in power plant is carried out according to the instructions of dispatching center. In order to fully guarantee the scientificalness and rationality of load distribution of units by dispatching, according to the requirements of relevant technical standards, the calibration test of power generation operation parameters of units is carried out, and the result serves as the technical basis for dispatching of units after grid-connected operation. At the same time, if the operating parameters of the unit need to be revised due to the change of operating conditions during operation, the parameters should also be calibrated by test.

articleTitle: A WPT System Applied to Space Solar Arrays MPPT/Constant Voltage Mode Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The conductive slip ring is generally used for energy and information transmission between the solar array of a space vehicle and the main body of the vehicle. Since the solar array needs to be oriented to the sun to ensure maximum irradiation, the slide of the conductive slip ring is continuously in a relative rotation, and this contact rotation will lead to wear of the conductive slip ring and negatively impact the steadiness of the power supply system. The utilization of magnetic resonance wireless power transfer technology for energy transfer in this scenario has a good application prospect and has attracted wide attention. In order to realize the WPT system to switch smoothly between MPPT mode and constant voltage output mode of the solar array, a control strategy that is based on a competitive meritocracy of modes is suggested. Firstly, according to the application scenario of space solar array, the WPT power topology architecture is designed, and the relationship between the output power of Boost circuit and control variable D and the output power of LCC-S compensated WPT circuit and control variable θ is analyzed respectively; Then design a smooth switching strategy between MPPT/constant voltage output modes based on the relationship between output power and control variables. In conclusion, a physical simulation model is developed in SIMULINK to simulate and validate the proposed control strategy, with the results demonstrating its feasibility and capability to achieve adaptive and smooth mode switching.

articleTitle: Music chord sequence recognition method based on audio feature extraction algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the continuous development of music information retrieval, the traditional music retrieval method based on keywords is more and more limited in the application of massive song search on the Internet. Therefore, more and more researchers begin to turn to the research of content-based music retrieval technology. Chord is a typical middle-level feature in music information. It can fully express all the attributes of music. Chord recognition is the basis of automatic music annotation. It plays a very important role in the fields of computer music accompaniment, massive search of cover songs, audio signal segmentation and matching and so on. In this paper, the key technologies of content-based music retrieval are deeply studied: Piano single note recognition method, music chord feature representation method and recognition algorithm are proposed. The characteristic of PCP with higher frequency and its calculation method are used, and the specific calculation formula is given. When using the features of this paper for recognition, the recognition rate of the methods proposed in this paper is higher than that of the current recognition methods.

articleTitle: Application of 5G+AI technology in agricultural administrative law enforcement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation, existing problems and demands of China's agricultural administrative law enforcement, studies the application scenarios of 5G such as high speed, low delay and massive connection, describes the performance indicators and technical characteristics of 5G, and proposes an agricultural law enforcement application platform based on 5G+AI technology in combination with the development status and technical characteristics of AI. With the help of key technologies such as 5G high-speed network and AI video detection and identification, the platform has the capabilities of intelligent perception, real-time monitoring, analysis, research and judgment, and early warning of law enforcement risks, comprehensively improving the efficiency of agricultural law enforcement.

articleTitle: Research on Terminal Access System of Power Equipment Based on Plug and Play Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presents a data acquisition software system design method which can realize plug and play for power equipment sensing. Based on a novel interface broadcast plug and play protocol (HPLC) proposed in this paper, the system can realize data acquisition of the sensor equipment connected to the system without configuration and additional operation. The system automatically generates dynamic adaptation to realize automatic adaptation with the sensor, and then realizes the "plug and play" of the sensor. Finally, the pluggability of the status module is verified by the rod arm estimation experiment of the guide receiver. The system verifies the plug and play capability of sensor and filter through seamless switching experiment of integrated navigation system. Simulation results show that the proposed modular information fusion method not only supports the plug and play of sensors, but also reduces the difficulty and improves the efficiency of navigation system development.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in the Simulation System of Physical Fitness Parameters of Sprinters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Quantitative analysis and evaluation of the change process of athlete’s performance ability in spring training practice is the main way for coaches to understand the training effect, revise the training plan, and scientifically control the training process. In this paper, a simulation system of physical fitness parameters of sprinters is proposed based on the innovation of computer virtual reality technology. The system includes perception interaction subsystem and model calculation subsystem. The perception and interaction subsystem produces and constructs a three-dimensional training scene through the virtual environment, and then renders the picture in the three-dimensional scene through the view module in the model calculation subsystem. The model is established based on the improvement of Banister’s motion adaptation model, and the limited growth parameter of the adaptation is added. The parameter estimation results showed that the fit of the model to the data was 0.882±0.068. The response curve of the model to the analog input signal conforms to the theoretical assumptions. The similarity of the distance correlation between the predicted value of the model and the measured value of the physical state of sprinters is 0.914±0.079. The new model can be adapted for short-term prediction of fitness status.

articleTitle: Research on aspect-level sentiment analysis of tourism review text based on joint learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current aspect level sentiment analysis model is weak in generalization ability and word perception, a multi-task joint learning model GL-IJM for target word emotional polarity discrimination and target word extraction is proposed, which can learn the relationship between specific aspects and context in the training process, and can be used to capture the information closely related to specific aspects in the context sequence, so as to increase the modeling of specific aspects, compared with the BERT-based method. The F1 values of ATE tasks on camera and mobile phone datasets increased by 0.2 and 0.4 percentage points, respectively, and the F1 values of SPC tasks increased by 0.61 and 0.04 percentage points, respectively.

articleTitle: IP Service Core Network Architecture and Service Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the vigorous development of new services, differentiated carrying requirements such as deterministic high throughput, deterministic delay, and deterministic jitter are proposed for IP carrying network. At the same time, owing to the dumb pipe characteristics of traditional IP networks, the price scissors between operators' traffic and revenue become more and more obvious. Hence, it is urgent for operators to develop differentiated carrying capacity of IP networks, reconstruct the network value chain, and achieve sustainable and healthy development of IP networks. Firstly, the concept and architecture of IP service core network are introduced, which can be smoothly evolved based on the existing network. Then the private network services are proposed under this architecture, to verify the private network services based on the IP service core network. The results show that the conceives of the IP service core network own high technical feasibility, clear advantages in service differentiation carrying, and great potential in business value.

Author Keywords: build or dismantle as your wish

articleTitle: Research on sea target detection method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology has made rapid development in recent years, in which the deep learning field has shown strong applicability. In the field of national defense, the war mode has also changed from mechanized combat mode to intelligent combat mode. YOLOv5 network based on target classification and regression is widely used in the field of target detection. This paper proposes a ship detection method based on YOLOv5x video image. We use photographic data annotation and self-made data sets to obtain training data based on video images, and combine them with YOLOv5s model. We use the transfer learning method to train the model and modify the weight parameters. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of the algorithm can reach 95% for the target class ships and ships in the video images.

articleTitle: Application and research of interpretable real-time software defect detection method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper proposes an ex ante interpretable real-time software defect prediction method based on formal functions. The method mainly consists of three parts, metric definition, defect prediction modeling and interpretability analysis. The interpretability analysis includes the reduction of polynomial functions and the ordering of importance of metric elements. In order to verify the interpretability and accuracy of the instant defect prediction method proposed in this paper, the experimental results show that the interpretable instant software defect detection method proposed in this paper has good feasibility and application value.

articleTitle: Research on Expert System Technology of Biomass Detection in Fermentation Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The fermentation process refers to the reaction process in which specialized metabolites are produced and accumulated in large quantities through the growth, culture and chemical changes of microorganisms (or animal and plant cells). The biomass parameters play a key role, and they cannot be detected online. Measurement technology offers a solution. Expert system technology can solve the problems of complicated fermentation process classification and numerous mechanism models in the process of biomass soft sensing modeling. This paper presents the structure of an expert system for biomass detection in fermentation process. This expert system provides a new technical method for the division of soft-sensing hybrid models.

articleTitle: Research on electroplating power supply based on three-phase interleaved parallel LLC resonant converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, a three-phase interleaved parallel LLC resonant converter topology is used to design a electroplating power supply suitable for chromium and other precious metals, which can meet the performance requirements of high frequency, high power, low voltage and high current, and soft switching technology to reduce losses. This paper will introduce the topology principle, control circuit principle and specific circuit parameters of the electroplating power supply in detail. Finally, the simulation verifies that the electroplating power supply meets the requirements of electroplating power supply with high frequency, low voltage and large current pulse output of chromium metal.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Intelligent Scanning and Shooting Technology under Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, there are errors in the shooting accuracy of drones, which cannot meet the requirements of real and high resolution. Based on this research background, the article proposes a registration method of sequence images and ground laser point clouds based on artificial intelligence computer technology. The article first corrects the distortion of the UAV image in the local area to eliminate the error of the image point, so as to obtain the distortion parameters. Secondly, perform relative orientation and spatial interpolation on the image to build a dense point cloud of the image. The study found that the algorithm improves the production efficiency and automation of 3D laser point cloud and digital image registration.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Control of Dynamic Surface Synovial Membrane Based on Adaptive Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper mainly studies an adaptive FNN with uncertain delay and unstable nonlinear feedback system. A new type of sliding model control system is established by using nonlinear disturbance observer and RBF neural network. The parameter estimation method is used to replace the artificial neuron weights to speed up the solution of the algorithm. Time-varying disturbances are estimated using a nonlinear disturbance observer. In order to prevent the "differential explosion" produced by derivation of virtual control law, it is estimated by filtering method. A simulation study is carried out on the low maneuverability of large maneuvering aircraft. Experiments prove that the designed controller has excellent performance and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Improvement of semantic segmentation algorithm based on ResNeSt network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved semantic segmentation algorithm based on the split attention network resnest. The original icnet semantic segmentation model has some defects in the segmentation of foreground objects. In view of these problems, we optimized the icnet model with resnest network and CBAM convolution attention module. On the one hand, we replace the backbone network in the original model with resnest network, which enhances the feature extraction capability of the model. On the other hand, we introduce the CBAM convolution attention module to improve the segmentation ability of the model to the target in the foreground region. Without affecting the inference rate of the original model, the training effect of the improved idea proposed in this paper on the cityscapes open data set is improved separately from 71.0% to 71.3% and 71.9%. Respectively compared with the MIoU of the baseline model, the MIoU of the icnet model combined with the resnest backbone network and the CBAM convolution attention module on the cityscapes open data set is increased from 71.0% to 72.1%, and the segmentation effect of the foreground area target is significantly optimized in the visualization images, which has certain positive significance for the application of the semantic segmentation algorithm in the field of unmanned driving.

articleTitle: Treatment of OOV Words in Neural Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, the cross-language information retrieval technology is growing. In neural machine translation (NMT) system, there are always OOV (Out-of-Vocabulary) words which have never appeared in the training set and it has a direct impact on the performance of translation system. This paper proposes data generalization method to deal with the OOV problem to improve the performance of the system and the result shows that the approach can solve the OOV problem to some extent and improve the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Modeling Analysis and Recognition System in Architectural CAD Engineering Drawing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In mechanical design, this paper uses CAD interface for 3D modeling to generate 3D solids. This paper clarifies the intelligent standard view generation technology in 3D CAD software and its intelligent technologies such as axonometric drawing, internal structure, auxiliary view, intelligent annotation, parametric design and assembly design, showing its powerful application function. According to the principle of shape design in 3D conception, this paper discusses the teaching mode of combining composition theory with 3D CAD application, and using 3D CAD system to cultivate students' abstract thinking, image thinking and innovative thinking.

articleTitle: Improved adaptive image enhancement algorithm based on SSA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: When taking images under low illumination conditions, the obtained images are usually affected by low visibility. The low visibility and low brightness image not only affect the visual effect, but also causes many difficulties for subsequent use. In this paper, an improved adaptive image enhancement algorithm based on SSA is proposed, first adjusts the parameter value of the normalized incomplete beta function to fit four types of typical grayscale transformation function curves, then use the intelligent optimization algorithm with strong optimization ability and fast convergence speed, namely sparrow search algorithm, to dynamically determine the best transformation parameters α and β, thus quickly realize adaptive image enhancement. The algorithm is highly adaptive and the convergence speed is accelerated by the sparrow search algorithm. Additionally, the image gray coverage is wide and the enhancement quality evaluation is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of fuzzy PID DC motor control system based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In view of the traditional PID DC motor speed control in the actual use of the process of the parameters of the regulation method is more complex, and can not achieve self-adaptation, in order to further tap the application potential of brushless DC motor, by studying its structure and working principle, a fuzzy PID DC motor control system based on STM32F407 is designed. By analyzing the speed control system of the PID DC motor, the speed of the DC motor can be adaptive controlled and displayed, the PWM control signal can be generated by the STM32 controller, and the speed can be measured by the Houle signal, combined with PID control algorithm to improve the robustness and adaptive ability of the control system, this design makes the system run more stable and improves the ability of anti-jamming.

articleTitle: Wear reliability analysis of pantograph systems based on an optimized radial basis function neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The wear reliability analysis model of pantograph systems is built based on a radial basis function neural network in this paper, complicated and strong nonlinear wear characteristics of pantograph systems are obtained, and the wear variational laws with external parameters are analyzed. By Comparing the optimized radial basis function neural network performance in relative errors and learning speed with BP neural network and ordinary radial basis function neural network, the optimized radial basis function neural network has strong ability of nonlinear mapping and functional approach, and obtains high prediction accuracy. The study provides a simple and feasible method for wear characteristic analysis and wear reliability design of pantograph systems in electric railroad.

articleTitle: A Temporal Convolutional Knowledge Tracing Model Integrating Forgetting Factors and Item Response Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As the current mainstream model in the field of knowledge tracking, the deep knowledge tracking model based on RNN has insufficient interpretability, long sequence dependence, gradient disappearance and gradient explosion. Aiming at the above problems, a Temporal Convolutional Knowledge Tracing Model Integrating Forgetting Factors and Item Response Theory(TCKT-FI) was proposed. Firstly, TCN is used to extract the students’ knowledge states. Then the exercise embedding vector is obtained, and the relevant weight vector is obtained through calculation. Next combined with the forgetting factors summarized in pedagogy, the knowledge state is forgotten. Finally, the difficulty of the exercises and the students' ability are obtained by using the embedding vector of the exercises and the mastery of the knowledge points, and the probability of the correct answer to the next question is predicted based on the above factors. Comparing the TCKT-FI model with the DKVMN model, CKT model and SAKT model, the results show that the accuracy rate (ACC) and area under the curve (AUC) of the prediction results are significantly improved, and the best effect is increased by about 14 percentage points, and The calculation speed has been improved by 3-6 times.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Patent IPC Classification Based on ERNIE Model and Deep Pyramid Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For the purpose of automatic classification of patent documents, a Chinese patent IPC classification method based on Enhanced Representation through Knowledge Integration(ERNIE) model and Deep Pyramid Convolutional Neural Networks (DPCNN) proposed. The ERNIE model is used to obtain a more fully semantic distributed text representation; Then the deep convolution neural network is introduced to further extract the coding features of the context to obtain a deeper level of text feature expression; Finally, we use the classifier to achieve chinese text classification. The experiment on the public data set of the State Intellectual Property Office shows that the accuracy of this model is improved by 5.53% compared with the traditional classification model based on Bdirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BERT). It shows that the text classification method based on ERNIE model can effectively improve the performance of Chinese text classification, and can provide reference for automatic classification of patent documents.

articleTitle: Intelligent Warning System of Transformer Based on Fault Recording
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, transformers in Guizhou power grid lacks of assessment and operation and maintenance support means, especially those in substations below 220kV. Due to the lack of recording data of substations below 220kV, it is difficult to perform intelligent analysis and status assessment of circuit breakers in substations below 220kV. Therefore, in order to better control and evaluate transformer operation status in Guizhou power grid, it is necessary to establish an intelligent early warning analysis tool for transformer based on fault recording in Guizhou power grid, strengthen the status assessment technology research and improve transformer operation monitoring capability of Guizhou power grid. This paper introduces a transformer assessment method based on fault recording data. The cumulative effect of the transformer can be evaluated by scoring method to predict the damage degree of the transformer in time and provide a basis for the equipment condition overhaul.

articleTitle: Experimental teaching platform of artificial intelligence of robotic arm based on voice control and visual assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper develops a robot arm artificial intelligence experimental teaching platform based on voice control and vision assistance, the whole system consists of robot arm body, control system, image processing system and voice interaction system. The system adopts ST NUCLEO-H743ZI embedded development board as the main control board, equipped with bus servo and Ov7725 camera, and adopts robot positive and negative kinematics algorithm to complete the operation of servo joint control, grasping and rotation of the robotic arm; meanwhile, the Raspberry Pi 4B type development board is selected to train in TensorFlow, PaddlePaddle framework data set to achieve image recognition, intelligent sorting, mobile tracking clamping, intelligent palletizing and other functions, and by combining voice recognition and synthesis module to achieve voice control of the robotic arm. In addition, students can operate the robotic arm functions on the APP easily and conveniently, which can effectively mobilize students' learning enthusiasm, cultivate their deep thinking ability, stimulate innovative thinking and improve teaching quality.

articleTitle: Design of control system of electric proportional valve for new logistics transfer equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The operation process of logistics transfer equipment is required to be efficient and green, so as to reduce the energy consumption of logistics transfer operations. The control of proportional valve operation of vacuum generator is the key. This paper designs a proportional valve control system, which uses PID algorithm to control the pressure and on-off time of electric proportional valve through the controller. Compared with the traditional control algorithm, the precision of pressure control is improved by 8.7%, which effectively realizes the efficient and green operation of the logistics transfer system.

articleTitle: Bearings only passive location for UAV in formation flight
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to ensure the UAV cluster to perform formation flight, bearings only passive location method can be used to adjust the position of UAV. This paper analyzes the different formation conditions of UAVs, gives the bearings only passive location method in unmanned formation flight, and the corresponding position adjustment strategy, and uses the idea of target separation to split the target into two sub targets to avoid the need for more UAVs to send signals when adjusting the UAV position. Because UAVs do not always fly at the same altitude in formation, and the initial position information cannot be known. Therefore, according to the characteristics of the model and the relationship between the edges and corners of adjacent UAVs, this paper constructs a greedy criterion based on the minimum number of UAVs required to transmit signals, and gives a position adjustment scheme for UAVs.

articleTitle: Dynamic Adjustment Algorithm of Cloud Computing Virtual Cluster under Fragment Interference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The task scheduling algorithm of cloud computing virtual machine topology is studied. First, a new virtual machine model and task model should be proposed, and the establishment of this model must be based on the virtual topology, and then a virtual machine-task fitness evaluation function FEF should be established. When scheduling resources, we should coordinate the relationship between the topological distance between virtual machines and the processing performance of virtual machines. When resources are assigned to the corresponding tasks, the fitness value between the target virtual machine and the task is accurately calculated by using FEF function, and the virtual machine with the highest evaluation value is selected by the calculated result. The experimental results show that this method can effectively reduce the total time to complete the task set, thus ensuring the scheduling performance. Quantify the resource fragments formed by different resource scheduling strategies in the cloud computing environment, and re-divide them quantitatively, so that they can regroup into a whole block of resources to maximize the reception of subsequent tasks. Using membrane computing and bat algorithm, according to the optimization requirements of resource allocation in cloud computing under the interference of debris resources, resources are reasonably allocated on the basis of ensuring the time requirement, and the concept of membrane computing is introduced to obtain the final optimal solution. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the resource scheduling ability.

articleTitle: Research on autonomous obstacle avoidance assistance system for surface unmanned vehicle based on intelligent vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The intelligent vision based unmanned surface vehicle intelligence constructed in this article. Its obstacle avoidance system mainly consists of three parts, namely enhancing visual perception, autonomous recognition of obstacles and targets, and autonomous obstacle avoidance for unmanned boats. The project first performs denoising, defogging, and low illumination enhancement on the obtained video images. Then, the YOLOv4 object detection network in its system is used to identify obstacles in enhanced video images. In addition, the project utilizes computer technology to obtain the occlusion angle of obstacles in the image. Then, the system uses millimeter wave radar to measure the distance of obstacles based on its data, achieving the fusion of visual information and radar information. Therefore, based on the VFH obstacle avoidance algorithm, the intelligent obstacle avoidance of unmanned boats was achieved through the above steps.

articleTitle: Vehicle precise control system based on active disturbance rejection control under multi-source disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the control problem of driverless vehicle under multi-source disturbance, a vehicle precise control strategy based on ADRC (Active Disturbance Rejection Control) is proposed. Firstly, a nonlinear time-varying dynamic model of unmanned vehicle is established. Then, the dual channel controller based on ADRC is designed. In the simulation experiments, the given step signal is input to verify that the ADRC can track the desired signal in the presence of multi-source disturbance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of COVID-19 Database Management System Based on Java and MySQL Database
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper introduces how the Java application with graphical user interface is connected to MySQL database. This paper designs and realizes the operations of adding, modifying, deleting and querying the data in MySQL database.

articleTitle: Improving CNN Cardiac MRI Segmentation by Transformer and Direction Feature
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As the development of medical image processing, automatic cardiac magnetic resonance images segmentation has been one of the most important issues. However, the unclear boundaries and inhomogeneous intensity in MRI images usually cause indistinction for pixels from different class around boundaries, limiting accuracy of the segmentation result. In this paper, Transformer which is common in natural language processing is introduced into UNet, which is common in medical image segmentation to capture global information; meanwhile, direction feature is used enhance comparison for inter-classes pixels for better performance near the boundaries. The network can be divided into segmentation module and direction feature module: self-attention mechanism is used to replace the convolution module in building blocks for long-range dependence; result of segmentation module is taken as input of direction feature module, which utilize direction vector from pixel to its nearest boundary pixel to improve segmentation accuracy nearby boundaries. Performance of the network is evaluated and got satisfied result.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Home Appliance Control System under IoT Artificial Intelligence Technology in 5G Era
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The application of Internet of Things technology in the 5G era integrates the intelligent management model into people's lives. This paper innovatively proposes to use Mini2440 microcontroller and LAN communication to realize the remote monitoring of home smart devices. The system realizes functions such as home fire alarm, intelligent temperature display and control, RFID access control, infrared detection automatic door opening and closing, and home equipment control. The system uses the ESP8266 WiFi module as a wireless communication module to realize data communication between hardware and software, and writes an APP based on the Android platform to realize the intelligent management of the home by the user terminal. The test results show that the system basically completes the design requirements and has a certain room for functional expansion.

articleTitle: Research on Graphic Processing System of Visual Communication Design Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the computer image visual communication system is designed and the function of this system is analyzed. Then, based on the hardware design, this paper re-confirms the position, proportion and Angle information of 3D human body. Machine learning algorithm is introduced to integrate visual experience data with user data. This completes the filling of visual experience data. Finally, the texture information to be rendered is transformed into rendered texture by texture mapping method. Complete 3D animation rendering based on the difference between input points pixels. Finally, the design of computer graphics visual communication system is tested. The test shows that this system has powerful drawing function and can be used in many occasions.

articleTitle: The Study on NLP-based Semantic Analysis Technology to Improve the Accuracy of English Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the semantic analysis technology based on NLP(natural language processing) is proposed to optimize the English translation model in order to improve the efficiency of the error correction and accuracy of English machine translation by building the NLP corpus, constructing semantic feature analysis model of English translation text error correction. A grammar error detection model is used as a discriminator, in addition, N-gram information and NLP corpus information is added into the corpus model parameters in English machine translation: first, use the sequence label error detection model to mark the characters with problems in sentences; Second, use the end-to-end model to correct only the wrong characters to reduce the reasoning time; then, the semantic features are added to Transformer's attention calculation through NLP's semantic analysis method to improve the error correction efficiency of the model. According to the sentence error category, the pre-training sentence pairs of the specified error category are generated, and the masked characters in sentences of different languages are predicted through auto-regressive decoding; Besides, the large-scale sentences are corrected into corresponding correct sentences in the case of unknown languages, thereafter reaching the aim of realizing semantic analysis technology based on NLP to improve the accuracy of English translation. The test results show that this method has good error correction ability by reducing the error rate, thus improves the accuracy of English machine translation.

articleTitle: Style-constrained Takagi-Sugeno-Kang Fuzzy Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Due to the excellent interpretability and classification performance, the Takagi-Sugeno-Kang fuzzy classifier (TSK-FC) has drawn great attention. However, different patterns own their respective homogeneities, and the samples from different groups present explicitly or implicitly homogenous styles, which are significantly different from the assumption that all samples from different groups are identically and independently distributed (i.i.d.). In this paper, a style-constrained Takagi-Sugeno-Kang fuzzy classifier called SC-TSK-FC is proposed by breaking the i.i.d. assumption. To explore the styles of data, a series of style matrices are embedded into the objective function of the TSK-FC. Besides, with the introduction of the regularization term corresponding to each style matrix, the nuances between different styles of data can be captured, which can help improve the classification performance of SC-TSK-FC. Particularly, five fixed fuzzy partitions with interpretable linguistic terms are adopted to along each input feature, and SC-TSK-FC outperforms TSKFC by using less fuzzy rules. These guarantee the interpretability of SC-TSK-FC. Experimental results on some benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed SC-TSK-FC.

articleTitle: Research on Trustworthiness Analysis Technology of Artificial Intelligence Software
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to solve the trustworthiness risk problems of artificial intelligence software such as algorithm model security, data security and privacy risk, infrastructure security and other types of trustworthiness risks, we investigate the trustworthiness mechanism and defect patterns of artificial intelligence software and proposes a comprehensive analysis method of artificial intelligence software trustworthiness based on SFMEA and SFTA, which realizes a comprehensive analysis of artificial intelligence software trustworthiness. Through example analysis, this method can effectively improve the quality level of artificial intelligence software.

articleTitle: IoT-based ice room temperature and level monitoring and classification system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The cold rooms for the storage of chicken meat for human consumption are controlled systems to maintain the cold to guarantee the product's quality and take care of food safety. This article presents a system for monitoring and classifying the temperature of a cold room and the level of ice generation to keep the cold room in the right conditions. Through IoT, an application for mobile devices is developed that allows the remote visualization of cold room data. This system uses an ESP32 board, two sensors, a DHT 22 sensor for temperature control, and an ultrasonic sensor for ice level control. Communication is accomplished through the ThingSpeak platform. Based on the data obtained and the experience of the professionals, a classifier for the support vector machine is designed to determine the normal and abnormal state of the plant's operation. The results indicate the correct functioning of the proposal and the performance of the classifier of 84%. Using these IoT tools facilitates meat production processes, maintaining product quality and warning of possible failures in the cold room.

articleTitle: Feature screening for high dimensional data with response and covariates missing at random
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Feature screening has been proved to be effective and fashionable method for analyzing high-dimensional data. It is a challenge in identifying important feature for the high-dimensional data when both response and covariates are missing at random. In this paper, we consider a feature screening procedure based on distance correlation between the marginal distribution of the covariate and the marginal distribution of the response for missing data, where the marginal distribution of missing variable is estimated by inverse probability weighting method. We also propose a computationally very efficient algorithm based on proposed screening procedure. The results of some numerical experiments show that the proposed method and algorithm have a better performance for linear model even if both response and covariates missing at random, and also work well for nonlinear model.

Author Keywords: Response and covariates missing at random

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Data Analysis in Agricultural Products E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper designs a cloud platform for agricultural products e-commerce information service based on big data, relying on the Internet of Things, big data, cloud computing and other technologies. The data acquisition layer mainly uses IoT perception to collect data. The system completes data conversion, processing, and analysis in the big data center, and realizes the application through the visual display of the application layer. The development system uses ASP.Net technology and uses C# as the programming language. This article uses Silverer database as the background database to build an agricultural product e-commerce platform. The research shows that this paper applies big data technology to the field of agricultural product information service to realize real-time sharing of agricultural product big data. The system is conducive to the effective and full utilization of agricultural product data resources.

articleTitle: Human resource recommendation algorithm based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Among various kinds of image recognition, the Chinese character recognition has a very wide range of application prospect and practical value, for example, can be used in sorting, license plate recognition, billboard recognition, identity CARDS, auxiliary blind people read scene, can realize automatic recognition, reduce artificial operation, save time and manpower cost, convenient people's life. Deep learning mainly builds a neural network model with multiple hidden layers. In this paper, a large number of training samples are used to learn more useful features, so as to improve the prediction and classification accuracy of the network model. As an important network model of deep learning, convolutional neural network has the characteristics of hierarchical structure, weight sharing, regional local perception, feature extraction and global training combined with classification process, etc., and has been widely applied in the field of image recognition. In particular, deep convolutional neural network is currently a research hotspot. It is of great application value to study its own and its application in the identification of different samples.

articleTitle: Research on Conductive Model of Composite Conductive Fiber Based on Transmission Line Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on the uniform transmission line theory, a transmission line model is established in this paper. Using this model, the conductive model of composite conductive fiber is studied. The conductivity of composite fiber is closely related to the types of added conductors, the weight percentage of added conductors, the distribution of conductive components in the fiber cross section, the contact state and other factors. The composite conductive fiber conduction model based on transmission line model can only guarantee the causality of the model, but not the passivity of the model. Transmission line model method is based on Huygens principle. By establishing the equivalent relationship between the electric field and magnetic field in Maxwell equations and the voltage and current in transmission line equations, a method to simulate the electromagnetic field response in time step. This method is simple and practical, with clear physical concepts, and can effectively solve all kinds of dynamic circuits, especially high-order circuits, with unconditional numerical stability. The results show that the transmission line model and its analysis method proposed in this paper can effectively evaluate the performance of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research progress of part point cloud detection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As the demand for 3D vision technology in industry continues to rise, 3D point cloud part classification based on deep learning has received widespread attention. Classification methods based on 3D point cloud data outperform traditional 2D image classification in terms of inspection accuracy, and are advantageous in detecting parts with similar and poorly differentiated part shapes and parts with uncertainty in the type and extent of damage areas. The aim of this paper is to introduce some of the mainstream part inspection methods based on 3D point cloud data. Firstly, the advantages and background of 3D point clouds in industrial applications and the characteristics of their acquisition methods are introduced; secondly, the classification methods based on 3D point clouds of parts by classical and deep learning algorithms and the related industrial applications are introduced; the common datasets for 3D point cloud classification are summarised; Finally, the development trends and potential research directions of deep learning in the direction of part point cloud detection are foreseen.

articleTitle: Design of Computer Intelligent Scoring System for English Translation Based on Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The existing scoring methods have many shortcomings, such as long calculation time and significant differences from manual scoring results. A machine correction system based on Markov model is proposed to address the problems in English translation correction, in order to reduce manual correction work during the correction process and improve correction efficiency. A hierarchical structure system consisting of modules such as translation data collection, information feature extraction, analysis model construction, and evaluation result feedback has been established for the English translation evaluation system; A language model for evaluating English translations has been proposed, and this model is used to calculate the specific sentence order and word count that appear in the translation. Statistics were conducted on English translation data, and statistical analysis was conducted on the translation data. Intelligent scoring of English translations. Experiments have shown that the difference between the intelligent scoring system and manual scoring is only 0.1 points.

articleTitle: Research on Impedance Control of Two Robot Cooperative System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A comprehensive and detailed study on the key problems of industrial dual robot cooperation system was carried out. Firstly, so as to increase the speed of system response, the mathematical model of the cooperation system was established according to the peer-to-peer architecture. On this basis, the control structure diagram of the system in three different situations was designed. Then, the derivation process of impedance control algorithm was analyzed in detail, including the discretization of impedance control and the analysis of system stability conditions. According to the position impedance control method, the realtime force on-line adjustment was added to form the contact surface force control method of adaptive impedance control. Finally, a simulation platform was built to verify the coordinated control of the location and contact force of the two robots. The simulation outcomes indicate that the system can follow the quintic polynomial curve well by using the position impedance control algorithm designed. The response curve of the system output force can track the target value well because of the addition of the error adjustment term of the real-time force in self-adaption impedance control. Thus, the practical validity of the suggested impedance control method of position/contact force coordination control were verified.

articleTitle: Hydrodynamic shape simulation optimization of an underwater vehicle equipped with ocean observation devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A structural scheme of an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) that can carry multiple unmanned ocean observation devices is proposed to enhance the multi-environment working capability of the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) and improve the information acquisition capability. The scheme was numerically simulated for the hydrodynamics of the initial shape and the most suitable hydrodynamic shape was selected. At the same time, based on an adaptive multi-objective optimization algorithm, a solution has been proposed to reduce the drag and turbulence generation in the operation process, and the shape geometry parameters were developed with the goal of reducing turbulence and drag, and a solution was produced. The optimized profile has an average drag reduction of 16.67% and an average turbulence reduction of 65.15% compared to the pre-optimized profile, which enhances the hydrodynamic performance of the profile.

articleTitle: Research on an integrated index prediction model based on RF-XGBOOST-ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
