abstract: At present, the performance of each machine learning algorithm is different in the exponential prediction research, and they work independently without fusion, and cannot complement each other, resulting in low accuracy, generalization and stability of each machine learning algorithm. This paper aims to find a better prediction algorithm by comparison. In this paper, by constructing a prediction method based on Random Forest-XGBOOST-Artificial Neural Network and integrated learning based on BAGGING, MSE, R<sup>2</sup> and MAPE are used as test indicators. The conclusions are as follows: The RF-XGBOOST-ANN integrated algorithm has great advantages over single machine learning, with small error and accurate prediction. It stands out among many integrated prediction models and has broad application prospects. In this paper, the ensemble algorithm is used to improve the prediction accuracy. The prediction results are more accurate. The machine learning algorithms are effectively integrated, and the prediction performance is significantly improved.

articleTitle: The overall architecture design of English listening and speaking autonomous learning software based on feature matching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Autonomous Learning of College English Viewing, listening and speaking refers to a learning method in which computer network technology cooperates with learners' visual, auditory, language and other sensory systems. The autonomous learning mode in the online environment enables students to directly access English learning information and practical operations. In order to ensure that students' autonomous learning is effective, teachers should supervise and guide students' autonomous learning. The "English Listening and Speaking" self-learning system can effectively solve the problem of modern college students being able to learn English listening and speaking at any time and place. On this basis, this project will implement a "feature matching" system framework for autonomous English listening and speaking learning, with the goal of achieving English listening, speaking, reading, and writing. This system overcomes the shortcomings of existing similar software, expands the functions of existing software, and improves the user experience.

articleTitle: Multiple ensemble learning methods for Mandarin multisyllabic pronunciation assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The automatic pronunciation assessment technology based on artificial intelligence can well help language learners understand their pronunciation level and give timely feedback. The main reasons for the lack of relevant datasets and the immaturity of multisyllabic pronunciation assessment techniques are that there are few studies on the assessment of Mandarin multisyllabic pronunciation. In order to solve the above problems, this paper establishes a phoneme- level Mandarin multi-syllable assessment annotated dataset, designs various acoustic models with different network structures, and combines ensemble Learning algorithms to conduct a multifaceted pronunciation assessment comparison experiment on the self-built Mandarin multi-syllable assessment dataset. The experimental results show that the performance of the model with ensemble Learning algorithms is significantly improved compared with the traditional regression model.

articleTitle: Consortium Blockchain Efficient Storage Access Control Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The consortium blockchain platform Hyperledger Fabric provides a channel mechanism to isolate and protect the data, but the nodes inside the channel access the chain data at will and the centralization of management make the consortium blockchain face security problems such as data leakage, confusion of node access rights, and inability to update access rights. In order to solve the above problems in the consortium blockchain, an efficient storage access control scheme for the consortium blockchain applicable to Hyperledger Fabric is designed. The scheme is studied from several aspects of access control, attribute update, access policy update, key distribution and efficient and secure storage of data, using a combination of data chain and attribute set chain through the channel mechanism provided by Fabric, using database to store update records to achieve access policy update, using Fabric-CA component to achieve node attribute private key generation and distribution, proposing IPFS chunking and negotiation mechanism to reduce the I/O performance consumption of nodes. Experiments and security analysis show that the proposed scheme is efficient and secure.

articleTitle: Suppression method of MT interference noise based on marginal spectrum and blind source separation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As magnetotelluric exploration has two inherent disadvantages of "weak surface observation signal" and "random excitation of field source", it is extremely susceptible to various kinds of interference noises which have serious effects on data processing and inversion interpretation in the later stage. Therefore, it is urgent to suppress the interference noise in MT signal. In this paper, blind source separation is performed for suppression of magnetotelluric interference noise. Firstly, the magnetotelluric data with interference noise is transformed by HHT, and then the marginal spectrum is used to determine the number of source signals in order to do blind source separation. Then the IMF components by EMD processing and the original signals are combined into a signal group to conduct independent component analysis. At last, a dynamic factor processing is used in order to avoid the amplitude displacement in the extracted signal. After the processing of the simulation signal and actual magnetotelluric signal, compared with wavelet de-noising method, it is found that the method proposed by this paper can suppress the magnetotelluric interference noise more effectively.

articleTitle: Research on ship route control based on LOS navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The intelligent navigation system of watercraft at home and abroad is still quite difficult. Most of the research is still focused on realizing intelligent navigation with basic functions and autonomous navigation function levels, while the related research on advanced autonomous navigation functions is based on numerical simulation and small Model ship. In the parameter adjustment of this paper, because obstacles and moving targets are used as reference objects, it has good tolerance and anti-risk ability, and can maintain the autonomous running function of different ship types under the condition of fine-tuning parameters. At the same time, the designed system is suitable for the motion control of large sea-going ships. According to the advantages of the algorithm, it can make up for the poor maneuverability of large ships and improve the precise navigation ability.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Landscape Design Based on Data Fusion and Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper innovatively proposes a city landscape virtual simulation system with virtual reality technology and SketchUp technology as the core. Based on the 3D geographic information system software development platform VRMap3.0, the system imports the CAD drawing files of architectural landscape plans into SketchUp software for lightweight modeling and converts 2D graphics into 3D models. The experimental results show that the SketchUp modeling software has good compatibility with the renderer of the data fusion computer virtual technology. The accuracy rate of processing 3D point cloud data is as high as 99%. The system is a landscape planning system with high satisfaction. The material rendering of the system is realistic, and the shadows of ambient light illumination vary significantly. Virtual reality technology has low learning and working costs and shortens the design cycle. The system has certain practical significance for urban landscape design.

articleTitle: A method for intelligent segmentation and acknowledge of musical notes based on artificial brilliance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the era of big data with explosive growth of data, how to efficiently classify, retrieve and manage massive music has become a difficult problem. The traditional manual labeling method is far from meeting the needs. Therefore, content-based music element analysis has become a research hotspot. Content-based music analysis is an vital branch in the field of computer music brilliance processing, in which the segmentation and acknowledge of musical notes is one of the key technologies. The segmentation process of the traditional music note segmentation acknowledge method is relatively complicated, and the acknowledge accuracy is not high. In the music retrieval system through the user's humming input, the segmentation and identification of musical notes is one of the key issues. Content-based music analysis is an vital branch in the field of computer music brilliance processing, in which the segmentation and acknowledge of musical notes is one of the key technologies. The method adopted in this paper is artificial brilliance, which can enhance human decision-making ability in certain fields, and even replace human decision-making in some aspects. Artificial brilliance is influencing the social and political preferences of audience groups, and subtly influencing and manipulating the behavior patterns of audiences.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation of Energy Storage in Distribution Network Adapted to Large-Scale Distributed Photovoltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of large-scale distributed photovoltaic systems, this paper establishes a network-based robust optimal planning method. Taking the maximum access capacity of the solar power generation system as the research object. Then this paper analyzes the influence of factors such as reserve capacity, conventional unit ramp rate, network transmission and other factors on the power grid under two different power generation modes: grid side and distributed generation side. Secondly, this paper uses the robust optimal algorithm to analyze the uncertainty of the distributed power variation, and obtains the optimal access location and the optimal installed capacity of a node. Simulation experiments show that due to the addition of dispersed energy, the output power distribution of the solar cell is more stable. It reduces the impact on the power system due to the instability of the photovoltaic system.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Electronic Evidence Trusted Deposits and Traceability Application System for Safety Production in Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For power grid enterprises in the development of power engineering infrastructure, line equipment operation and inspection and other production and management activities, often due to evidence collection is not timely, lack of effective evidence and other reasons lead to the inability to prove, weak defense of rights, to the legitimate rights and interests of power grid enterprises caused losses. In this context, this paper carries out the technical research on the whole life cycle management scheme of electronic evidence for power grid enterprises' safety production, designs the architecture of electronic evidence credible storage and traceability application service system, and realizes the whole life cycle credible management of electronic evidence from collection, curing, transmission, sealing to checking and identification. Enhance the credibility of electronic evidence, access to evidence from the traditional "after the fact evidence" to "before the evidence" mode change, and promote the company's safety production management level.

articleTitle: Study of Different Working Conditions Influence on the Performance of Attitude Control Device in Stratospheric Airship
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the attitude control device is designed according to the attitude control requirements of the stratospheric airship, which is arranged vertically by two unidirectional control devices. The influence of different working conditions on attitude control requirements was studied, and the performance of attitude control device and unidirectional control device are compared through the method of numerical simulation analysis. The results show that the attitude control device control efficiency is high under the thrust in both directions. The results show that the increase of power is greater than that of thrust under the thrust different directions, making the control efficiency is lower than that of unidirectional control device.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Robot Path Planning Based on Fuzzy Artificial Potential Field Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Route planning is a hot issue in mobile robot research. Artificial potential field (APF) method is a classical method to figure out mobile route planning problem. However, the traditional APF method has the disadvantages of being unable to reach and gradually moving away from the target and wandering in situ and falling into local optimum. Therefore, an improved APF method combining fuzzy control with APF method is proposed. Through the design of two double input single output fuzzy controllers, the heading angle and speed are adjusted in real time to help the robot conquers the defects of the traditional APF method in some special cases, reach the target more smoothly and safely, and achieve effective route planning. Simulation Experiment of Robot Route planning in Matlab. The Simulation result indicates that the fuzzy improved APF method can figure out the problem of unreachable target and local optimum, and also shows advantages in obstacle avoidance safety.

articleTitle: Timing Verification and Optimization Method of Spacecraft Signal Processing Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the wide application of large-scale complex integrated circuits in spacecraft signal processing circuits, some faults such as timing competition and timing coordination metastable state have been found in the application of new integrated circuits in signal processing circuits, which affect the reliable application of complex integrated circuits in spacecraft. By analyzing the timing faults of integrated circuits found in the application process, combined with the application scenarios of digital integrated circuits in spacecraft signal processing circuits, this paper deeply explores the mechanism and causes, puts forward targeted solutions to timing faults and application circuit optimization methods, and effectively verifies the circuit optimization methods. It can effectively guide the design of complex integrated circuits and its application in spacecraft, and has strong practicability.

articleTitle: Optimization of Optical Detection System for Partial Discharge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The optical detection efficiency for partial discharge depends on the performance of optical system. As an important component of optical detection system, light guide plays an important role in photon collection and transmission. Improving its photon collection efficiency is of great significance for the sensitivity of partial discharge optical detection. In this paper, the average irradiance of the light receiving surface and the field of view are used as its performance evaluation index. Firstly, the photon transmission path inside the light guide is calculated according to the optical parameters of the light guide material, and the optimization method for the geometric structure of the light guide is clarified. The Monte Carlo simulation method is used to calculate the average irradiance of the light receiving surface, and the light loss and field of view of the light guide with different geometric shapes are compared and analyzed. The results show that the geometry of wedge type or double wedge type is more conducive to the low loss transmission of optical signals compared with the traditional cylinder. The average irradiance values are increased, and the field of view are expanded, which reduces the blind area of detection system and improves the sensitivity of the photodetector indirectly. This study has guiding significance for the geometric design and parameter optimization of partial discharge optical signal coupling devices.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning and Obstacle Avoidance Behavior of Manipulator Based on Q-learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Trajectory deviation exists in the movement and obstacle avoidance of mechanical arm, which should be corrected based on appropriate control algorithm to ensure that the actual trajectory is close to the ideal trajectory. The trajectory planning and obstacle avoidance schemes based on the improved Q-learning algorithm were proposed, and the state vector set and the action set in each state were constructed respectively. BP neural network algorithm was used to improve the continuous approximation ability of the model, and Q function values were constantly updated during iteration. In path planning, according to the principle of minimum joint rotation Angle and minimum space travel distance of connecting rod, the trajectory deviation can be minimized while reasonable obstacle avoidance. The simulation results show that the proposed control algorithm has fast convergence speed, better path planning effect than the traditional planning scheme, and the lowest migration cost.

articleTitle: Java card competitive product analysis method and device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This article explains the methods and devices of Java Card competitive product analysis from many aspects, such as function, performance, reliability. This article also proposes specific means to optimize the Java card competitive product analysis process, including garbage collection and transaction protection, to increase the technical depth and efficiency of Java Card competitive product analysis. Through the methods and devices, the competitive product capability can be evaluated more comprehensively and deeply to guide the improvement methods.

articleTitle: Economic dispatching model of virtual power plant and carbon emission under carbon trading mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Virtual power plants can aggregate the distributed energy on the power generation side to improve the consumption degree of renewable energy. Given the unpredictability of renewable energy generation and the lack of cost competitiveness, virtual power plants often abandon wind and light in the process of operation. The economic benefits of a virtual power plant scheduling model under the carbon trading mechanism and electricity consumption behavior is established, so that renewable energy can participate in the carbon trading, and promote coordination between the user side and the power generation side. According to the bilayer, nonlinear and semi-continuity, a reconstruction method that integrated linear approximation, KKT condition and perspective transformation theory is transformed into a single-layer integer second-order cone model. The example shows that promoting the consumption of renewable energy can help improve the emission reduction benefits of virtual power plants. At the same time, the carbon trading mechanism has the ability to improve the total consumption of renewable energy, the response of users has the ability to improve the distribution of wind energy utilization, and the use of appropriate electricity price mechanism can further play the synergistic benefits between the two.

articleTitle: Research on the recognition and localization of Momordica grosvenori based on binocular vision and a convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, all the components of picking robots are becoming highly developed. The work efficiency of robots is greatly affected by the design of its visual positioning system, particularly the target detection rate, fruit picking accuracy, and environmental adaptability of the picking target. This paper is based on vs2017 and OpenCV3.4. A Momordica grosvenori segmentation recognition method, based on the K-means clustering algorithm is applied, and a Momordica grosvenori recognition and location algorithm, based on a combination of a deep convolution neural network and binocular vision, is proposed. The binocular camera is calibrated using OpenCV and MATLAB1. Blurred images or those with excessive errors are removed, and the calibration error is controlled within 0.15%. The results show that the maximum error is less than 1.36mm, and the positioning effect is good, proving that the system has satisfactory accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: An Improved Wavelet Denoising Method Based on Acoustic Echo Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Acoustic echo detection is a method of echo analysis using active acoustic signal. There are a lot of same frequency noises in the echo, the acoustic imaging quality is poor, and the detection effect is greatly affected. The traditional noise reduction methods have some problems, such as poor suppression effect of same frequency noise and so on. In this paper, the characteristics of signal and noise are studied by using the collected target echo information and analyzing the echo of target position. The improved threshold wavelet denoising method is proposed, and the segmented threshold denoising is carried out according to the signal-to-noise ratio. After echo denoising, the full matrix imaging based on Hilbert transform is applied to target detection and analysis, and the imaging effect is obvious. The experimental results show that the improved wavelet denoising method greatly improves the echo signal-to-noise ratio and the relative identification of target position.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Manufacturing Flexible Production Line System Based on Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This study is about design of intelligent production line based on industrial robot. The system uses Mitsubishi programmable controller and Siemens RFID data transmission as the core to construct ring conveying unit system, linear conveying unit system, workpiece assembly mode and four-station feeding system. The production line is also equipped with automatic feeding system composed of rotary feeding mechanism and taking mechanism and automatic fixture changing system. A visual system is installed above the feeding table. When changing processed products, the robot can quickly process different products with only limited adjustments. The virtual simulation of Visual One software verifies the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: HSVAugRegNet: Random Augmentation to Rotate Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Ship detection technology has always played an important role in operations such as maritime traffic management, ship protection and identification of noncompliant ships. When conducting water surveillance, ship target detection is carried out not only to ensure ship safety but also to supervise non-compliant ships. Due to the current improvements in physical imaging technology and developments in the field of machine vision, it is now possible to use deep learning methods to train neural networks for ship inspection. In all types of ship inspection tasks, ship targets are variable in direction and vary greatly in scale, and the detection accuracy is not high if the generic traditional horizontal frame detection method is made to work. Therefore, this paper proposes the HSVAugRegNet based on the framework of RegNet, which deepens the network depth based on RegNet and also adds data enhancement means HSV random perturbation to change the image brightness and improve the network generalization ability. After conducting experiments on the well-known dataset HRSC2016, it was found that compared to the original method, the results obtained by HSVAugRegNet improved 3.41% of the map, satisfying the need to improve recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-loop Feedback Analysis of Distributed Power Inverters in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As a new type of energy storage device and control system, microgrid can solve the problem of traditional energy sources due to limited resources and high development costs. It changes the relationship between the participants in the power system by controlling the inverter output so as to achieve a balanced energy exchange and distribution of the whole power system. The access to non-linear loads leads to an increase in the harmonic content of the inverter output current, which seriously affects the quality of the output current of the parallel inverter and also the operational efficiency of the inverter. The aim of this paper is therefore to design a correct and effective control strategy to enable the parallel system to operate stably. The author focuses on the circulating impedance of the inverter parallel connection, based on which a multi-loop feedback analysis of the parallel inverter for distributed power supplies in microgrids is carried out to improve the operational efficiency of the parallel inverter system in terms of suppressing the circulating current size and reducing the harmonic content of the inverter output current.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-robot Pursuit Control Based on Distributed Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The coordinated control of multi-robot systems is a hot research topic in robot control in recent years. This paper mainly focuses on the coordinated control of multi-robot pursuit and evasion task, and analyzes the motion strategy of both sides in the obstacle environment. Firstly, a task allocation model based on distribution is established. Secondly, the pilot-following method is used to determine the formation pursuit strategy of the pursuit robots, and the moving target points of the pursuit robots are solved in the barrier-free environment based on differential games. Finally, the obstacle avoidance angle is analyzed and calculated according to the sensor information, and the real-time motion strategy of each robot is obtained by combining the fuzzy logic algorithm. The simulation results show that the distributed intelligent fusion algorithm can complete the pursuit task in real time efficiently, and the pursuit robot can maintain a certain formation during the pursuit process. The research results are not only applicable to the problem of multi-robot pursuit, but also have certain reference significance for the analysis of pursuit tasks in UAV and military field.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Virus Infection Detection Mechanism Based on Brute-Force Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Most people get sick because they are infected with a virus. When a patient goes to the hospital for treatment, how can the doctor effectively and accurately detect whether the patient is infected with the corresponding virus is something that both the doctor and the patient are looking forward to. Pattern matching is widely used in practical applications, such as network intrusion detection, computer virus signature matching, DNA sequence matching and so on. The detection of virus infection can be realized by using pattern matching to compare the DNA of virus and the DNA of patient. Famous pattern matching algorithms include BF algorithm and KMP algorithm. BF algorithm is the simplest, most intuitive and easy to implement, and in the case of small string cost performance is also very small. Therefore, this paper selects BF algorithm to realize the virus infection detection mechanism. This paper first introduces the basic concept of pattern matching, the core idea of BF algorithm, algorithm thinking, algorithm steps, algorithm flow chart and algorithm description. Then the basic principle and realization of virus infection detection mechanism are described. Finally, an experimental test was carried out on VC++6.0 platform. The test results show that the proposed virus infection detection mechanism can effectively and accurately detect whether people are infected with the virus.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Route Optimization Method Based on Dijkstra Algorithm and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: When there is a massive blackout on the grid, reasonable and scientific selection of power supply restoration path can save huge economic losses, and produce positive social significance. In order to improve the overall recovery efficiency of power grid and ensure the safe and stable start-up of power grid, a power supply route optimization method based on Dijkstra algorithm and genetic algorithm was proposed. Based on Dijkstra algorithm, considering that the maximum path sharing can reduce the total transmission distance, the shortest path model of power supply network was constructed. At the same time, considering the operation time of each plant station to be restored, the comprehensive weight of the power supply path was taken as the target, and the genetic algorithm was used to search the optimal path. The model was verified by the power system of a certain province. The results showed that the model can obtain the shortest path generation from the black start power supply to some specific power supply targets, which reflected the effectiveness of the method.

Author Keywords: power supply path of the power system restore

articleTitle: Six Transformations and Their Relationships in Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: An important content in the course of digital signal processing is the analysis of the time domain and frequency domain transformation of the system, which involves several important transformations, including the Fourier transform (FT) of continuous non-periodic signals, Fourier Series for Continuous Periodic Signals (FS), Discrete Time Fourier Transform (DTFT), Z Transform (ZT) of Discrete Signals, Fourier Series (DFS) of Discrete Periodic Signals, and Fast Fourier Transform (FFT),. The definitions and relationships of these transformations often confuse beginners. In response to this problem, this paper narrates the definitions of the six major transformations, and expounds the relationship of various transformations.

articleTitle: Algorithm design and application research of English picture recognition intelligent system based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of technology and the advancement of educational concepts, the country has put forward new requirements for the training model in the context of the era of artificial intelligence. The advancement of science and technology has made big data and artificial intelligence the focus of exploration and research of the times. Among them, the deep learning network in the field of artificial intelligence can solve many complex pattern recognition problems by simulating the human brain, but there are still shortcomings. Most existing deep networks have complex structures, involve a large number of hyperparameters, and suffer from extremely time-consuming training processes. This research introduces the basic knowledge of augmented reality technology and artificial intelligence into the English teaching system, and explores the deep integration of science education and artificial intelligence based on augmented reality technology. A wide learning system model based on convolutional neural network is proposed. First, the image is extracted through the convolutional layer and the pooling layer of the convolutional neural network to obtain the extracted features. In order to extract the features more accurately, the Adam algorithm is used to iteratively update the parameters of the convolutional layer and the pooling layer for a certain number of times. Then, the extracted image features are input into the width learning system, and feature nodes and enhancement nodes are established. Using the SqueezeNet design principle and the SVD algorithm to compress the proposed network as a whole, a lightweight network is finally obtained.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Hydraulic Pump Based on ICEEMDAN Sample Entropy and LLTSA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the nonlinear characteristics of hydraulic pump vibration signals and low diagnosis accuracy in fault diagnosis, a feature extraction method based on ICEEMDAN sample entropy and LLTSA popular learning was proposed.Firstly, multiple intrinsic mode functions are obtained by ICEEMDAN decomposition method for signals of different modes, and the kurtosis index is used for preliminary screening of components. Then, the 6 dimensional feature vector is formed by calculating sample entropy of each component. Secondly, the low dimensional fault features with good clustering are obtained by using LLTSA for further dimensionality reduction of features. The low dimensional features are classified by SSA- SVM method.The experimental results show that the fault diagnosis model can accurately identify all kinds of faults of hydraulic pump, and the advantages of this diagnosis method are verified by comparing with other pretreatment methods.

articleTitle: A Smart Mat for People Identification Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A shoe print is a unique feature of each shoe, and is used in the forensic case to identify the suspect. Many kinds of research showed that it is effective in identifying people with shoe shape and gait features. Although the researches have achieved high accuracy in people identification, immunity to interference was generally poor and the devices they used were high-cost. This paper designed a low-cost hardware system based on a thin-film pressure sensor to collect plantar pressure data. The data were sampled and pre-processed by an MCU with internal ADC peripherals and transmitted to a PC synchronously. Then the data were enhanced and trained by a BP neural network with shoe shape and plantar pressure features combined. By comparing the 3 different pressure data accumulation methods, the system achieved a best accuracy of 89% without noise and 74% with about 10% noise pixels added. The result of the experiment demonstrated the effectiveness of this system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent System of Malformed Document Correction Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The document image captured by the camera may be tilted or deformed, so that the optical character recognition (OCR) software cannot recognize it correctly. In this paper, image segmentation technology is firstly used to detect words and text lines. We then use linear fitting to obtain lower and upper baselines of words. Finally, according to the corrected baseline and vertical displacement distance, the word is rotated and displaced to obtain the corrected image. The experimental simulation shows that the corrected baseline and vertical displacement distance obtained by this method are not affected by the specific text content of the document. In this way, the recognition rate of the corrected image in the optical character recognition stage is greatly improved.

articleTitle: RDRS: Represent Document-level Relation with Sentence-level Relation by Distant Supervision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper aims to study how to use remote monitoring for relation extraction, so as to identify the relationship between entities and provide logical facts. In recent years, document-level relation extraction (DocRE) has attracted much attention. Distant supervision (DS) has been playing an important role in sentence-level relation extraction (RE). Compared with traditional relation extraction methods, DS requires less data. However, the performance of document-level DS is limited by the noise in the long distant text. Previous DS works represent intra-sentential and inter-sentential representations in the same way, and neglect the difference between noise in them. This paper proposes an architecture called RDRS, which represents inter-sentence and intra-sentence relations in different ways, and uses a sentence-level relation model to represent document-level relations. The RDRS contains various modules, in which pairs of entities are separated according to the distribution of their mentions. In addition, this paper also improves the performance of inter-sentence representation by associating intra-sentence representation with inter-sentence representation. The experiments are carried out on Document-level Relation Extraction Dataset (DocRED). Experiments on DocRED show that the method has a significant improvement over the baseline. This model is better than previous models that represent inter-sentence and intra-sentence relations in the same way.

articleTitle: Research on Hydraulic Pump Fault Diagnosis Method Based on SSA-KELM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The stability of hydraulic pumps, as the power source of hydraulic systems, is particularly important. In order to improve the accuracy of hydraulic pump fault diagnosis, a kernel limit learning machine (SSA-KELM) fault diagnosis method based on sparse search algorithm (SSA) was proposed. In this method, the original signal was decomposed into several IMF components by CEEMD, and IMF components with high correlation were selected by the principle of correlation coefficient to complete the signal pretreatment. Secondly, the filtered IMF component was input into the time-frequency index model, and the feature vector was screened and dimensionally reduced through the sensitivity analysis of the time-frequency index to the signal, and the fault identification and classification were input into SSA-KELM. The validation obtained that the recognition accuracy of the method is up to 98%, which is higher than that of the ELM method, verifying that the method has a high recognition effect.

articleTitle: Frequency regulation control method of power grid based on variable coefficient droop consistency algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: We proposes a power grid frequency regulation control method based on variable coefficient droop consistency algorithm to address the issue of frequency degradation caused by new energy grid connection. This method improves the virtual droop control coefficient and load damping coefficient respectively to achieve rapid frequency stability. Frequency stability analysis verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of the control strategy proposed in this article. Simulation experiments show that the control strategy proposed in this article has the ability to quickly restore frequency and strong anti-interference ability under different working conditions.

articleTitle: MLSCH: Multi-layer Semantic Constraints Hashing for Unsupervised Cross-modal Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As one of the mainstream research directions in the field of computer vision, cross-modal hash retrieval has been concerned by researchers. For real world data, unsupervised cross-modal hash retrieval is obviously more important. Aiming at the problem that some current research methods cannot convey the semantic information of high-level representation to hash code, this paper proposes a novel cross-modal hashing method, named Multi-layer Semantic Constraints Hashing for unsupervised cross-modal retrieval (MLSCH), for cross-modal retrieval. The neighbor matrix between intra-modal and inter-modal is used to guide the generation of hash codes, and the neighbor structure is applied to the feature representation of different modes, which reconstructs the cross-modal features containing structural information, and effectively improves the generation quality of hash codes. Extensive experiments show that MLSCH outperforms the current advanced cross-modal hashing methods.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of intelligent control system based on embedded linux
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Linux is an accident in the process of technological development, but it has swept the world in the past 30 years. It was born in the form of "Linux boom" and has become the largest project in the world with the most participation in development. This paper introduces an intelligent control system based on Linux, designs and implements an intelligent mechanical device of a microcontroller based on embedded Linux, describes the implementation process of hardware and software in detail, mainly including embedded Linux hardware circuit design, debugging, U-BOOT migration, Linux kernel migration and cutting, root file system creation, etc., and analyzes the design of each part of the application program. In practice, the communication between the system and PC is smooth. Compared with other systems, this system has the characteristics of simple operation, small size and low cost. The system realizes the human-computer interaction function, and the control function is mainly completed by the LCD screen, which is controlled by pressing keys; The voice command can realize the control function, and the user can select the corresponding function in the system; The main functions of human-computer cooperation include voice, gesture, click, expression and other functions.

articleTitle: Electroencephalography Data Denoising with Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is frequently utilized in investigations including neuroscience, neural engineering, and biomedical engineering, because of its benefits, such as non-invasiveness, high temporal resolution, and relatively low cost, Nevertheless, the raw EEG data are frequently corrupted by physiological artifacts and many noises, such as cardiac artifacts, myogenic artifacts, and ocular artifacts. Artifacts can have a negative impact on an EEG signal and can be reduced or eliminated using existing deep learning-based EEG signal denoising techniques. However, when the acquired EEG data has significant artifacts, they typically experience performance degradation. In order to address this problem, we introduced the 2x3R-CNN and compared it to four deep learning-based methods: fully connected neural network (FCNN), basic convolution network, and deep reinforcement learning (simple CNN), complex convolution network (complex CNN), and recurrent neural network (RNN) to remove muscle and ocular artifacts from EEG signal. The experimental results demonstrate that, on the EEGdenoiseNet dataset, the proposed model outperforms the existing approaches.

articleTitle: Research and application of the detection technology of low voltage photovoltaic grid-connected circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Low-voltage photovoltaic grid-connected circuit breaker is the key equipment for distributed photovoltaic grid-connected power generation system to connect to the power distribution network. Its function and performance determine the normal grid-connected operation of the system and the quality of power supply. Due to the lack of professional detection tools, this paper studies its test technology. This paper analyzes the characteristics and functions of photovoltaic grid-connected circuit breakers and puts forward the test requirements. According to the requirements, the overall design scheme of the detection system is proposed, and the solutions of several key detection technologies are put forward, including: the voltage and current output technology of "same line but different loop" is proposed to achieve the accurate output of the amplitude and phase of the current and voltage in a large range; the residual current equivalence test technology is proposed to realize the high precision and high efficiency detection of residual current; the voltage power source is developed to support the step change of the output amplitude, phase, frequency and harmonics, so as to realize the simulation of the electrical quantity when the islanding effect occurs, and verify the islanding protection function; a closed-loop automatic detection technique is proposed to realize the highly effective automatic test of low-voltage photovoltaic grid-connected circuit breakers.

articleTitle: A memory allocation method for MPU memory protection unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, the Memory Protection Unit (MPU) of Cortex-M series processors needs to align the address with the rule of 2<sup>n</sup> when protecting the memory, but this method will cause memory waste in multi-task memory allocation. Therefore, this paper proposes a method that uses multiple MPU protected regions to concatenate and superimpose to protect a region simultaneously, which effectively reduces the memory waste caused by alignment. The experimental results show that, compared with using a single MPU protected region, using four regions for concatenation and superposition can reduce the memory waste by 63%, and effectively improve the memory utilization.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Mobile Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of wireless multimedia transmission, the article proposes a wireless multimedia transmission system design scheme based on big data analysis. Based on big data technology, the article comprehensively analyses and mines communication information, locates and samples the communication information in transmission, evaluates the health of the sampling information transmission system, introduces a visualization method and builds an intelligent operation auxiliary decision-making model. Use the calculation results to record the threshold and distribution density of big data transmission, and finally compress the redundant big data characteristics according to the calculation method of cyclic segmentation, and store the conventional data and redundant data of massive big data; experimental simulation proves that the proposed method improves the compatibility of massive big data storage, and enhances the accuracy and flexibility of big data storage.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Cheap Biomimetic Collision Detection for Flexible Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to avoid the massive sensor array on collision detection for intelligent flexible structures, a cheap biomimetic collision detection method is proposed here in this paper, which is inspired from spiders. The results show that, The variation mode of attitude angles during the collision section was significantly differed from that during the stable and collision stages, and is recommend for adopting in collision detection in similar scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Extraction Method of Transformer Winding Deformation Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Scanning frequency response is a significant method to detect the deformation of transformer windings. The conventional offline frequency scanning detection method cannot meet the requirement of online detection of winding deformation. Therefore, we propose an online extraction method for weak sweep response signals in strong power frequency signals. The paper reports a novel winding signal extraction scheme based on the "superimposed voltage + filtering + current amplification" (SFC) circuit architecture. Moreover, field tests are carried out on the 110kV transformer winding with the proposed SFC circuit. The results indicate that the method can extract the weak winding deformation signal of ±0.4mV<inf>P-P</inf> and 1kHz-1MHz from the power frequency signal of the transformer. In addition, the proposed method provides a novel solution for the signal extraction of Rogowski coils.

articleTitle: Voltage Stability Evaluation Considering Successive Commutation Failure Risk
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to evaluate the risk of successive commutation failure caused by voltage drop, a deep learning-based method is proposed in this paper. First, the mechanism of successive commutation failures is analyzed and the minimum second voltage drop value of the commutation bus after short-circuit fault is utilized as the index to quantify the severity of line outage contingencies. Then, to quickly evaluate the impact of multi-line outage failures on DC systems, a deep learning-based assessment network is built, of which the output is the minimum second voltage drop value of the commutation bus and inputs are steady-state features related to network structure. Moreover, a bus impedance matrix formation approach based on Woodbury formula is proposed, which is used in the calculation of input features and search index. Finally, simulation results based on a real-life AC/DC power system demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves the risk evaluation efficiency of successive commutation failure.

articleTitle: Study on Quantum Phase Transition of 2-D Quantum System by Tensor Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the deepening of people's understanding of quantum phase transitions, various efficient numerical algorithms have developed rapidly. It is necessary to develop tensor network algorithms to efficiently generate the ground state wave function of quantum many-body system and then calculate the ground state fidelity per site. This mini review article aims to discusses the tensor network algorithm for studying 2-dimensional quantum lattice systems, namely projected entangled pair state, and introduce how to characterize phase transitions in quantum many-body systems from a novel perspective-fidelity. It includes the wave function updating of projected entangled pair state and the tensor network contraction scheme, which can be used to calculate the ground-state fidelity per site of the quantum system, and the phase diagram of the ground-state can be determined without any knowledge of the order of the 2-dimensional quantum system, thus indicating that tensor network algorithms can provide a means to describe quantum phase transitions.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Sentiment Classification Based on BERT-wwm-BiLSTM-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Music reviews help to understand the specific information in the recording, and use this to judge the listening intentions and recommendation plans of different individuals. By analyzing the emotional polarity of comments, it can help users get better personalized recommendation schemes, and the platform can also adjust and optimize the content according to user feedback. Therefore, this study proposes a sentiment classification model based on BERT-wwm-BiLSTM-SVM. The model uses web crawler technology to crawl relevant comments from mainstream music software. The obtained data is cleaned and organized to form a music comment dataset. Firstly, the BERT-wwm model is used to process word vectors on music review data Obtain the characteristics of words and sentences, while avoiding ambiguity caused by word polysemy, then use BiLSTM to capture the context sequence information, and finally the output of BiLSTM is combined with SVM model for sentiment classification, and the accuracy of BERT-wwm-BiLSTM-SVM model is improved compared with BERT, BILSTM, LSTM and other models.

articleTitle: Design of Ethernet Interface for Liquid Level Collection in Conticaster Crystallizer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, Ethernet communication interface which is simple in structure and has good Ethernet communication performance is designed for the intelligent liquid level detector based on industrial Ethernet IEEE802.3 communication protocol, so as to realize the real-time detection of liquid steel level by industrial Ethernet. In view of some technical and functional characteristics of Ethernet and TCP/IP protocol, the conventional and practical single chip microcomputer STM32F103 are used as the core controller, and the ENC28J60 chip are used as the core controller chip. Then presenting an Ethernet interface design and implementation method for liquid level sensor based on the common protocol of industrial Ethernet. The software developed by LabVIEW is used to monitor the liquid level data measured by the liquid level sensor in real time. The experiment results show that the interface is stable, and the real-time data transmission is good, in industrial production it has engineering reference value liquid level monitoring in conticaster crystallizer.

articleTitle: Research on pure azimuth passive positioning of UAV based on optimization model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Pure azimuth passive positioning is a positioning method that uses passive reconnaissance equipment to receive signals so as to determine the location of the target signal source; in order to locate the UAV that passively receives signals, this paper establishes a UAV positioning model based on single-objective optimization and conducts simulation, and finds that the sum of squared errors between the results obtained through the model and the actual results is 0.3335220*10-6; when the UAV position deviates, a UAV position adjustment model based on multi-objective optimization is established and a computer simulation scenario is set up. It is found that if the UAV position under circular formation deviates slightly, only five adjustments are needed to make UAVs reach the specified position.

articleTitle: A data augmentation strategy for scene text recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Synthetic datasets alleviate the shortage of label data in the real world to some extent. But, synthetic datasets still have problems with the complexity of picture backgrounds and text diversity. It is well known that collecting large amounts of real data is a job that requires a lot of human resources and material resources. Therefore, we propose a small batch data augmentation strategy, hoping to improve significant performance by collecting and labeling small batches of real data. We have verified our ideas on a strong baseline. The result shows that the accuracy of the model can be significantly improved by replacing the synthetic dataset with the real dataset, which proved that real datasets could train the model better than synthetic datasets. Then, we use different enhancement strategies to expand the data of small batches of real data sets and explore the performance improvement of the model under the condition of low-resource real data. Finally, we mixed the augmented small batch of real datasets and synthetic datasets to make the model learn the image features of real scenes more elegantly. The results show that the proposed strategy can well fill the gap between synthetic and real datasets and improve the model performance.

articleTitle: Optimizing CNN Using Adaptive Moment Estimation for Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Deep learning technology has been widely used in many applications. Especially in the field of image recognition, where convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated superior performance. However, most existing papers focus on a particular model or algorithm, and lack a complete discussion on the whole process of CNN construction, training and usage. In this paper, the authors introduce a CNN optimized by Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) optimizer from the theoretical level to practical applications. The authors describe its concept, algorithm, model construction, model training, simulation, testing methods, and typical cases. Adam is an extension of the stochastic gradient descent algorithm, which has recently been actively used in the field of deep learning. The dataset contains two classes, aircraft and lake, with 700 photos in each category. The authors built a convolutional neural network model and trained it by using the Adam optimizer. Experimental results demonstrate that the trained network can correctly classify the images.

articleTitle: Improved NSGA-II based process dynamic multi-objective algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The NSGA-II-T algorithm is proposed to solve the scheduling problem with dynamic changes in process data processing in the service Internet, modelling the problem as a dynamic multi-objective optimisation problem. In the event of regular changes in load, the solution in the next environment is predicted by the transformer model and added to the original population; in the event of changes caused by physical factors such as node downtime, the population is added randomly. The algorithm uses different means of adding populations to address the lack of diversity that can occur in static multi-objective algorithms when the environment changes. Experiments conducted on the WorkflowSim platform show that the NSGA-II-T algorithm outperforms other classical algorithms in all performance metrics when the environment changes significantly, demonstrating the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Based on SOM Weather Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Changeable weather leads to random output from Photovoltaic (PV). Therefore, it is difficult to forecast PV power generation accurately by manual forecasting or traditional forecasting methods. We proposed a new method to improve forecast accuracy based on SOM-BP Neural Network. Firstly, we clustered different weather types by Self-Organizing Maps (SOM) to solve the problem of inaccurate PV power forecasting in the conditions of changeable weather. Secondly, Back Propagation (BP) Neural Network was applied to predict PV power generation considering the result of weather clustering from SOM methods. Finally, we relied on the PV power generation data and meteorological data in Qingpu District, Shanghai, trained the overall model and acquired the forecast results. The results showed that the SOM-BP model had the greatest forecast accuracy through the error comparison analysis among different models.

Author Keywords: PV power generation Self-Organizing Maps Clustering

articleTitle: Research on Welding Robot Path Planning Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Nowadays, welding robots are widely used in the automobile manufacturing industry, but the current solder joint path planning mainly depends on the experience of technicians, and an automatic path planning method is urgently needed. The traditional algorithm can not adapt to the complex working environment of welding robot. In the intelligent algorithm, the advantage of genetic algorithm (GA) is that its overall retrieval level is high and the robustness is good. Therefore, in this research, GA is selected for path planning of welding robot. In this research, firstly, the working conditions of the welding robot are established by the grid map method, and then the adaptive level function is created by referring to the needs of its motion smoothing level and route distance, and the weighting factors of the appropriate smoothing level and route distance and the relevant parameters of the GA are found. Finally, MATLAB is used for simulation verification. Through simulation experiments, it can be concluded that the change of different parameters will have a greater impact on the path of welding robot. By adjusting the parameters, the welding robot can find the optimal path in different environments, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Scheme Based on Gradient Compression and Local Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As a deep learning framework for distributed deployment, federated learning allows users to complete model training while retaining the original data, which meets the local data privacy protection needs of each user. Differential privacy, as a classic data desensitization technology, is often used to improve privacy protection. Many studies have applied it to machine learning, but it is accompanied by the problem of model utility. In addition, in the traditional federated learning model training, there are frequent gradient exchanges between the user and the central server, which poses a huge challenge to the communication overhead of the model and affects the training efficiency of the model. In order to solve these problems, we propose a new federated learning scheme, firstly propose a StaComp compression algorithm to compress the gradient parameters before the user uploads them, use the local differential privacy mechanism to add noise to protect the user's local data. Finally, we evaluate our scheme on the MNIST dataset. Experiments show that the scheme of this article is close to the classic FedAvg algorithm in the aspect of model accuracy, and is better than other methods based on differential privacy. At the same time, it significantly reduces the training time, improves the convergence speed of the model, and saves communication costs.

articleTitle: An emotion speech sequence alignment algorithm based on ShapeDTW++
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For aligning non-uniform time series, the traditional DTW algorithm is commonly used. However, in emotional voice conversion, traditional DTW algorithms tend to over-align and have poor local matching for aligning non-uniform parallel emotional speech sequences. This results in the emotional speech alignment data obtained affecting the quality and naturalness of the final emotional conversion. To address this issue, we propose an emotion speech sequence alignment algorithm based on ShapeDTW++. Our new algorithm improves on the DTW algorithm by incorporating shape descriptors from the ShapeDTW algorithm, which is a significant breakthrough in the popular DTW algorithm and can increase local matching. We also add cumulative distance loss weight and relaxation endpoints to reduce over-alignment of emotional speech sequences. Finally, the ShapeDTW++ algorithm provides performance similar to the ShapeDTW algorithm while increasing local matching and reducing over-alignment when aligning emotional speech sequences. This improvement in the objective evaluation of the ShapeDTW++ algorithm for aligning emotional speech sequences compared to traditional DTW algorithms is significant.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Personalized Recommendation Accuracy Based on NLP Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of English machine translation under the deep learning mode, an improved personalized recommendation model for English machine translation based on NLP(natural language processing) semantic analysis is proposed. According to the semantic mapping structure characteristics of the source language words, the NLP semantic analysis model of English machine translation under the deep learning mode is established. The parameters of the training model with large-scale corpus are taken as the initial parameters of the scarce corpus model. The neural network parameters of the deep learning are used to learn multiple English machine translation tasks at the same time, and the meta learning is introduced into machine translation. The NLP semantic learning task of English machine translation is solved by using a small amount of computational gradient iteration. The NLP semantic analysis information is introduced into the translation model to expand the existing corpus resources and improve the personalized recommendation accuracy based on NLP semantic analysis. The test results show that the personalized recommendation learning ability of English machine translation using this method is strong, which can effectively use the contribution of different parameters to the loss function to compare whether the parameters are beneficial to the training process, and improve the efficiency of recommendation and the vocabulary matching ability in translation.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Ability Evaluation of NBA Basketball Players Based on Cloud Model Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: People pay more attention to analyzing the sports problems with mathematical methods. The paper takes the technical statistical data and game performance of NBA basketball players in 2021-2022 season as the research object, selects indexes by literature review, questionnaire and mathematical statistics, and conducts research on the technical ability, tactical awareness, fitness level and game performance of NBA basketball players. Based on statistical mathematics and fuzzy mathematics, the paper introduces the concept of index contribution rate, and constructs comprehensive evaluation model of competitive ability of outstanding basketball players with improved order relation method and cloud model, making both quantifiable indexes and non-quantifiable factors involved in the evaluation process. First of all, it uses improved order relation method to determine index weight, and constructs the index weight evaluation model of basketball players’ comprehensive ability. Secondly, with NBA players’ data as sample data, it realizes the conversion between qualitative concept and quantitative concept based on cloud model algorithm, uses Matlab to conduct simulation analysis to derive the order relation weight table, compares and analyzes the evaluation cloud chart and standard cloud chart based on cloud model, and analyzes the weight and influence of each index in the players’ comprehensive ability evaluation to determine the preferred index. Finally, the author verifies the indexes selected by mathematical method and the indexes of 503 basketball players published on the NBA official website in 2022-2023 season, proving that it is effective and can achieve the unity of subjective and objective. This demonstrates that the basketball players’ comprehensive ability evaluation system built in this paper is reasonable and has reference significance for basketball players and coaches. Compared with other weight evaluation models, the comprehensive ability index system established by the evaluation method provides a systematic method for quantitative analysis and comprehensive evaluation of basketball players’ competitive ability, and has practical significance for improve basketball players’ competitive performance with mathematical model.

articleTitle: Multimodal Fatigue Recognition State Based on Eyelid Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Fatigue recognition of operators in a complex human-machine interface can effectively avoid human error. Aiming at improving the operator's vigilance in the digital control room of nuclear power plants, this paper proposes a multimodal fatigue state recognition technique. It combines deep learning and eyelid feature information to recognize the fatigue state of operators. Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) is integrated with the 3D Residual Network (ResNet3D) to retain the temporal and spatial features of the eyelid. By using a custom cosine annealing learning rate decay algorithm to avoid the training process of the model falling into the local optimum. In this study, experiments were conducted on a variety of eyelid feature information for different timesteps. The UTA-RLDD and DROZY datasets were used to train and validate the model. The experimental results show that the fusion recognition of eyelid images and eyelid aspect ratio (EAR) using ResNet3D and TCN multimodal model can achieve better recognition results. With the increase of the timestep, there is a significant increase in the effect of recognition of mental states. In addition, the study set up an eyelid fatigue dataset to better fit the working environment of the digital main control room in a nuclear power plant. When the timestep is set to 160, the recognition recall of the model for this test dataset is 88%. The multimodal model can detect the state of low vigilance and drowsiness in real-time. Compared with other methods, the recognition accuracy of the model is improved by an average of 2.25%.

articleTitle: Based on Sememe Knowledge Enhanced Network for Paraphrase Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Paraphrase Identification(PI) aims to judge whether the semantics of two sentences are the same, and the semantic representation of sentences is the basis of paraphrase identification. Most of the existing paraphrase identification methods use pre-trained word vectors as model input. This pre-trained word vector ignores the common polysemy and synonyms in Chinese. In order to improve the accuracy of paraphrase identification on the datasets LCQMC and BQ, we use sememe knowledge in HowNet is used to enhance the semantic representation effect of polysemous words and synonyms in paraphrase identification, thereby improving the accuracy index of paraphrase identification on the dataset. In the text representation stage, two sememe knowledge representation methods are used to enhance the semantic representation effect in the paraphrase identification task. In the semantic distance measurement stage, Euclidean distance, Manhattan distance and cosine distance are used to measure the semantic relationship between sentences. The model we proposed has been verified on two Chinese datasets LCQMC and BQ, and the ablation experiment and experimental analysis of the representation of sememe knowledge have been carried out. The results show that the accuracy of the model is about 1% higher than that of the typical model. At the same time, the introduction of sememe Knowledge can enhance the semantic representation of polysemous words and synonyms, thereby improving the accuracy of paraphrase recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Hierarchical HOI Detection Framework Augmented by Human Interactive Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is a core task for human-centric visual relationship understanding. However most existing methods still face the challenge of accuracy improvement. Because there are usually too many human-object pairs and complex scenes in the image, which leads to the complexity of HOI detection task. In this paper, we innovatively introduce a multi-grained interactive intention layer to deal with human gaze and multi-level human pose information in complex human-object scenes. We construct a hierarchical architecture using macro-level spatial layout cues, mesco-level interactive intentions and micro-level appearance features of humans and objects to complement the various levels of information. Leading results on two public benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our model.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive evaluation of energy efficiency in the transportation sector under the "dual-carbon" target
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Scientific assessment of the needs of energy efficiency services in the transportation sector can effectively tap the potential of energy efficiency improvement and optimize the energy use mode. However, at present, there are some problems in the comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation index system in the field of transportation, such as less coverage indicators, narrow scope of application, and insufficient consideration of client-side diversified needs. It is urgent to put forward a new evaluation system for multi-type low-carbon energy efficiency and comprehensive business. Based on the analysis of energy use data, this paper studies the development trend of energy use in the field of transportation, including greening, sharing and intelligence, and proposes a new comprehensive evaluation index system of energy efficiency business in the field of transportation for the purpose of multi-service integration, covering four aspects of transportation energy structure, infrastructure level, intelligence level and carbon emission level. This index can support multi-service integration and scientifically evaluation of the energy efficiency services and smart energy services.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Recognition Method of the Shipboard Equipment Status
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In severe sea conditions, it is difficult for the crew of a survey ship to monitor the status of multiple equipment in multiple cabins. Based on this status, an intelligent recognition method of shipboard equipment status based on deep learning is studied. The manual valves not equipped with electronic monitoring means are selected as the research object, and the deep learning image recognition method is used to recognize the switching statue of the valves in real time. This method can be applied to the cabins equipped with fixed surveillance cameras. For cabins that are not equipped with cameras, surveillance cameras can be equipped on the crew. In this case, the location of the visual image capture is unknown. The peripheral fixed equipment can be loaded as a reference for visual posture recognition, and the posture information of the valve in the real environment can be solved to determine the true operating state of the valve. Experiments were carried out in the real cabin, and the accuracy rate of attitude recognition was 81.17%.

articleTitle: A Cloud-based Photographing System with Adaptive Image Quality Promotion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, we have now entered the information society. The traditional ID photo shooting system needs to go to a photo studio to take pictures. The relatively expensive price and long waiting time are no longer suitable for today's development needs. Although there are already some self-service ID photo shooting systems that have overcome the shortcomings of traditional ID photo shooting, it is not convenient to use in many scenarios due to the lack of cloud platform services. This paper proposes a new ID photo shooting system. Users can take pictures through the WeChat applet, detect and modify the source image, and upload the processed image to the cloud, which greatly simplifies the user's time cost and realizes Automatic source image authentication, posture detection and standard certificate generation provide an efficient and fast system for ID card production units. After simulation tests, the system can effectively and reliably capture and process ID photos.

articleTitle: A Parameter-Optimized Mobilenet-v2 Using SSA and Its Application in Fault Diagnosis of Bearing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
