abstract: Traditional feature extraction methods have poor autonomous adaptation capabilities and lack universality in the face of large batches of data to obtain network models with optimal extraction capabilities. To improve each network's feature extraction capability and diagnostic accuracy, this paper proposes optimizing the mobilenet-v2 network framework using the Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA). Firstly, the wavelet time-frequency transform is used to process the vibration signal from the CWRU-bearing data set and the wavelet time-frequency map is used as the input sample. Afterward, the root means square error (MSE) from the network training is used as the fitness function, and the optimal learning rate and a number of batch learning of Mobilenet-v2 are searched for using the bottle sheath swarm algorithm to find the optimal combination of parameters to minimise the error. Finally, combined with the powerful adaptive feature extraction and non-linear mapping capabilities of deep learning, the optimal parameters obtained from the search are input into the network to construct the best diagnostic model and test the data. The 99.32% correct rate was obtained through multiple tests on the sample data. Compared with the grey wolf optimization algorithm and the sparrow optimization algorithm, the iterative convergence converged faster and with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Design, Optimization and Performance Analysis of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator for Fuze
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to solve the power supply problem of the fuze on the small-caliber projectile and improve the reliability of the fuze power supply, a miniaturized fuze turbine permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) is designed in this paper, which is a physical power supply driven by wind. In order to improve the electromagnetic performance of the design schemes, this paper proposes a methodology based on dimensional parameters optimization, optimizes the design parameters based on the Rotational Motor Expert (RMxprt) module, and then conducts electromagnetic performance analysis based on the Maxwell 2D module. Finally, according to the performance parameters, the scheme with 6-pole 9-slot mode is selected among the two schemes with different pole-to-slot ratio, its load line voltage is 21.53 V, and the rated load output power is 47.15 W, which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: UWB Radar Performance Analysis Based on OFDM Pilots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The technology of radar - communications integration can obtain situational awareness and unlimited ability to communicate simultaneously without increasing bandwidth. A single wireless hardware platform with a single signal provides both functions of radar and communication i.e. so as to integrate radar and communication systems into a system. Additionally, the hardware platform is very promising since the high performance is provided in radar and communication. Therefore, integrate radar and communication is an emerging and feasible trend. The paper focuses on UWB radar function applications, and system researching the radar performance based on MB-UWB. MB-UWB signal bandwidth is 528 MHz, which includes 12 pilot subcarriers. This paper analyzes radar detection performance of MB-UWB with 12 subcarriers on maximum unambiguous range and velocity, false alarm rate, misdetection rate and loss power induced by pilot. The numerical analysis shows that the MB-UWB specification is suitable for the corresponding radar application as the impulse UWB. This research lays the foundation for the research of radar technology that combines UWB technology and OFDM technology, and provides a new idea for Integrate Radar and Communication with integrated waveform.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Service Robot for Military Recuperation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problems of huge demand and complex realization of intelligent recuperation service in military logistics support, environmental disinfection, security inspection and emotion recognition are applied to the intelligent service robot designed in this paper. Firstly, A scheme using ARM architecture chip as the main control module of the robot is proposed. The robot in this scheme is equipped with a three-degree-of-freedom manipulator to solve the problem of limited killing range. Secondly, it combines the optimized ant colony algorithm for path planning to solve the problem of too many turns in the traditional algorithm. Finally, to better serve the soldiers in the rehabilitation period, the function of face recognition technology to obtain and analyze user emotions is well applied in the robot system. The MATLAB simulation shows that the design of the intelligent service robot is well-design.

articleTitle: Energy-Based Controller Design for Decentralized AC Inverter-Base Micro-grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Micro-grids, which utilize photo-voltaic (PV) cells, wind turbines, and batteries, are gaining widespread adoption as a viable solution for renewable and sustainable energy infrastructures. However, ensuring the reliability and stability of these power grids is critical, and several control strategies have been developed to achieve these goals. In this study, we have modeled the decentralized behavior of microgrids using the port-Hamiltonian formulation and a PI controller to control the inverter voltage and output power. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our control method, we have conducted simulations that consider both maximum and worst-case system fluctuations.

articleTitle: Low Complexity AoA Estimation with Planar Electromagnetic Lens Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper describes the problem of angle of arrival (AoA) estimation with planar electromagnetic (EM) lens arrays. Planar EM lens arrays exhibit some implementation advantages if compared with dielectric lenses such as light weight and low cost, making them a very attractive solution for different applications. Although several AoA estimation algorithms and methods have been recently proposed, most part of the literature does not deal with the case of planar lens, and an analysis of EM lens array signal models reveals the impossibility to apply methodologies developed for other kind of EM lenses to this case. Therefore, this work develops novel algorithms for AoA estimation with planar EM lens arrays. Moreover, the proposed methods not only have a very low computational complexity, but also employ only signal energies, leading to a great implementation simplification. Numerical results are also shown to demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Study on the Pressurization of Liquid Nitrogen in a Robotic Water Jet Thruster
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As the process of LN<inf>2</inf>’s phase transition and heat exchange with water in pressure-tight tank is complicated, the tank’s inner gas pressure is tough to be calculated by mathematical model or CFD simulation. Therefore by conducting orthogonal experimental design and its variance analysis, the first two significant influence factors of average pressurization rate of the pressurization process were determined, namely the mass of injected liquid nitrogen and the volume of compressed gas inside the pressure-tight tank. Then a RBF artificial neural network model was established, trained and tested for pressurization prediction by the orthogonal experimental data. The average value and standard deviation of relative prediction error for testing data set were 8.52% and 1.82%, respectively. Finally, the pressurization and free jumping experiments of the water jet thruster were performed. By applying the RBF neural network model, the average value and standard deviation of the relative prediction error were 8.93% and 2.33%, respectively. Thus the RBF neural network model can be taken as the theoretical pressurization prediction model and provide guidance for the robotic water jet thruster’s actual jump.

articleTitle: A Distributed Microservice Scheduling Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the current Internet of Things environment, factors affecting scheduling are gradually increasing, and service performance is affected. There may be service delays, service non-response, and service feedback error messages. At the same time, service scheduling needs to be continued. Therefore, the scheduling The algorithm puts forward higher requirements. This paper proposes a scheduling algorithm based on depth-determined policy gradient (DDPG). By combining deep learning and reinforcement learning, it solves the problem of continuous action control and constructs a policy network and a value network. Double network structure to solve the problem of slow algorithm convergence. Secondly, this paper designs a microservice-based visual monitoring system to obtain the experimental data required by the algorithm and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm. Finally, 30 sets of data collected by the monitoring system are used to test and analyze the resource balance and service delay on the node in combination with the constraints of service and data dependency, and compare the delay and resource utilization with three typical algorithms. Experiments show that DDPG can show better performance under various constraints of the complex environment of the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment and damage prediction model of typhoon disaster in Shandong Province based on TDRI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper develops a typhoon risk assessment model for Shandong Province using the "disaster risk index method" and "weighted comprehensive evaluation method". The model evaluates typhoon disaster risk and spatiotemporal change characteristics, and predicts using an Elman neural network. Results show increasing exposure and resilience but similar risk and vulnerability over time. The risk of typhoon disasters in Shandong Province decreases from coast to inland, aligning with the economic spatial aggregation. The prediction model has a minimum relative error of 0.003 and high accuracy in training and testing, demonstrating its usefulness for predicting typhoon damage.

articleTitle: Automatic parking problem based on path planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Research related to the problem of automatic parking of driverless passenger vehicles is of great importance, and this paper presents a series of studies on the path planning problem of automatic parking of driverless passenger vehicles. For Problem 1, three physical problems are solved: solving for the minimum turning radius, the shortest distance required, and the limiting relationship between the magnitude of curvature change on the path relative to the path length under the respective conditions. The structural Ackermann physical model involved in this driverless bus is analyzed in depth, and with the help of the differential equation system model and related physical concepts and formulas, a car motion model is established, and the minimum turning radius of 4.9947 m and the minimum distance of 5.23 m are successfully solved. The mathematical model of parking from the initial position to the specified parking space under the specified conditions is required. After analyzing the basic models of the Ackermann model, such as state equations, path smoothing and trajectory generation, the relevant mathematical models for solving the critical conditions were established and the RRT algorithm was used to build the model. Finally, the resultant model is obtained by MATLAB.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Copyright Protection Method Based on Fingerprinted Adversarial Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Neural network watermarking is currently the mainstream deep neural network (DNN) model copyright protection method, and the embedding of the watermark is accomplished by changing the internal structure of the model or introducing special input-output relations. The current watermarking method has weak defense against ambiguity attacks and only solves the attribution problem of the model, which is difficult to help users to make accurate rights recovery. In order to solve the above problems, we propose a DNN model copyright protection method based on fingerprinted adversarial samples. This method uses asymmetric digital fingerprints to solve the authentication and pirate tracking problems, generates adversarial samples with better mobility by iterative and momentum methods, fine-tunes the model so that the adversarial samples clamp the decision boundary of the model to complete the embedding of the watermark, and finally gives the treatment of piracy behavior. VGG-16 is chosen as the baseline network, and experiments are conducted on three publicly available datasets to evaluate whether the method meets the various performance requirements of neural network watermarking and to derive the appropriate weighting key length. The method outperforms the comparison method in all metrics, while achieving pirate tracking.

articleTitle: Accompaniment Generation Based on Deep Learning and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: To generate accompaniments when given vocals, deep learning and genetic algorithm models were used to do prediction. For deep learning, a LSTM model was used. Softmax was used as an activation function and loss was determined using categorical cross entropy. The model trained with 500 epochs and 0.01 learning rate got the best accuracy 82.6. For genetic algorithm, functions were defined based on chord designs. The model was built by six steps: encoding, create initial population, evaluate individual fitness, selection, crossover, and mutation. The model with 5000 generations and 1024 population size got the best result.

articleTitle: Digital Video Technology and Image Detection Algorithms in Film and Television Post-Production
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the advent of the information age, a large amount of digital information is flooding human's daily life and people can easily access it. Due to the massive use of smartphones, tablets and other mobile devices, digital video has become a mainstream multimedia application and is widely used in various fields such as video teaching, video conferencing, video-on-demand, entertainment and social networking, news and judicial criminal investigation. Digital video has become an important medium for the daily transmission of information. The main objective of this paper is to investigate the application of digital video technology and image detection algorithms in film and television post-production. This paper first introduces scene boundary detection, analyses the reasons why existing sampling strategies still suffer from the loss of optimal foreground and background pixel pairs; investigates fuzzy multi-criteria foreground and background pixel pair evaluation methods, proposes an infrared pedestrian classification algorithm based on fully automatic keying enhancement, and finally conducts experiments on video scene boundary detection and analyses the results. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper performs relatively better in terms of detection rate and accuracy compared with the method using only lens visual features, although its recall and accuracy rate are still somewhat lower compared to a movie with a smoother video pace.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Feature Selection Algorithm Based on Apache Spark and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The algorithm for feature selection using multi- objective particle swarm optimization has been effectively implemented in certain programs. Existing algorithms face difficulties in handling large data volumes and high- dimensional data due to their high computational complexity. To tackle this problem, data parallel frameworks have been suggested with the advancement of distributed parallel computing. However, increasing parallelism could lead to the problem of uneven data distribution which would affect the effectiveness of the cluster. We have introduced a feature selection approach that utilizes the Spark-MOPSO parallel algorithm and is implemented on the Spark platform in this paper. Firstly, the entire dataset was divided into multiple partitions, distributed computing and in-memory computing. They performed out by using Apache Spark. The local fitness values of particles were iterative independently which updated based on the data parallel computation of each partition. Among the interactive process, each partition was independent and did not affect each other. It reduced the necessity to transform mass date between nodes and network communication. At the same time, the local external archives produced by the particle swarm every m iterations pulled back to the main node and broadcasted to the partitions as the global external archive, guiding the search for the optimal particle in each partition and improving the issue of imbalanced data distribution impacting the outcomes. The experimental results indicated that the algorithm could obtain a good quality and diversity Pareto frontier through multi- objective evaluation indicators, and it could also enhance the effectiveness of problem-solving by increasing the speed of finding solutions and exhibit a better capabilities on performance and parallel computing.

articleTitle: An Inverse Propensity Score Framework for Breaking Filter Bubble Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Recommendation systems often amplify biases in data, leading to the creation of filter bubbles. Models learned from historical interactions with an imbalanced distribution of items will amplify this imbalance by over-recommending popular items. In the long term, addressing this issue is crucial for a healthy recommendation ecosystem. Existing work has not addressed the issue of bias amplification with respect to the quality of items, and definitions of item quality are typically global and do not account for user differences. In this work, we carefully analyze how bias amplification leads to filter bubbles. To address this, we propose an IPS-based sequence recommendation system (IPS-seqRS) that leverages both user local popularity and item group quality to eliminate filter bubbles. We conduct extensive experiments on a large real-world industrial dataset to validate the superiority of our proposedIPS-seqRS method in eliminating filter bubbles.

articleTitle: Multi-mode Voltage Control Strategy for High Proportion Residential Photovoltaic Based on Plug- and-Play Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The irrational development and use of traditional fossil energy sources has led to an increasingly serious energy crisis, which has also produced environmental pollution and other problems. Solar energy is clean and non-polluting, and is widely used in all walks of our life. However, the high proportion of residential photovoltaic grid-connected is very likely to cause voltage violation, which will have a negative impact on the power quality and stable operation of distribution network. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-mode voltage control strategy based on plug-and-play devices for high proportion residential Photovoltaic (PV), which selects the corresponding voltage control mode according to the voltage requirements of the distribution network and combines it with Modified Particle Swarm Optimization (MPSO) for solving the problem, so as to ensure the stability of voltage control after grid connection of high proportion PV. The proposed method is used to ensure the stability of the voltage control after grid-connected high proportion of PV. The validation analysis shows that the control strategy proposed in this paper can achieve peak-shaving and power quality improvement for high ratio PV grid connection, and can effectively solve the adverse effects of voltage crossing when high proportion residential PV is connected to the grid.

articleTitle: Cascading Modular Multimodal Cross-attention Network for Rumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, the task of rumor detection has progressed from its initial focus on textual content to a multimodal approach incorporating both text and images. This means that images and videos within rumors are considered as sources of information and are more likely to capture people's visual attention, thus making the spread of rumors easier. Failure to control rumors on the Internet could lead to negative consequences such as endangering public safety. In this context, multimodal rumor detection has emerged. However, current multimodal rumor detection is unable to capture deep-level textual semantic information and integrate it with key objects in images. So, we introduce the Cascading Modular Multimodal Cross-Attention Network (CMMCN), which has been specially crafted for the purpose of detecting rumors. By facilitating sophisticated interactions between information at both the word and visual-object levels, our network leverages modularized cross-attention units to extract deep textual features in a cascading fashion. The network also facilitates layer-by-layer interaction between textual and visual key objects to capture deep-level fusion features across modalities. Two multimodal rumor datasets (Weibo and Twitter) were used for comparison and ablation experiments. According to the results of the experiment, CMMCN can effectively integrate modal information and enhance the ability to detect rumors through multiple modes.

articleTitle: The Research and Construction of Practical Case Library of Database Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Using database technology and AI, it is of great significance to explore the database case for data processing and analysis of the digital transformation platform based on Knowledge graphe. Knowledge graph includes knowledge engineering, natural language processing, database, machine learning. With the development of university-enterprise cooperation in china, high-quality resources in the computer industry will be introduced into the practice of database courses, so as to create new database practice case library with new engineering characteristics. Colleges and universities have realized the training goal of talent technology under the background of new engineering by building a hierarchical database oriented talent training mode. Knowledge graph is used to process massive multi-dimensional data, which can be considered as a semantic network. The knowledge graph processing steps involve knowledge representation, knowledge acquisition, knowledge fusion, knowledge calculation and knowledge reasoning. The knowledge graph includes the processing and calculation of database data. Then, the construction of the case of the database can use the knowledge graph technology. The construction and reform of the database practice case for the new engineering and engineering education accreditation, and the strengthening of both theory and practice, have an obvious role and significance in improving the quality of talent training in the computer direction, promoting practical teaching and improving teaching quality. Based on the innovative mode of university-enterprise cooperation, this paper explores the path and direction of the construction of the case library for practical of database using knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Auction Pricing for Bandwidth across Multiple Datacenters with Traffic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Bandwidth between servers becomes valuable and congested for network users because of the gradual development of datacenter networks recently. The bandwidth is selling at a fixed price per GB in traditional methods. Traffic engineering technique is commonly used for route scheduling. The main shortcoming of traditional pricing strategies is the low usage rate of costly connections and mendacious transactions of strategic users. Auction principle is able to overcome shortcomings in these aspects, but the unacceptable efficiency in large-scale networks limits the usability. And, existing pricing strategies do not take the importance of data and transaction itself into consideration in scheduling. In order to take advantage of the auction principle and avoid the shortcomings, MAPS, a pricing system for bandwidth across multiple datacenters based on auction principle, is designed. MAPS combines auction pricing with traffic engineering technique in order to achieve high performance. MAPS aims to achieve considerable efficiency and provides fairness guarantee for normal bidders and against malicious bidders. Algorithms in MAPS are well-designed based on the formulation of the problem. Our evaluation is based on simulation and the result proves that MAPS performs well in network utility and time efficiency. Important transactions are prioritized and the value of data transferred is improved up to 60 percent.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Optimizing the traffic control system is of great significance for improving people’s livelihood and promoting economic development. To realize an intelligent traffic control system that is different from the fixed timing scheme based on historical traffic flow and the adjustment of green signal ratio, maddpg and qmix reinforcement learning methods are tried to be applied to two different four intersection traffic network files with restricted traffic routes and the whole route. The total reward value of the algorithm is compared; the stability of the two methods applied to the traffic control system is evaluated by the growth speed of the reward items, the reduction speed of the penalty items and the convergence speed of the algorithm. Finally, through two groups of comparative experiments, the convergence speed of maddpg is slightly slower than that of qmix in the case of the whole route and the restricted route, but the total reward is significantly higher than that of qmix algorithm. At the same time, the growth rate of maddpg in reward items and the decline rate of punishment items are faster than qmix. Through the comparison of the two methods in different road environments, it is found that maddpg is more suitable for optimizing traffic control. The total reward value of the algorithm is compared; the stability of the two methods applied to the traffic control system is evaluated by the growth speed of the reward items, the reduction speed of the penalty items and the convergence speed of the algorithm. Finally, through two groups of comparative experiments, the convergence speed of maddpg is slightly slower than that of qmix in the case of the whole route and the restricted route, but the total reward is significantly higher than that of qmix algorithm; at the same time, the growth rate of maddpg in reward items and the decline rate of punishment items are faster than qmix. articleTitle: Table of Contents

articleTitle: An Overall Weighted Fusion Algorithm Based on Dynamic Optimal Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Based on the background of cooperative detection of target by multiple UAVs, this paper proposes an efficient multi-sensor data fusion algorithm, which is called the overall weighted fusion algorithm based on dynamic optimal estimation (abbreviated as DOE-OWFA) Based on the weighted fusion by the least squares method, the algorithm makes full use of the state estimation property of Kalman Alter for data processing and state estimation. In order to evaluate the performance of the algorithm, we conducted simulation tests with the help of MATLAB. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has higher fusion accuracy and better robustness compared with the same type of algorithms.

articleTitle: Improved WD-Transformer Based Wire Rope Damage Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to monitor the wear and tear of hoist ropes due to fatigue and other factors, and to ensure reliable hoist operation, a wire rope damage detection algorithm based on improved Wavelet Denoising (WD) and improved Transformer is proposed. Firstly, the wire rope monitoring data set is constructed, expanded and split by voltage sensor measurements. Subsequently, the wavelet denoising algorithm is improved by using a gradient descent automation design threshold to filter out voltage fluctuations due to wobbles and other factors. Next, the monitoring of the location, degree and type of wire rope defects and the determination of whether the wire rope meets the quality regulations are completed by constructing an improved Transformer computational model, including two parts, the Transformer prediction network and the multi-layer perceptron correction network. The experiments show that the above model has the advantage of high prediction accuracy compared with other similar models.

articleTitle: Driving Circuit Based on Artificial Synapse for Display
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The development trend of flat panel display is bound to be ultra-high pixel. While the current display is that the driving module is separated from the display module. And the operation speed is slow. When the amount of displayed data is large, the data transmission from the shift register to the column driver and the clock circuit to the row driver will have a time delay. This will increase the connection time between the picture frame and the frame. The computing based on Von Neumann framework is the separation of storage and calculation modules, which reduces the computing speed and integration density. And the display driving circuit based on this framework also has the same problem. Neuromorphic computation based on artificial neurons and artificial synapses is integrated with storage and computation in a device. This greatly improves the operation speed and integration density. In our work, artificial synaptic device was applied to the display driving circuit in order to solve the above dilemmas. The combination of neural morphological devices of artificial synapses and display will reduce the energy consumption of display and improve the speed of operation to realize the integration of display, memory and computing in a device, and brain-like parallel operation.

articleTitle: Discussion on Using Continue Statement to Improve a Descending Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In essence, the simple selection sort, as an important sort descending algorithm that plays a significant role in data mining, decision analysis and other fields, is to compare, assign subscripts and exchange data, which is designed to sort a set of known disordered data in descending order. The analysis on two different sort descending algorithms of simple selection sort using only the main function and the simple selection sort calling the function reveals that the sort descending algorithm uses an if statement in the inner loop. Discussion on how to control the number of if statements used in descending order using the continue statement. The running results showed that the improved algorithm using the continue statement is feasible. It just realized descending sort, and effectively reduced the times of comparing in sort descending and saved time.

articleTitle: Design and research of hydraulic monitoring system based on single chip microcomputer control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The improvement of automation and intelligence level of hydraulic transmission system is of great significance for safe and efficient production. AT89S52 single chip microcomputer can achieve good results in the hydraulic transmission control system. The stability of flow control is high, the maximum deviation is less than 7%, and the control of displacement ratio and speed meet the expected requirements. The periodic changes in different speed control areas have significant linear characteristics. The variable displacement pump can effectively improve the control accuracy in the closed-loop feedback control.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation of cooperative reconnaissance between electronic signal reconnaissance equipment and SAR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Electronic signal reconnaissance equipment can locate electromagnetic targets in long distance and large range, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) can image and locate targets. According to their reconnaissance characteristics, the factors and indexes affecting the cooperative reconnaissance efficiency of airborne multi-reconnaissance loads are analyzed, and the cooperative reconnaissance efficiency model of UAV multi reconnaissance loads is established by using linear weighting algorithm. Finally, the reconnaissance effectiveness of the above two airborne reconnaissance loads is calculated and analyzed to verify the availability of the model.

articleTitle: Short-term passenger flow prediction strategy of urban rail transit based on ridge regression and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to reduce the interference of noise in the short-term passenger flow prediction of urban rail transit, an efficient and accurate traffic flow prediction scheme has become the most concerned issue for traffic participants. This paper focuses on the application of ridge regression and LSTM neural network in the short-term passenger flow of urban rail transit. This paper firstly performs data cleaning, missing processing and normalization. Then, we choose LSTM as the core and use the ridge regression-assisted model to predict the short-term passenger flow of urban rail transit. Ridge regression is used for prediction when there is less data, and LSTM with high fitting degree is used for medium and long-term prediction. The model has a high fitting effect on the randomly divided test set and real data.

articleTitle: Multiple Harmonic Current Control Based on Adaptive Inverse Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this study, a method for adaptive inverse control of multiple superimposed harmonic currents is proposed. The noise mechanism of multiple harmonic current in power capacitor is analyzed, and the multiple harmonic current is correctly reproduced under the real operation condition of the laboratory. In the converter station of high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission, several power capacitors are required. When multiple superimposed AC harmonic signals flow through the power capacitors, they will generate vibration and noise. To study the characteristics of the noise generated by multiple superimposed AC harmonics flowing through the power capacitor, it is necessary to simulate the numerous superimposed harmonic currents under working conditions. This study uses the adaptive inverse control method to achieve accurate control of the superimposed harmonic currents of the required order, which is based on the multi-harmonic current injection system (MHCIS). The simulation findings validate the efficacy of the adaptive inverse control based multiple superimposed harmonic currents control approach put forward in this paper. The findings indicate that HVDC is simpler to control than conventional AC power supplies. HVDC transmission helps to improve the security and stability of regional power grid. It has strong transmission capacity and obvious advantages in long-distance transmission.

articleTitle: Research on the Joint Learning Method of Intent Detection and Slot Filling by Fusing Tag Semantic Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Intention recognition and slot filling are the main functions of natural language understanding. In view of the insufficient consideration of the semantic information of intention and slot label in most current models, this paper proposes a method to integrate the semantic information of intention and slot label into the joint model. First, in order to make full use of the semantic information of intention and slot, we transform intention, slot label and label "B, I, O" into natural language; Secondly, the pre-training model BERT is used to encode the natural language and interact with the coded representation of the sentence, so that the sentence fully contains the intention and semantic slot information, and the intention and semantic slot that best match the sentence and word are output. Finally, we conducted experiments on three data sets, ATIS, SNIPS and Facebook. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively use the semantic information of tags, and the accuracy of intention recognition and F1 value of slot filling are improved, which verifies the effectiveness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Periodic Operation Plan of Railway Station Based on NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The periodic transportation organization mode of high-speed railway has been widely adopted in many countries. In order to better meet the requirements of periodic transportation organization, the operation organization mode of high-speed railway station should also be changed from non-periodic and non-fixed to periodic, regular and specialized. This paper mainly studies the method of high-speed railway station operation planning under the periodic transportation organization mode. With the goal of minimizing the total time of train operation at the station and balancing the utilization of tracks at the station, a unit periodic operation planning model is constructed. The fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) with improved elite strategy is used to solve the problem model. Taking Xiong’an station as an example, the periodic station operation plan is compiled. The results are analyzed from the balance of station equipment utilization and the periodicity of operation plan, which verifies the feasibility of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Technical Model of Computer Network Database Security Management Based on State Voting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the process of the development of computer network database, the security management technology is also constantly improved and innovated, which plays a great role in improving the security management level of computer network database. At present, database updates at home and abroad are carried out by means of independent updates between departments. In the process of updating, there is no interaction between departments, that is to say, each department updates its own and handles its own exceptions. The traditional security update method is to update independently among multiple departments, which can not find the problems of different database table versions in time, and even the problem of verification failure. Therefore, we must find an update method that can solve the problem of excessive voting data. This paper studies the security management technology model of computer network database, designs the security management technology model of computer network database and possible problems, and improves the update rate of security computer database and the security and reliability of computer travel.

articleTitle: Enhancing Education Performance through Machine Learning: A Study of Student Learning Outcomes Prediction Using GANs and ANNs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Education is a crucial strategy for a country, and an increasing number of nations are investing more in their education systems. However, the improvement in the performance of some private universities remains limited. This is due to the low quality of information in the education process and a lack of consistency between the implementation of policies and the logic of classroom instruction. To address this issue, this paper proposes the use of machine learning models to improve the current teaching framework. By predicting performance, the paper detects illogical policy planning in education and carries out appropriate modifications. This research takes student academic performance as an example and uses Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) models and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models to predict student performance based on their classroom performance. To evaluate the differences between the two models, this research will use Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) to evaluate the performance. The experimental results show that the two algorithms mentioned in this paper are effective in predicting student performance and contribute to improving the performance and information quality of private universities, as well as adjusting teaching structures.

articleTitle: Improved A-star Method for Collision Avoidance and Path Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The A-Star algorithm is one type of typical and useful method in the field of path planning and has been used in many fields. However, the conventional A-Star algorithm just takes the shortest path as the optimal path generation condition and does not consider the actual morphology of the robot. At the same time, the path search efficiency can be further improved. In this study, the problems with the A-Star algorithm above are improved. Firstly, changing the evaluation function of the traditional A-Star algorithm make it more effective. Then, the search directions are changed from 8 to 5. The orthodox A-Star algorithm has eight directions for exploration, which is not always efficient, so the search directions are adjusted to five to improve its efficiency. Finally, avoid oblique penetrations of the obstacle vertex to avoid the collision. The size of objects is usually neglected in the traditional A-Star algorithm. The route produced by the new method avoids moving too close to obstacles. The result of the experiment proves the effectiveness of the improved method. It improves the traditional A-Star algorithm so that the generated paths avoid sticking too close to the obstacle or even colliding with it.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis and Research on the Mainstream Algorithm of Machine Learning in Stock Trend Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The rapid growth of the equity market has progressively become an essential pillar of the nation's economy. The stock market can generate high returns. our research focuses on how to accurately foresee the stock price trend. In this paper, Fenghua high-tech stock data is chosen as the experimental data, and stock movements are predicted using the support vector machine (SVM) model, the LGBM model, and the random forests (FM) model. On the premise of empirical research, the prediction effect and accuracy of each model are demonstrated by integrating the prediction curve of each model with the evaluation indices RMSE, MAE, MAPE, and R2. The results indicate that the model based on random forest provides more accurate predictions.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Hydrological Monitoring System Based on Beidou Short Message and LoRa
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the current problems of hydrological monitoring in China, such as monitoring points located in remote areas, no communication network and poor real-time data collection, this paper proposes and designs a hydrological monitoring system based on Beidou short message and LoRa. The system consists of several collection terminals, data gateway, and monitoring terminal. The collection terminals send hydrological data to the data gateway by LoRa, the data gateway acquired multiple sets of hydrological data and reports them to the monitoring terminal through the Beidou short message module; the monitoring terminal also can send instructions to the collection terminals through the data gateway to realize the control of the collection terminals. By testing, the system meets the requirements of wide communication coverage, long-distance networking of collection terminals, low power consumption, and has wide application prospects.

articleTitle: Network Equipment Fault Maintenance Decision System Based on Bayesian Decision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Bayesian network is a directional loop topology composed of graph theory and probability principle. The input data can be classified by expressing the causal relationship between variables in the way of directed connection and expressing the correlation degree between variables in the way of probability. It avoids complicated operation and improves the efficiency of fault diagnosis. The performance of network devices deteriorates gradually. After a certain period of time, an alarm is generated indicating that the performance deteriorates. If the network devices are not repaired in time, the network devices will be faulty soon. Based on Bayesian decision algorithm, the hierarchical structure of network equipment fault maintenance decision system is designed, and the criteria of Bayesian decision algorithm and the decision model of network equipment fault maintenance are constructed. The research results can make decision on network equipment fault maintenance and improve the level of network equipment fault diagnosis and maintenance.

articleTitle: An Investigation into the Detection of Human Scratching Activity Based on Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Because pruritus is often overlooked and undertreated in the clinical setting, a major unmet need is objective measures of behaviors associated with scratching in order to quantify itch severity and frequency since scratch directly correlates to itch. Such methods to measure itch and how itch severity changes over time are needed to objectively study and understand pruritus, develop and assess the efficacy of new medications, quantify disease severity in patients, and monitor treatment response. Wearable sensors in the form of wrist actigraphy, which detects wrist movements over time using micro-accelerometers, are the most studied and tested method to detect scratching events. To address these issues, 7 deep learning models will be used to train and test for scratch detection, including: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) – Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), RNN – Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), CNN & RNN – GRU (end-to-end), CNN & RNN – LSTM (end-to-end), CNN & RNN – GRU (parallel) and CNN & RNN – LSTM (parallel). The final results show accurately detect scratching using deep learning (CNN achieved a high accuracy of 0.996) in various situations and can provide useful information (time, frequency, scratched body part, etc.) regarding the scratching behavior in day and nighttime in order to better quantify pruritus for use in the medical field.

articleTitle: Simulation of Financial Market Index Prediction Model Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper is based on the design model of long-and short-term memory network (LSTM) and BP neural network. Then this paper takes the historical price and trading volume of the market price index, the correlated sector index and the financial sector and the historical price of the 10-year Treasury bond yield as input to study the trend of the rise and fall of the TDX financial industry index. The empirical results show that using 39 days prior data makes the trend prediction effect the best. It has achieved the ideal prediction effect and no fitting has occurred. BP neural network can predict the market index well and the predicted result is close to the real value. This method has good practicability.

articleTitle: Collision Warning Method for Unmanned Vehicles Based on Region Division
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to improve the safety of unmanned vehicles in the performance test, a collision warning method based on region division is proposed. Through collision detection calculation, collision warning information is sent out before the collision occurs, and the accident rate is reduced. Firstly, the test site was divided into several detection blocks and detection areas, and the detection area of the vehicle was calculated according to the location information of the test vehicle. Then, the test vehicles located in the same detection area were screened and collision detected according to the rules, and an alarm was issued according to the change trend of vehicle travel distance. The simulation results show that the method is efficient, stable and practical, and can effectively carry out safety early warning in the process of unmanned vehicle test.

articleTitle: 3D Building Reconstruction Using 2D GANs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: There are many historical sites across the globe that hold a huge importance to mankind as it contains the history and culture of the past. But as buildings wither and lose their beauty over the course of time, we lose a precious piece of the heritage of mankind forever. With the growing emergence of new technologies and the internet, we are instead able to preserve these heritage sites through their reconstruction as 3D models using convolutional neural networks and simple 2D vision. We base our work mainly on a previous implementation of 3D shape reconstruction using 2D image GANs by Xingang Pan et al, where we mine for cues such as albedo, viewpoint, lighting and depth such that we can infer a 3D image from these factors. We believe our work is different from other works in that we use purely an 2D image to reconstruct its 3D form, unlike other related works such as Pixel2Mesh, which uses 3D Mesh Models for ground truths. Our work infers a 3D shape and model from simply one 2D image, which cuts costs and is much easier to implement as it does not require any other input other than the singular 2D image.

articleTitle: A Fully-Integrated Relaxation Oscillator with No Reference Voltage for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The research direction of this paper is a chip oscillator circuit for IoT equipment. This circuit can effectively reduce the impact of power supply voltage on frequency stability, improve stability and reduce area and power consumption without additional voltage. Moreover, this Relaxation oscillator is 0.18 μ Designed in the BCD process. The power supply voltage range is from 2.7V to 5V. The simulation results show that the maximum frequency change relative to the power supply voltage is 0.65%. It has excellent performance.

articleTitle: Dependency enhanced session-based recommendation based on GNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Session-based recommendations can predict the next item through the user's current session sequence. Session-based recommendation with graph neural network has become the mainstream method in this domain. However, the session sub-graph constructed by the session sequence will bring fake dependencies issue. Adjacent items may be noise, non-adjacent items may have true dependencies; Moreover, the information outside the target session is ignored. To solve these problems, a dependency enhanced session-based recommendation model based on graph neural network (GID-GNN) is proposed. Firstly, it uses GNN to learn session features, meanwhile uses self-attention to capture session items’ dependencies to obtain session level representation; Then a global graph is constructed to obtain effective global level information and global level representation; Finally, the prediction is made by combining two part representations. Experiments were tested on two real datasets, the results proved effectiveness of GID-GNN model.

articleTitle: High-altitude parabolic detection system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The high-altitude parabolic intelligent detection and early warning system based on machine vision is a high-precision, low-cost, practical, and easy-to-assemble new system designed by combining existing technical means. Combined with traditional video surveillance, the system performs morphological processing on the initial image through grayscale and Gaussian filtering methods, and then transmits data quickly through the 5G communication module. The receiver uses a convolutional neural network algorithm to identify the type of objects falling from high altitudes. When entering the threat mode, while identifying the falling object, through the mathematical model established by analyzing its possible force mode, the Kalman filtering method is used to jointly predict the data received by the dual cameras, and the falling object is predicted. Point coordinates and transfer them. The sound and light early warning module that receives the coordinates quickly processes the data, uses eye-catching laser lights to mark the landing point before the falling object hits the ground, and supplements it with a sound alarm to remind pedestrians, and uses a blocking net to intercept to avoid pedestrians from being hurt. This paper focuses on a high-altitude parabolic detection system based on deep learning and intelligent prediction.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of hospital infusion monitoring and alarm system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the progress of society, people have benefited from modernization and the convenience of science and technology in all aspects. However, the relationship between doctors and patients in today’s society has always been the focus of contradictions that easily lead to disputes. In terms of infusion, problems such as bulging infusion caused by insufficient medical staff also occur from time to time. At present, the most widely used and easy-to-master infusion method is intravenous infusion. According to the patient’s condition and medication, the infusion speed is often different. However, in the specific operation, nurses often adjust the infusion speed manually by experience. Although this method is easy to use and master, in actual operation, the inexperienced medical staff may not be particularly accurate in grasping the drip speed during infusion, which is prone to problems such as patient discomfort. Continuous work, coupled with the shortage of personnel, is prone to medical accidents, thus increasing the pressure on medical staff. Therefore, it is particularly important to make a relatively low-cost and easy-to-use infusion alarm to meet this need. Therefore, taking AT89C51 as the central control unit, the design is relatively simple and the cost is relatively low. With 3mm red led, LCD1602, resistor, infrared optocoupler, 8550 triode and stepping motor, an infusion alarm based on 51 single chip microcomputer is designed, hoping to play a certain role in infusion speed control and end warning. This paper will introduce and explain the hardware and software of infusion alarm in detail from various aspects.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic grid-connected control system based on improved genetic algorithm and its implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Economic development and social progress make a large amount of traditional energy consumed, followed by environmental deterioration. The optimal configuration of photovoltaic power generation grid-connected is studied. A multi-objective optimization model is established to minimize the loss of the distribution network, the node voltage offset and the access cost for the location and capacity of photovoltaic power supply; an improved parallel selection method based on genetic algorithm is proposed; the key objectives of optimization are highlighted, treat each objective function differently, and obtain the optimal solution of the model on the basis of the forward push-back method to calculate the power flow of the distribution network. The results show the correctness of the established model and the superiority of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on English semantic intelligence analysis method based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Semantic analysis of sentences is the research basis of automatic scoring of subjective questions in English examination, English machine translation, English automatic response, automatic acquisition of English article abstracts and so on. The research on English strong thematic structure (the so-called "split sentence") first includes yesperson’s "shift analysis" and "insertion analysis", followed by Halliday’s "syntactic analysis", "theme Rheme Structure Analysis" and "participant role analysis" And other methods. The intelligent algorithm of sentence component oriented English semantic analysis can not only reduce the workload of teachers, but also avoid the inconsistent scores of students' subjective questions caused by different teachers' subjective cognition; With the continuous improvement of regular expressions and vocabulary databases of English vocabulary and grammar, the algorithm will be trusted by more and more teachers. This paper adopts the method of deep learning. Simply emphasizing shallow learning of knowledge can no longer meet the requirements of modern society for knowledge. Deep learning is a method based on the understanding of knowledge, aimed at enhancing students' problem-solving and knowledge transfer abilities.

articleTitle: A study of trajectory selection based on pedestrian willingness in extreme situations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the improvement of urban intelligence, trajectory prediction technology can accurately predict the future trajectory of pedestrians to reduce collisions and avoid human-vehicle conflicts. Pedestrian trajectory prediction is important for developing smart cities and improving traffic safety. This paper analyses the trajectory choices of pedestrians under extreme and normal conditions, such as subjective emergencies, extreme weather (rain, snow, wind, etc.) and darkness. A web-based questionnaire survey was conducted using the software "Questionnaire Star" and the data collected was processed and visualised for analysis. This paper compares the trajectory choice of pedestrians' willingness to travel under normal and extreme conditions and examines the impact of pedestrians' willingness to travel under extreme conditions on the choice of a wide but distant road versus a rugged but close road.

articleTitle: Optimization of apparatus translation algorithm for English complex long sentences based on multi-layer filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: English apparatus translation is a handle mechanism for spontaneous tongue, but most English apparatus translations rely too much on the manual summary of tongue experts when acquiring grammar rules, and there are large errors in the process of English apparatus understanding under some weakened rules, and there are semantics. The disadvantage of large error in feature extraction. Apparatus translation is an vital research field of spontaneous tongue handle, and it has a wide range of application prospects in today's message society and military departments. Apparatus translation is an vital research direction in the field of spontaneous tongue handle. In the existing English-Chinese apparatus translation system, long sentence analysis is a research difficulty. With the burgeon of message technology, patent or technical long sentences with huge amount of words and complex structure have widely appeared in people's daily work. How to translate these long sentences reasonably and effectively has become an urgent problem to be solved by the existing apparatus translation technology. The means used in this paper is multi-layer filtering, which can effectively filter redundant phrase pairs in the phrase table and reduce the excessive consumption of time and space in decoding.

articleTitle: A YOLO-Based Transmission Line Protection Method in Smart Electric Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The safety of the power infrastructures is important for the development of industries, the damage caused by external forces to transmission lines is fatal, often leading to longterm failures. To detect external dangers, we proposed the YOLO based algorithm which combined the data augmentation and anchor clustering method. To save the labeling work, we proposed semi-auto labeling algorithm based on YOLO model. Simulation results show that the our method improves prediction accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network in Face Recognition Application Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Face Recognition has proven to be one of the most successful technology. In this study, the convolutional neural network is applied to the field of face recognition, which greatly improves the accuracy of recognition. In this study, by obtaining higher quality face image data source, select a better face recognition optimizer, adjust some of the hyperparameters, and then improve the ability of face data processing. In this study, convolution neural is used to improve the algorithm accuracy of feature extraction, which improves the recognition effect of the model.

articleTitle: Research on the Security of Electronic Information Engineering Transmission System under the Integration of Computer Wireless Network Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper studies the resource allocation method of the heterogeneous cellular network. Aiming at the heterogeneous cellular network that supports user direct-connection communication, a wireless network communication technology based on SIDR is proposed to configure the user's transmit power for direct-connection communication. The method first defines the ratio of the power of the valuable signal received by the cellular communication node to the power of the interference from the direct-connected communication users. In this paper, SIDR can predict the relationship between the increase of outage probability of cellular communication nodes and the transmit power of direct-connected communication users after the introduction of direct-connected communication. A simulation example verifies that the method has strong practicability in practical applications, especially in multi-source fusion systems with limited communication.

articleTitle: Research and design of wireless charging system for intelligent device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: in this paper, a kind of intelligent wireless charging device is studied by taking the intelligent car as an example, the system is mainly composed of MSP430 control circuit, DC motor, wireless charging and discharging module, voltage stabilizing application circuit and super capacitor energy storage module, Through the MSP430 single-chip microcomputer control car operation, set the car charging time, control the wireless charging coil module, the use of super-capacitor charging, DC-DC conversion circuit for car charging, after repeated testing,The experimental results show that the device has high charging efficiency and low power consumption, and can charge the car at a set time.

articleTitle: Data Storage Architecture and Data Backup Scheme for Digital Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The wide application of new technology has effectively promoted the construction of digital learning platform, making it up for the learning of traditional teaching. Therefore, using information technology and network technology can build a more flexible and diversified learning platform that is not limited by time and space. In the digital learning platform, the need for data practicality, reliability, integrity and recoverability is particularly important. This paper will analyze the construction of the digital learning platform in detail from three aspects: the construction of the server, the deployment of data storage, data backup and restore, and carry out thorough planning and design.

articleTitle: English pronunciation quality evaluation system based on data mining algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Chinese English learners are constrained by factors such as the English learning environment and educational level, and have encountered many problems in oral learning. For the evaluation of English pronunciation quality, some existing CAT systems both domestically and internationally focus on vocabulary and grammar learning in oral teaching. The evaluation of English oral exams is still conducted manually, with issues such as high subjectivity, uneven standards, slow speed, repeatability, and instability. With the continuous improvement of big data, cloud technology, and language teaching methods, the English speech recognition and pronunciation quality evaluation system based on DM algorithm will bring new opportunities for English oral teaching, correcting pronunciation errors, and improving English oral proficiency.

articleTitle: Application of BeiDou Navigation Satellite System Based Indoor and Outdoor Fusion Positioning Technology in the Construction of Power Grid Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a technical solution for indoor and outdoor fusion positioning. This paper studies the algorithm principles of two positioning modes, satellite positioning and ultra-wideband indoor and outdoor fusion positioning, and proposes a high-precision positioning algorithm that is compatible with the two positioning modes. This paper adopts the innovative development of the innovative rail terminal mobile platform, night patrol module, and switching function module. The system can better play the practical use of substation robots. The actual test shows that the system has the characteristics of complete functions, accurate positioning, and stable operation. The system provides an essential solution for the intelligent management and safe production of the State Grid.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning of 6-DOF manipulator based on spatial ant colony algorithm and obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Moving in an environment with obstacles is a common operating condition for manipulators. How to adjust the obstacle avoidance planning path according to the position of obstacles in time is the key to achieving the safe operation of manipulators in obstacle environments. The trajectory of a 6- DOF manipulator is proposed to be planned using a spatial ant colony method. By establishing an improved D-H motion model to solve the forward and inverse kinematic equations, movement from a specified point to a specified point at the end of the manipulator is achieved. To create collision-free routes, a modified ant colony algorithm is paired with a collision detection technique. The position of each arm is determined by solving the inverse solution of the manipulator motion through the manipulator's end path nodes, collision detection is done to assess the viability of each set of inverse solutions, and then the obstacle avoidance path is obtained. The effectiveness and feasibility of this method for 6-DOF manipulator trajectory planning and obstacle avoidance are verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Signal Transmission System of Competitive Sports Competition under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper makes a detailed description of the construction, workflow, software testing and live effects of the virtual system through the use of the virtual system in the live broadcast of competitive sports competitions. This paper innovatively proposes a real-time signal transmission system for sports competitions based on computer big data technology. The system is mainly composed of video system composition, signal production process, and several major functional architectures of system core equipment. Aiming at real-time signal transmission, this paper innovatively proposes a chaotic system based on Duffing oscillator to detect weak sinusoidal signals in the background of color noise. The experimental research shows that the method proposed in this paper has practicability for the detection of real-time signals of competitive sports, especially the detection of weak signals submerged in the background of strong color noise is superior to the traditional time domain detection method.

articleTitle: Design of Radar Waveform Using Adaptive-Network-Based Fuzzy Inference Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Radar’s transmission waveform will affect the radar’s performance and the extraction of information from the echo of target. Therefore, radar waveform design is of great significance. There are two commonly used radar waveform design methods: the waveform design based on SNR criterion and MI criterion, but both two methods have their own limitations. In this paper, a new waveform design method that takes into account the advantages of both criteria is proposed. Adaptive-Network-Based Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) not only has the self-learning ability and self-adaptation ability of neural network, but also has the ability to understand rules in the fuzzy field. The data sets produced by two criteria are training data sets for the neural network. The trained ANFIS is to design waveform. Finally, it is found that the mutual information of the ANFIS waveform is better than the MI criterion, and the signal-to-noise ratio of the ANFIS waveform is better than the SNR criterion, that's to say that ANFIS-based waveform design takes into account the advantages of both based on SNR and MI criterion.

articleTitle: 3D mapping and visual navigation system for automatic driving scene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In view of the current problem that the navigation effect of the target point of the indoor small environment is not ideal in the V_SLAM of the current mobile robot through the depth camera, based on the RTAB-MAP algorithm, it is proposed to configure the multi-sensor configuration map navigation system based on the use of visual map navigation and the lidar odometer and robot visual mileage rgbd_odometry. Experimental results show that compared with single-V_SLAM vision or lidar mapping, RTAB-MAP after extended sensor configuration can obtain a three-dimensional depth map with richer information and more accurate map edges, which improves the accuracy and practicality of visual navigation to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on the peak intelligent detection technology of AC voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper analyzes various methods for peak measurement of AC circuits. Specific schemes are given according to the signal frequency level and the waveform division of the signal, including a peak measurement circuit, a waveform conversion circuit, an AD536-based peak voltage measurement circuit, a peak detector circuit and some programs. The advantages and disadvantages of these four methods are analyzed, and finally, a suggested scheme for engineering practice is given.

articleTitle: A safety helmet recognition algorithm for substation operation site
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the process of electric construction, electric workers are required to wear safety helmets. However, in recent years, production safety incidents in substations have occurred frequently, and the fundamental reason is that operators violated power safety regulations to operate, and one of the important reasons is not wearing safety helmets in accordance with the regulations. In this paper, a pixel-level visual background extraction moving target detection algorithm is proposed to obtain foreground targets. Experiments show that the detection algorithm studied in this paper basically meets the requirements of substation workers' helmet wearing status recognition performance, which is a good way for subsequent safety The application of hat wearing status recognition technology to the intelligent video monitoring system of substations has laid a foundation, and it also provides a new idea for the identification method of helmet wearing status in substations.

articleTitle: Design of online educational resources recommendation algorithm based on collaborative recommendation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer and network technology, the Internet has gradually entered people's daily life and completely changed the way people obtain information. Massive network information provides a guarantee to meet the information needs of users and brings great convenience to people. However, the diversity and variability of network information lead to the excessive expansion of information and the problem of information overload, which makes it difficult for people to find the required information from the vast information resources quickly and accurately. Therefore, the storage of courseware resources on the education cloud platform has increased sharply, resulting in the problem of "information overload" in the user learning stage. For users, relying solely on early classification and keyword retrieval technology is difficult to find the required courseware efficiently and accurately. Under this background, the online education resource recommendation system came into being, which has brought effective solutions to the above problems. This paper focuses on the design of Network Education Resource Recommendation Algorithm Based on collaborative algorithm, and completes the analysis and design work. The online education resource recommendation system customizes personalized recommendation services for users according to their individual characteristics, so that users can get what they are interested in more quickly and conveniently, and the collaborative recommendation algorithm is the core part of the system. At present, collaborative recommendation algorithm is the most widely used and studied recommendation algorithm, but the algorithm itself has problems such as sparse user rating data and cold start when new users join. Therefore, the research on collaborative recommendation algorithm is mainly focused on this problem. "Network Education Resource Recommendation System" is an intelligent system proposed to better realize network education.

articleTitle: Low carbon operation of integrated energy systems with carbon capture devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, the environmental problems related to carbon dioxide emission have become increasingly prominent. The carbon seize gadgets are brought into the gadget for optimization.
