In this paper, firstly, the curbing wind punishment aspect is used to convert the curtailed wind quantity into the wind curtailment cost, and a low-carbon monetary operation mannequin of the built-in strength device with carbon seize units is hooked up with the gadget running price and carbon emissions as the multi-objective. The regular boundary intersection approach is used to assemble the Pareto frontier of multi-objective problems, and deciding on answer with biggest complete pride as the compromise answer thru fuzzy membership function. Then, the optimization results in different scenarios are compared, and the influence of power to gas raw material cost coefficient on the system operation is analyzed, verifying that using captured CO2 as the gas production material effectively improves the operating efficiency of the power to gas and enhance the new energy consumption capacity as well as operational economy of the system. Finally, the contradiction between system operating economy and low-carbon caused by carbon capture introduction is studied in the multi-target scenarios, which proves that carbon capture can effectively improve the carbon emission reduction capacity of integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Fault Identification and Localization for Cables Based on Time-Frequency Domain Reflection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The insulation strength of cable is related with the security operation of power transmission and distribution system. Insulation diagnosis and fault localization for high voltage cables has great significance for urban power g rid security. This paper presented a novel method based on the time-frequency domain reflection method (TFDR) that can restrain the noise interference in the measurement of impedance spectroscopy of cables to precisely identify and locate defects in high voltage cable. In the paper, the cable transmission line model under normal operation and different fault types was analyzed according to the principle of TFDR cable fault location and the distribution parameter model of power cables. The cable sample that contains thermal aging defects is manufactured. The cable defect state features are extracted automatically based on the signal inject method and coupling devices from the original input samples, and the fault type recognition and location are realized with the time-frequency analysis algorithm. Based on the developed cable samples and detection devices, the proposed method is validated. The experimental results show that the method can effectively identify and locate the aging segments and concentration defects in cables. The TFDR method can serve as a sensitive fault diagnosis tool suitable for high-voltage cable networks under various conditions.

articleTitle: Development of fault diagnosis expert system based on wastewater treatment systems of intelligent substations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the current popularity and application of intelligent substations, in order to meet the construction requirements of automation and greening of such new substations, the scheme of using MBR process and SBR process for wastewater treatment of intelligent substations with different wastewater discharge volumes is proposed.. And the types of faults that may occur in the treatment process are summarized, and a fault diagnosis expert system for wastewater treatment is designed using VB6.0, which is convenient for substation staff to troubleshoot common faults in the process of wastewater treatment in time and can help reduce the learning cost of staff, with a broader application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Formation Control Method of UAV Group
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: UAV group formation is widely used in many fields and tends to be popular in the world. It is an urgent problem to determine the minimum number of UAVs transmitting signals in UAV formation. The main research content of this paper is the formation control of UAV formation flight, with bearings-only passive location as the core method, first, classify the position of the UAV, program around the sine and cosine theorem of analytic geometry, and then adjust the position of UAV according to the reference target state. Finally, the report can comprehensively consider whether the position of the signal source UAV is accurate, whether the number of signal sources is known, different formation formations and other situations, and give the formation adjustment scheme with the least signal sources under different conditions, so that the UAV cluster formation can quickly and accurately adjust the position to achieve the desired effect.

Author Keywords: location circle multi-station cross location method

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology and System Design of Network Performance Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In view of the lack of practical means of network performance management, this paper firstly studies the relevant technologies of network performance monitoring, and compares and analyzes the commonly used network traffic models. Secondly, on the basis of current situation analysis and related technology research, a network performance monitoring system based on the combination of active and passive measurement is proposed, which can measure the performance parameters of IP networks of different scales. Finally, the overall architecture of the system is designed.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of control system for rail car
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of manual identification of CA mortar layer gap of CRTS Ⅱ slab ballastless track, an intelligent track gap detection car based on Raspberry Pie 4B as the main control core was designed, and a non-destructive testing method based on laser scanning technology was used. The trolley can automatically travel on the track, locate its own position and measure its travel speed, display the detected gap width, depth and track plate number data corresponding to its position in real time, package and send the detected data to the terminal, and automatically identify the problem of avoiding the track side stop during the travel to prevent the trolley from collision. Through the design and analysis of the mechanism and control system of the trolley, the requirements of gap detection can be achieved, providing technical support for the safety assurance and development of high-speed railway.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Based on Improved YOLOv3 Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Pedestrian detection has important applications in driverless and road detection. For the common problems of pedestrian detection such as multi-scale target and occlusion, this paper improves the YOLOv3 network structure by introducing CBAM attention mechanism and SPP structure to improve the expression ability of the output feature layer of the backbone network, and greatly improves the perceptual field to enhance the network's perception of features. By conducting experiments on the INRIA Person dataset, The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv3 network improves the detection accuracy from 89.95% of the original YOLOv3 network to 92.06%, an improvement of 2.3 percentage points, which is a significant improvement in accuracy. Compared with YOLOv3, the improved network in this paper has more outstanding effect on real-time detection.

articleTitle: Big Data Classification Model and Algorithm Based on Double Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: For the traditional big data classification models and algorithms that have the drawback of long processing time, the use of intelligent algorithms to model identification of multivariable systems has become a mainstream research direction. Discussion This paper proposes an efficient solution for data-parallel optimized computing. The problems in the identification of multi-variable systems that integrate historical big data and intelligent algorithms are analyzed, and the impact of input variables on output is quantified. Build a big data classification model, mine valid data points, arrange data combination methods, divide data local connection methods, obtain local node micro-cluster data, calculate redundant data and invalid data increment values in node data groups, and reconstruct central node sample algorithm, adjust the integrated data classification strategy, optimize and update the data integration classification method. Design the experiment, simulate the experimental environment, and verify that the proposed model calculation method can shorten the data processing time in practical application, which has practical research value. Through the design of the overall process of the algorithm, data classification to form a data set, and then describe the steps of the algorithm, and finally verify the feasibility of the algorithm through simulation experiments, which can not only greatly reduce the communication cost between network nodes, but also greatly improve the global mining accuracy and improve the query efficiency in distributed data, It has good utilization value in the analysis of massive data information.

articleTitle: Cross-scene Transfer of Road Disease Classification Model Based on Dynamic Knowledge Distillation Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: There will be various apparent diseases on the road, which will affect the driving safety and cause economic losses, so it is very important to maintain the road. Researchers need to transfer the classification model of road diseases across scenes, but the data of road diseases in the target scene are few and only partially marked, so the existing transfer learning method has poor effect. Aiming at the problem of cross-scene transfer of road disease classification model, the DNN-Road algorithm is proposed in this paper. The experimental results show that the DNN-Road algorithm achieves the best results among the mainstream transfer learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Calculation of Safety Evaluation Index Weight for Tactical Training Airspace Planning Based on Fuzzy AHP-DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of lack of data support, excessive subjectivity of expert judgment, fuzzy semantics, and mutual coupling between indices in safety evaluation process of tactical training airspace planning scheme, an index weight calculation method based on fuzzy AHP-DEMATEL is proposed for tactical training airspace planning. The triangular fuzzy number is first introduced into the traditional AHP method for determining the initial weight of each factor. Then, the initial weight is modified to get the comprehensive weight using fuzzy DEMATEL method. The example analysis shows that the method proposed can evaluate the safety of the tactical training airspace planning scheme, and select the planning scheme with high safety. The example verifies the feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent travel route selection system based on multi-objective genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous improvement of people's living standards and the widespread popularity of private cars, the demand for urban residents to choose to drive to the suburbs in their spare time is growing. Visitors can choose their own tourist destinations according to their individual needs, and they can also flexibly choose the traffic routes and tourist order of scenic spots according to the road traffic status and tourist flow information of scenic spots. How to dynamically select the optimal tourist route by using the real-time information of roads and scenic spots to avoid travel congestion and queue of scenic spots has become the primary problem of suburban tourism. At present, the ways to solve road traffic problems are mainly divided into two categories: strengthening road construction, increasing road capacity, developing intelligent transportation system and improving road operation efficiency. However, under the condition of limited urban land resources, it is undoubtedly the most effective way to optimize road traffic organization and management through intelligent transportation system. In this paper, the multi-objective genetic algorithm is applied to the tourism route planning in scenic spots, and a multi-objective route planning model of scenic spots is designed. According to the different travel time periods, different methods are used, that is, the multi-objective route planning model of scenic spots is used in the peak season of tourism, and the multi-objective genetic algorithm is used to plan the route in the off season of tourism. Multi-objective genetic algorithm is the most suitable algorithm to solve tourism problems. Once again, the mathematical modeling method is used to describe it in mathematical language. According to the mathematical model, a multi-objective algorithm is designed to solve the shortest path problem. By analyzing and comparing with the previous experience of parameter selection, appropriate parameter values are selected for the multi-objective algorithm to solve the problem, and the optimal solution is obtained. The results show that the optimized route solved in this paper obviously shortens the total distance of tourists' tour routes, improves the efficiency of tourism, and at the same time reduces the consumption of the whole tour process.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of park-urban multi-energy systems considering carbon trading and energy flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the aim of optimizing the allocation of multiple energy sources between parks and cities, particularly addressing the issue of uneven distribution of energy sources in multi-energy parks and the supply relationship of multiple energy sources in urban areas, this research focuses on the electricity system between parks and cities, and introduces the carbon trading mechanism to facilitate the integration of new energy sources for consumption and emission reduction, in the context of achieving carbon peak and carbon neutrality. To achieve this goal, we develop a bi-objective operation optimization model that minimizes system operating costs and reduces carbon emissions levels, for a multi-energy system with carbon quotas and energy flows between parks and cities. We verify the effectiveness of our proposed configuration scheme, and our results support its correctness and rationality.

articleTitle: A New Strategy for Optimizing Threshold Voltage of Artificial Neurons
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Over the years, memristors have received much attention as strong candidates in the field of neuromorphology and have presented a wide range of application scenarios. In order to ensure the effective imitation of neurons by memristors during electroforming, there is usually some variability in the selection of electrode materials at both ends, but this results in the threshold voltage of the device being asymmetric. However, electrical signals within the range of neuron threshold voltage can be used to carry and transmit information, the asymmetry of threshold voltage often leads to the error and leakage of stored information. In this work, we present a system consisting of an Au/TaOx/Ta memristor (MTSM), a diode, and two load resistors. We have developed artificial neurons on account of Au/TaOx/Ta that demonstrate outstanding power-on and power-off efficiency, with a conversion ratio above 10<sup>5</sup>. Furthermore, these artificial neurons exhibit sustained stability over multiple cycle tests, indicating their potential for practical use. Furthermore, we found that the size of the load resistance can affect the switching of individual devices and thus control the threshold voltage range of artificial neurons. Therefore, this paper proposes a new method to optimize the threshold voltage of artificial neurons based on load resistance. This optimized strategy can be used to adjust the setting and resetting of the threshold voltage of neurons thus providing a potential platform to facilitate the development of electronic devices.

articleTitle: Chinese Text Sentiment Classification Based on LSTM Word-Tag Relational Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the task of Chinese text sentiment classification, the method based on sentiment dictionary and machine learning is suitable for the situation of small amount of text corpus data and simple text semantics. With the explosive growth of online text information and the continuous enrichment of expression methods, many researchers have gradually applied deep learning methods to text sentiment classification and made breakthrough progress. Convolutional neural network (CNN) can effectively capture the local feature information of spatial structure, but it lacks the ability to learn the contextual relevance of words. Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) can solve the semantic context problem well, but the phenomenon of gradient explosion and gradient disappearance is easy to occur in the training process. To solve these problems, this paper designs a word-tag relation network model based on LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) Chinese text sentiment classification model, which can acquire deeper tag dependency and enrich the feature information of the text.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain Technology-based Optimization Algorithm for Precise Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The article discusses supply chain optimization based on blockchain supply chain technology and genetic algorithm in the context of IoT to improve the availability of goods and the security of logistics information, improve supply chain efficiency and reduce transportation costs. First, the basic theories of supply chain technology, supply chain optimization and genetic algorithm are introduced, and supply chain optimization with collaborative logistics information management is analyzed. Then, a supply chain network optimization model based on genetic algorithm is established and the optimization results are analyzed. The optimization results show that applying blockchain technology to collaborative logistics information management system improves the overall efficiency of supply chain logistics; using genetic algorithm, the logistics distribution cost is reduced. The study is innovative in optimizing the collaborative logistics information management system in the logistics supply chain and the logistics distribution channel by using blockchain technology and genetic algorithm to improve the security and availability of logistics information. The case study shows that the optimization of supply chain logistics using blockchain technology and genetic algorithm improves efficiency, reduces costs, improves corporate governance and economic efficiency, and increases the competitiveness of the company.

articleTitle: Optimization of machine translation algorithm for English long sentences based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Traditional artificial English long sentence translation efficiency is low, and the difference of the translator’s personal level will lead to uneven translation quality. The existing MT can not effectively solve the problems of cross-type ambiguity in English long sentence translation rules. This paper adopts the encoder-decoder structure. In the encoding stage, each word in the Chinese sentence is first mapped to a fixed-length word vector, and all the information of the entire sentence is compressed through the recurrent neural network. The attention model is introduced in the decoding process, so that the decoder pays more attention to the context-dependent words of the current translated word, and selects the translated word with the highest probability to generate the target sentence each time. Compared with traditional English long sentence translation methods, it has higher timeliness, higher accuracy, and stronger translation standards.

articleTitle: Intelligent English Automatic Translation System Based on Improved GLR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, there are still many problems in the research and application of portable instant translation system. For example, the existing echo cancellation algorithms often have the problem of divergence in the case of two terminal intercom, and the convergence speed of the algorithm can not meet the real-time requirements. Correct and effective shallow parsing plays an important role in the analysis of the whole sentence. In English Chinese machine translation, there is a high degree of grammatical ambiguity between English and Chinese, and the task of sentence analysis is extremely arduous. Parsing model and parsing algorithm are two inseparable problems with statistical parsing research. It reveals that the existing machine translation level can no longer meet the current translation requirements, and the machine translation technology with high translation accuracy.Therefore, this article proposes a method using variable step size, which increases step size without convergence and decreases step size with convergence. The article focuses on analyzing the defects in the GLR algorithm. The research results of this project will provide new research ideas for the intelligent research of machine translation.

articleTitle: Four-wheeled Ackermann Robot Path Planning in 2D Maze Based on Q-Learning-Bezier Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Path planning methods have been increasingly utilized in autonomous driving. However, traditional path planning methods, such as Q learning, is not suitable for wheeled vehicles. In this paper, a Q-learning-Bezier method (QLB) is proposed to address the path-planning problem of four-wheeled Ackermann robot by combining Q learning with Bezier curve to produce smooth trajectories that can be passed by Ackermann robot. Meanwhile, two methods with different numbers of optional actions, QLB4a and QLB8a are compared and constructed separately. Experiments show that both proposed methods can generate paths that can reach the end point in a random maze environment. Simulation results show that the Ackermann chassis robot can complete the whole path successfully, which reflects the effectiveness of the algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Heterogeneous Data Synchronization Framework for Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the expansion of the power system, the problem of data synchronization between heterogeneous business systems within power system is becoming more and more obvious. This paper designs a heterogeneous data synchronization service framework for power system. Business systems can flexibly choose synchronization mode while ensuring the normal operation of system functions. The framework decouples the business system functions from data synchronization functions, stores the collected updated data using the principle of message middleware. The test results show that the system performs well in data synchronization services with different data volumes in the power system.

articleTitle: An Automatic Approach for Fault Isolation Based on System Abnormity Probability Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the influence of state parameter abnormity to aeroengine performance. Based on multivariate statistical analysis, a probability model describing how the state variable influences aeroengine performance is built to isolate fault in performance monitoring of aeroengine. Using this model, the probability of each state variable leading to performance abnormity in aeroengine is calculated. With this probability, the variables causing abnormity can be preliminarily ascertained, and relevant components can be examined to find the fault source. The practical application in monitoring a certain type of turbofan engine suggests by calculating the probability of each monitored parameter causing abnormity, and with the aeroengine fault mechanism analysis, the fault source can be effectively determined.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Cable Broadband Linear Impedance Spectrum Test Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: the reliability of power supply of cable lines is a hot and difficult technical issue in the world. The power accident caused by cable fault is extremely harmful, thus it is vitally important to find the defects in cable laying and operation in a quick and nondestructive manner. Based on this, the online monitoring and diagnosis technology of cable line condition is a key research direction. In this paper, LIRA ACQUIRE technology, a cable broadband linear impedance spectrum test system, is proposed for cable detection and condition evaluation. Firstly, the principle, function, application scope and characteristics of the system are introduced. Then two typical application cases are introduced. According to comparative analysis, the data obtained by the test are consistent with the actual situation, which proves the accuracy and convenience of this technology. It is proved that this system has practical significance for improving the reliability of power supply lines.

articleTitle: 2D Maze Path Planning Based on Q-Learning and Bezier Curve
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Q-Learning is widely used in path planning situations, while the trajectories it generates usually have abrupt bends, bending points, and sharp endpoints. A modified Q- Learning algorithm and Bezier curve are introduced in this study to improve trajectory smoothing, bringing the resulting trajectory closer to the routes of real-world vehicles. First, different mazes with the same start point and end point are created. Second, Q-Learning and modified Q-Learning are applied to path planning. Lastly, the path smoothed by the Bezier curve is imported into the simulation environment to verify its validity. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the above methods in enhancing path smoothness and shortening path length.

articleTitle: Improved facial expression recognition algorithm based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: It is fascinating to hear about the research conducted on facial expression recognition algorithms and its significance in the era of intelligence, especially with the development of the internet and IoT. The use of deep learning method and neural network VGG to study facial expressions sounds promising. It is encouraging to know that the network structure was improved and pooled using Soft pool, thereby enhancing the extraction of facial expression features. The integration of an attention mechanism to improve the ability of the network to recognize facial expressions appears to be a valuable addition to the research. it is impressive that the recognition rate of the improved network on the face expression dataset RAF-DB reached 86.1%, exceeding that of the original VGG network on this data set. this outcome suggests that the changed network is effective for facial expression recognition. thank you for sharing this information.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of quickly building artificial intelligence training environment on high-performance server
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In the artificial intelligence algorithm training process, it is a very time-consuming thing for researchers to configure the environment required by the code on the shared servers. In view of the difficulty to configure software operating environment on the server side and the pain that different researchers easy to conflict with each other in the research of big data and artificial intelligence when multiple people share multiple high-performance servers, a cooperation training platform between desktop and high-performance server based on SLURM, Singularity and Anaconda was proposed. At first, Anaconda was used to complete the software prototype development and simple running test in the desktop environment; Then a single file created by the Singularity software which packaged the existing environment and code was uploaded to a remote high-performance server. At last, SLURM and Singularity technology are used to start the operation of the single file on some high-performance servers and calculate the experimental results. A typical deep neural network training process was taken as an example to demonstrate the feasibility of the experimental data platform. The experiment shows that the experimental data platform can quickly configure the same experimental environment on the server and desktop, and has the characteristics of security, easy management and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Train a Highly Robust Model with a Data-enhanced Wavelet Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Once the classification neural network is attacked by adversarial attack, the classification accuracy will drop significantly. Therefore, the combination of wavelet transform and ResNet18 network model, and then linear interpolation adversarial training is used to train the defense model to improve its classification accuracy. Before training the network, the samples are linearly interpolated to obtain the interpolated samples and interpolation labels, and after the image features are convolved and normalized layers, the wavelet transform is applied to downsample to help filter out the high-frequency information, and finally the interpolation loss is obtained to update the network parameters. The trained model is tested using multiple adversarial attack methods on the CIFAR-10 and SVHN datasets, and the experimental results show that the proposed method can show excellent defense performance under strong attacks, and improve robustness and training time.

articleTitle: Anomaly Segmentation Based on Cosine Similarity Edge Iteration Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: At present, the existing anomaly segmentation algorithm directly uses the abnormal score of the trained network output, such as the cosine similarity score. However, due to the uncertainty of the edge, the edge pixels or pixels near the edge are less similar to the class prototype. It shows more false negatives at the target edge during inferring, which will greatly affect the performance of the anomalous segmentation. This paper proposed to solve the problem of more false negatives in target edges. First, we need to calculate the cosine similarity between the input pixel and the class prototype. The cosine similarity calculation image was performed using morphological edge detection to extract the false negative edges, features with high non-edge similarity were screened by the edge-aware pooling layer, the filtered features are used to update the edges part. Finally, the updated cosine similarity calculation image is treated with expansion smoothing. The experiments presented were conducted in the StreetHazards Dataset, the FPR95 was 19.6%, AUROC rate was 92.5%, AUPR was 12.5%. The method in this paper is simple and the network does not require retraining, and the precision is close to SOTA.

articleTitle: Adaptive Learning for Fast Training Neural Network in Hybrid Beamforming MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Recent research exhibits that the neural network based hybrid beamforming multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system can improve the spectrum efficiency and biterror-rate (BER) significantly. However, the neural network based hybrid beamforming MIMO system requires high iterations to follow the change of channel state information (CSI) during training. To overcome such difficulty, we propose an adaptive learning algorithm to fast train the neural network based hybrid beamforming system. The innovation of the adaptive learning algorithm is to calculate and return a dynamic learning rate vector for the corresponding channel model. We also propose an early training termination technology by analyzing the loss upper bound of the neural network training, which can further improve the training process. The simulation results show that the adaptive learning algorithm can considerably decrease the training times for the neural network based hybrid beamforming MIMO system and still maintain the system's BER performance.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Visual Modelling Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Most of the research on visual saliency in the field of computer vision is limited to the two-dimensional image level, while ignoring that human visual attention decisions occur in three-dimensional dynamic scenes. For this reason, a three-dimensional visual saliency algorithm is proposed based on a saliency calculation framework that combines multiple features. The article carries out binocular vision stereo tracking: using extended Kalman to predict and eliminate the wrong candidate targets in the prediction area according to the peripolar line constraints. Experiments show that in the video sequence shot in the laboratory’s Kinect, when the target is occluded and other complex situations, better tracking results can be obtained. In the experimental video, the overall tracking performance index of the classic method is improved by about 3%, indicating that this method can be more effective.

articleTitle: Adaptive Learning Analysis System for Colleges and Universities Based on Online and Offline Mixed Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology has made it possible for educational innovation. Autonomous learning, which fully reflects the personalized characteristics and needs of students, has become an important trend in the development of education in various countries. The teaching process of colleges and universities needs to apply the adaptive learning concept to the teaching process. According to the characteristics of adaptive learning that requires analysis and mining of students' learning data, the research and development of the college adaptive learning analysis system for online and offline hybrid teaching can achieve targeted teaching and provide teaching efficiency and effect.

articleTitle: Stability of Generalized Continuous Hopfield Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The Hopfield Neural Network (HNN) is a significant neural network which is applied in diverse applications such as signal reconstruction, image analysis, and optimization. In this paper, we propose a novel method for analyzing or determining the stability of generalized continuous feedback neural networks, which abandons the traditional approach of constructing Lyapunov energy function. The paper also provides relevant proofs for this method. By mathematical proof, it is concluded that the continuous Hopfield network is globally asymptotically stable, and this result is consistent with the result obtained by constructing the energy function.

articleTitle: CNN-BiLSTM-Attention Prediction Model for Merchandise Sales Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: As companies continue to generate merchandise sales, the data is important for their marketing planning, market analysis, and logistics planning, so it is important to accurately predict merchandise sales. This paper combines a recently proposed attention mechanism multiple time series regression model, the CNN-BiLSTM-Attention model, to predict product sales for the next three months. The model can fix the overfitting problem, and can accurately predict the sales volume of products with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Robot Index Based on AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Since the emergence of human beings, people have hoped that robots can take the place of people's work. The development of robots has always affected people's life and productivity, and the performance of robots in the stock market index reflects the development and use of robots. In order to predict the stock market index of robots, this paper proposes a decision tree based AdaBoost regression model to predict the robot index. First, prepare the historical data to be used, make a simple analysis and split it into training set and test set; Then, the features of date, open, high, low, close and volume waiting for analysis are observed visually; Then the AdaBoost regression algorithm model is used to train the training set data modeling, and the best fitting prediction curve is obtained; Finally, the test set is used to predict the new data value. After many times of training and testing, the scheme can achieve good prediction results.

articleTitle: Simulation of IGBT switch transient analysis model considering parasitic parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: The voltage change rate and current change rate of the insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) in the switching transient produce large induced voltage and induced current on the parasitic parameters of the device, which makes the IGBT very sensitive to the parasitic parameters during the switching process. In order to evaluate the influence of parasitic parameters of main circuit and package on the characteristics of IGBT switch, a transient analysis model of IGBT switch considering the influence of parasitic parameters is proposed. Detailed modeling and analysis are carried out for each stage of device turn-on and turn-off process, mathematical equations of voltage and current at each stage are established, and the change rate of voltage and current at different stages is calculated. Based on the mathematical equation between parasitic parameters and voltage and current, the influence of parasitic parameters on IGBT switching characteristics at each stage of the turn-on and turn-off process is analyzed. Finally, the influence rule of parasitic parameters on IGBT switching characteristics is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Collaborative path planning method for vehicle and vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle for power tower inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the key elements in the path planning problem of cooperative tower inspection between vehicle and vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle are sorted out and analyzed, and a model of TSP-D variant problem is constructed. Firstly, the respective functions of UAV and vehicle in the inspection process should be defined, and their respective flight and driving rules should be defined according to the characteristics of their functions. On this basis, the cooperative mode between them and the path characteristics under cooperative constraints should be further considered. The TSP-D model for transmission tower inspection (TTI-TSP-D) is constructed by reducing time consumption through collaborative parallelism and taking the total time required for inspection as the objective function. Therefore, we use genetic algorithm to solve the above model. By analyzing the characteristics of cooperative path planning problems and models, we propose odd-even layered coding to realize the transformation from problem space to chromosome space, and design matching crossover mode, mutation mode, solution test and infeasible solution correction mode. Finally, the performance of the algorithm is analyzed from multiple angles through simulation experiments, The correctness of the algorithm is verified by comparing it with enumeration algorithm in small-scale test cases, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is demonstrated by comparing it with conventional strategies in different scale tests. In addition, in order to improve the solution effect of the algorithm, the sensitivity of related parameters of the algorithm is analyzed through experiments, and the best configuration of algorithm parameters is given.

articleTitle: A novel 2-bit 2.5-dimensional miniaturized multifunctional active frequency-selective surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: A novel 2.5-D miniaturized multifunctional active frequency selective surface (2.5-D MAFSS) is proposed in this article. The structure uses two sets of the same gradual bending patches on the upper and lower surfaces respectively, and is connected with adjacent units. In addition, a PIN diode is loaded on the horizontal direction of the upper surface and the vertical direction of the bottom surface of the unit.By changing the ON-OFF state of the PIN diode, four independent working states can be achieved.At the same time, compared with the existing structure, the structure can achieve better miniaturization performance, the size of each unit is only 0.05λ<inf>0</inf>× 0.05λ<inf>0</inf>, where λ<inf>0</inf> is the wavelength of the free-space.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of English Machine Translation Based on Association Rules Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In response to this summary, and for the shortcomings of large English translation errors under the weakened rules, an English machine translation optimization algorithm based on weakened grammatical rules is proposed. Association rules are a research goal invested by many researchers engaged in artificial intelligence and database fields. At present, the main work is concentrated in the field of algorithm research. Association rules are widely used in the field of social life.

articleTitle: Research on Power Marketing System Based on Intelligent Full Speech Recognition and Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, a new electric power marketing information system is designed and developed by Silverstream platform with three layers including application server. Then, based on each server node in the speech recognition model, the system adjusts the virtual machine usage through the load prediction process. The image backup process is used to restore VM data when faults occur. The experimental results show that the load of different virtual machines is lower than 40% during the process of power marketing information storage. The VMS have the same load. This method can improve the blocking balance during information storage and improve storage efficiency.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition Using Inertial Sensors with 1D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Nowadays, smart wearable devices are widely used and Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems technology (MEMS) sensors are usually embedded in them. In this paper, a novel gesture recognition framework based on the 3D accelerometer and 3D gyroscope of smart phone is prpposed. Currently, most of the effort is focused on manually extracting features from MEMS sensors. However, without relevant domain knowledge, it is difficult to extract valid features to classify specific tasks. Instead of manual feature extraction, we propose 1D Convolutional Neural Network model to automatically extract features and gesture recognition from acceleration and gyroscope data. The best average recognition of ten Arabic numerals was 89.63%. The experimental results show that gesture-based Human-computer Interaction (HCI) can be applied as a new type of HCI for consumer electronics and mobile devices.

articleTitle: Study of a Three-step Nonlinear Control Method for Electric Heating Boilers Based on Smith’s Predictor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Considering that the temperature of the electric boiler system is easy to overshoot and accompanied by hysteresis when working, that is, there are problems of unidirectional heating, large hysteresis and large inertia, a new model-based three-step controller is designed, and combined with the Smith estimator to compensate for hysteresis, time-varying, etc. The results of the experimental platform show that the newly developed Smith three-step nonlinear controller has smaller steady-state error, higher tracking rate and better control performance than the original PID-Smith-based controller.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Sensor Networks in Intelligent Environment Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Real-time search of objects, data, and services has grown to be a crucial and practical problem in the IoT world in recent years due to the fast deployment of numerous Internet of Things (IoT) sensors. In addition to offering solutions for real-time sensor data collecting in the IoT, IoT data prediction models also provide more useful applications than conventional IoT event detection models. Using complicated time series created by several types of sensors, we have developed an enhanced neural network model in this research for multi-dimensional feature selection and outlier identification. Comparing our approach to conventional data prediction methods, we can see an improvement in the stability and accuracy of long-term forecasts for IoT sensor data. Finally, we compare the training capabilities of traditional neural network models with random forest models to assess the efficacy of our prediction model using sensor data from the Intel Berkeley Research Laboratory. Our model achieves an accuracy rate that is respectively more than 12% and 68% higher than the two comparison models, while the corresponding loss values are less than 0.325 and 0.595, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on a high-precision real-time 3D sonar image registration algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: An effective improved ICP algorithm for sonar point cloud registration is proposed. Through the coarse registration based on GPS and attitude instrument, the iteration times of ICP registration can be reduced; By mapping the sonar point cloud coordinates to the beam and distance coordinates and setting the threshold of the beam region to search, we only search for the points which are in the region to find the nearest point as the corresponding point, which greatly reduces the number of points to be compared in each iteration. Thus, the efficiency of ICP registration is effectively accelerated. Experiments show that the algorithm can improve the efficiency by 15-20 times.

articleTitle: Business process modeling extension and scheduling strategy compatible with big data business
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Business Process Management (BPM) is the factual criteria for business process modeling. Although it is widely used in various fields, when required When using business processes to express big data business processes, the existing business process specifications do not support it. Big data business can only be simulated as multiple manual tasks before execution, which is not friendly to non-big data technology practitioners, and will The non-standardized business process and poor reusability lead to a reduction in the efficiency of business completion. On the other hand, while supporting big data technology brings flexibility to BPM, it consumes a lot of process engine resources when executing big data business processes, and the execution efficiency is low, which brings greater burden to the process engine. Aiming at the above deficiencies, this paper carries out the following work: (1) Extend the existing business process modeling, and define a new category of " Big Data Service Task" by extending the activity elements in BPMN2.0 (2) Propose a compatible big data technology The task scheduling strategy in the business process includes a single big data task scheduling decision and an intensive big data task scheduling decision.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of PLC Technology in Electrical Engineering Automation Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper introduces the principle, composition, and design process of the electrical engineering automation control test system based on programmable controller PLC and MCGS configuration software. The test system consists of control, measurement, data acquisition, and configuration subsystems. The control subsystem consists of the upper computer (industrial control computer), the lower computer (PLC), and the control device. In this paper, the real-time control and data acquisition of the motor is carried out by the host computer, which effectively improves the test accuracy and efficiency of the high-voltage motor and realizes the automation and intelligence of the motor test.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Experimental Research on Intelligent Traction Plate for Stringing Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of tension paying off based on continuous process calculation and intelligent sensing, the application of intelligent paying off construction equipment can greatly improve the automation of tension paying off. Due to the limitation of traditional traction plate structure, it is not convenient to add sensing equipment and the problem of large quality. For the main part of the traction plate, the main body of the traction plate, the material analysis and research are carried out, and the optimization constraint conditions are proposed. The simulation model of the traction plate body is established by using software. The main body of the traction plate is designed by adjusting the main material and structural dimension parameters of the traction plate, and the trial production test of the traction plate is carried out. Through the finite element analysis and test method, the paying off pulley that meets the requirements of engineering strength and stiffness and has a light weight is obtained. Compared with the traditional empirical design method, research and development efficiency has been greatly improved. The research results can provide certain feasible conditions for the research of intelligent construction equipment.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Campus Water Supply Network Leakage Problem Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper explores the problem of leakage in the campus water supply network. Using methods such as time series analysis, BP neural network, and semi-Markov processes, and software such as Matlab and Excel, the water consumption characteristics of a functional area in the campus are analyzed and statistically analyzed. The data relationship between water meter levels is established, and the leakage rate trend chart and the mathematical model of the water supply network leakage are constructed to analyze the leakage situation of the water supply network. The BP neural network deep learning method is used to predict the location of water supply network leakage, and a mathematical model of water supply network leakage is constructed to determine the location and intensity of leakage based on the model. The semi-Markov process is used to simulate the leakage situation of water pipes, and the optimal maintenance decision-making plan for the network leakage is determined by setting the objective function.

articleTitle: A Three-Dimensional Shape Measurement for Large Deep-Cavity Parts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In manufacturing, it is important to measure large, complex, deep-cavity parts with high accuracy. Due to the large size of the part itself and the complex structure of its inner and outer surface, the traditional three-dimensional (3D) optical measuring system is more difficult to measure. In this paper, a collaborative measurement system for large-size complex deep-cavity parts is proposed based on high-dynamic range N-step fringe projection profilometry and parallel single-pixel imaging technology. By collaborative measurements, the 3D point cloud of internal and external surfaces of parts are reconstructed, and the measurement results are stitched. Experimental results show that the system can accurately measure the internal and external surface of complex deep-cavity parts and stitch the point cloud data with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Center System Based on Computer Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, the introduction of big data technology, from the hardware and software two aspects of communication security protection system design research. With the support of hardware equipment, the secure communication channel of the system is constructed by using the big data processing center as the support. The network data in the communication is stored in the specified network space to build the network communication link database. In this paper, the results of variance measurement are converted into the similarity between data and the similarity relationship of network communication big data is constructed. In this way, the similarity matrix of network communication big data is obtained. Experimental results show that the system designed by the proposed method has fast communication speed, low energy consumption, and low packet loss rate during communication.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of harmonic distortion characteristics of three-phase bridge inverter circuit based on SPWM control strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems, the gradual promotion of ultra-high voltage DC transmission technology has a key influence in China's power transmission projects, in which rectification and inverters play a great role. At present, the transmission technology has been perfected, but there are still problems of non-standard output current and disturbing waveform on the inverter side of EHV DC transmission, so how to improve the quality of the standard sinusoidal waveform of inverter current output with corresponding control strategies is a key problem that needs to be solved urgently. Based on the IGBT three-phase bridge inverter circuit, this paper focuses on the working principle of the inverter circuit, the principle of the main circuit topology and complementary structure, and the SPWM modulation technique for analysis and design. The Simulink simulation technique is used to calculate and measure the modulated waveform, carrier waveform, and inverter waveform obtained under the support of the modulated signal technique and perform FFT analysis to obtain the inverter results under different conditions. This experiment successfully improves the success rate of the inverter in obtaining high-quality sinusoidal waveforms, and the SPWM modulation technique effectively reduces the waveform distortion rate and suppresses the effects of harmonics. This is of great significance for the safe, stable, and efficient operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Intelligent model description language and algorithm generation based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of Internet technology and the emergence of large-scale data sets, deep learning has achieved great success in many traditional computer vision tasks due to its excellent computing power. Deep learning technology widespread application cannot leave the convolutional neural network algorithm and circulating neural network algorithm, nowadays, most of the research is to divide the image into one or more discrete label, can describe the image of the object categories, but did not describe the relationship between each object in the image and the image of what is happening. To sum up, this paper studies the image description algorithm based on deep learning and puts forward a series of improvement schemes for the defects of existing models. Experimental results show that compared with traditional methods, the proposed image description algorithm can effectively improve the performance of the image description algorithm, solve the defects of the previous image description algorithm, and generate the image description text more accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Information Big Data Prediction System Based on Support Vector Machine Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In this paper, combined with K-nearest neighbor classification and support vector machine classification, a predictive model on customer churn is designed. The goal of the model is to reduce the loss of innovative customers to the collaborative product innovation process and the enterprise. At the same time, the system can effectively identify innovative customers with a tendency to churn in collaborative product innovation. The model first collects historical samples of mobile customer churn, removes some useless samples through preprocessing, then classifies the mobile customer type according to the SVM algorithm, and finally predicts the churn rate of specific mobile customers. Experimental results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the prediction model. The model has high accuracy and strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Warning System of Circuit Breaker Based on Fault Recording
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the gradual improvement of China's electric power network, increasingly higher requirement is put forward for power network maintenance and power supply quality. Short circuit is one common and destructive fault in power grid. In recent years, a number of power grid accidents occurred in China Southern Power Grid Company, causing considerable short circuit impact on power equipment and seriously affecting the safe and stable operation of the power system. At present, the mechanical fault diagnosis technology of high-voltage circuit breaker has many problems, such as difficult installation, complex wiring and operation, and single diagnosis technology. Moreover, the existing monitoring system cannot comprehensively monitor and diagnose all parts of the circuit breaker, such as secondary control circuit components, spring or hydraulic operating mechanism, operating transmission rod and mechanical components of arc extinguishing chamber, it is difficult to perform intelligent analysis and status assessment of circuit breakers in substations. This paper introduces an intelligent early warning analysis method for circuit breakers based on fault recording, and gives the overall design of online monitoring device for circuit breakers. Through the substation recording data, SOE signal of protection switch action and mechanical characteristic data, the current of opening and closing coils and three-phase main circuit are monitored, and the data are analyzed and the potential mechanical fault of circuit breakers is diagnosed, It provides an effective technical means for condition based maintenance of high-voltage circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Research on Modal Parameter Identification and Damage Diagnosis of Bridge Structure Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Large-scale bridge projects are an vital part of national infrastructure, and are directly related to the safety of people's lives and properties. The identification of modal parameters of bridge structures under working conditions is an vital part of bridge damage identification. Considering the practicability of bridge detection, bridge detection should generally be based on environmental excitation. The existing means of modal parameter identification under environmental excitation are not suitable for The identification accuracy of the modal frequency is high, while the identification of the displacement mode has a large error. The existing means of modal parameter identification under environmental excitation have relatively high identification accuracy for the modal frequency, while the identification of the displacement mode has a large error. Due to the complexity and large-scale bridge structure, the importance and necessity of bridge structure health monitoring are more and more recognized by people. The means used in this paper is to improve the genetic algorithm to simulate the phenomena of reproduction, crossover and gene mutation that occur in the spontaneous selection and spontaneous heredity process. Genetic algorithm is a global optimization adaptive probabilistic search algorithm, which has the advantages of intelligent optimization and robustness.

Author Keywords: modal parameter identification and damage diagnosis

articleTitle: A ubiquitous IoT localization algorithm for power system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is a new type of information perception, collection and processing technology used by humans to study the physical world. In this paper, combined with the current mainstream positioning algorithms of wireless sensor network nodes, a ubiquitous IoT positioning algorithm for power systems is proposed. The technical research method combining mathematical models, using the linearization method of coordinate system translation, that is, a new method to eliminate the nonlinear variables of the observation equation through the corresponding formula transformation, thereby reducing the amount of calculation (low power consumption) and achieving better positioning performance , A localization algorithm that meets the needs of various scenarios is the ultimate research goal..

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation system of friendly charging of electric vehicles considering the characteristics of user behavior trends based on hierarchical fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: With the increase of electric vehicle ownership, how to accurately dispatch electric vehicles has become an urgent problem to be solved. Scientific evaluation of users by analyzing user behavior trends is a key link in the implementation of accurate scheduling. In this paper, considering the characteristics of user behavior trends, a research method of electric vehicle friendly charging evaluation system based on hierarchical fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is proposed: Firstly, a comprehensive evaluation index system for user-friendly charging of electric vehicles is constructed to provide a reference standard for comprehensive evaluation. Secondly, a combined weighting algorithm based on EWM-CRITIC and improved AHP is proposed to achieve scientific empowerment by modifying the subjective and objective weights. Finally, a hierarchical fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is proposed to evaluate the user's charging friendliness in a hierarchical manner, which provides a basis for accurate scheduling. The simulation is carried out using real data, and the results show the effectiveness and rationality of the user-friendly charging evaluation system method for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Design of Translation Accuracy Correction Algorithm for English Translation Software Based on Semantic Relations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Up to now, a fully automatic and high-quality software translation system has not appeared, which is due to the complexity of language knowledge and the limitation of human understanding of language laws. At present, the research of software translation is not limited to the syntactic and semantic analysis of a single sentence, but also to fully explore the internal laws of language and deeply explore various contextual information including sentence groups, paragraphs, chapters and genres. Therefore, this paper studies the accuracy methods of software translation in English language and literature. This paper describes the implementation process of similar instance retrieval module and translation generation module in software translation, and further proofreads the accurate translation of English language through data-oriented translation model.

articleTitle: An Adaptive High Frequency Time Series Prediction Model Based on LSTM and Bayes Model Averaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: Compared with traditional time prediction methods such as ARIMA and GARCH, neural network models such as LSTM can predict high-frequency time series more effectively. In this paper, the original time series information is considered to fit the prediction residual of LSTM model to further improve the prediction accuracy. Specifically, PCA and kernel method are first used to reduce the dimension of the original sequence with fixed lag order to capture the linear and nonlinear information of the original data. Considering the true data distribution and unknown structure, we use the idea of model averaging to adaptively determine the relative importance of linear and non-linear information and select the dimensionality reduction space dimensions of PCA and KPCA. In this paper, OLS, Lasso, ridge regression and principal component regression based on cumulative contribution rate are used as comparative methods to analyze the actual data in three data sets: hourly power change in a state in the United States, hourly PM2.5 content change in Beijing and changes in traffic flow at intersections. The empirical results show that the proposed method has certain competitiveness compared with other methods.

Author Keywords: high frequency time series regression prediction

articleTitle: Encrypted malware detection based on HTTPs financial data communication mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: In recent years, fintech has gained widely and deeply application, and the existing data security problems also keep emerging. Network attacks using advanced local hiding technology are increasing, which has become a serious threat to the financial data security. However, these attacks cannot be normally detected, and some attacks imitate normal data to evade detection. Therefore, a malware detection method representing users' web communication behavior is proposed, which introduces HTTPs data communication mode for classification. Two methods of constructing HTTPs communication descriptors are discussed, a method of large-scale descriptor construction is introduced, and the machine learning algorithm and similarity search methods suitable for the proposed descriptors are analyzed. Experiments are conducted to compare the performance of the two types of descriptors in various classification algorithms and search scenarios. The test results show that the machine learning classification method based on the proposed communication descriptor can effectively detect encrypted malware communications based on HTTPs.

articleTitle: The assignment decision of human resources in hydraulic engineering based on TAP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Control, Electronics and Computer Technology (ICCECT)
abstract: This paper presented an assignment decision of human resources in hydraulic engineering based on the task assignment problem (TAP). For different types of TAP, the Hungarian algorithm was used and the model was solved by MATLAB program about transforming the efficiency matrix into a square matrix. The calculation results showed that the assignment decision could allocate the limited human resources in the hydraulic engineering reasonably, and realize the time and cost minimization. which also proved the feasibility, practicality and high efficiency of the assignment decision.
